tei:titleStmt.tei:title: rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs bka' 'bum kha pa'i dkar chags bzhugs so/༄/ /rgyal dbang ratha'i bka' 'bum kha par/dang po/(ka)bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdo
rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs bka' 'bum kha pa'i dkar chags bzhugs so/༄/ /rgyal dbang ratha'i bka' 'bum kha par/dang po/(ka)bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdo

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000270rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs bka' 'bum kha pa'i dkar chags bzhugs so/ ༄// rgyal dbang ratha'i bka' 'bum kha par/ dang po/ (ka)bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdoms pa lhan skyes lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i cho ga dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba/(33) (kha)bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga'i sgrub thabs don gnyis mchog stsol zhe bya ba(21) (ga)bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lta lnga mchod pa'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/(10) (nga)gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i bsnyen sgrub rjes gnang gi cho ga bdud dpung zil gnon/(12) (ca)bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'i sta gon rab tu dbye ba dpag bsams snye ma(12) (cha)dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig rtsa byis pas rtogs pa zhes bya ba(3) (ja)sgrub chen bka' brgyad myang lugs kyi thig rtsa rgyud lung mthun grub(3) (nya)bla ma zhi ba'i las byang dbang dang bcas pa (6) (ta)bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub chen dang sman bsgrub kyi nyams yig dmar byang zin bris ta sbyang ba'i sngags shog gcig ma/(5) (tha)bsam yas dbu bde gshegs yongs 'dus kyi lung bdag 'jug gis dus kyi dag snang (2) (da)bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi las byang log 'dren zil gnon/(17) (na)phyag rgya zil gnon gyi bsnyen bsgrub kyi yig chung gud du bkol ba(4) (pa)'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro chu dug gdong nag po'i las byang gdug pa tshar gcod ces bya ba(11) (pha)dug sngags gser gzungs ma zhes pa'i dug bsrungs gser mdog can zhes bya ba'i gdams (2)pa zab mo (7) (ba)bstan bsrungs chos skyong gi skor las dpal mgon po bya rog ma'i las byang bsdus pa 'phrin las kyi 'dod 'jo dang*/ bskang ba 'phrin las lhun grub (14) (ma)dpal mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang bka' gtad 'phrin las bde mgyogs zhes bya ba dang*/

dpal ye shes mgon po'i gsang ba gsol ba 'debs dang*/ mnga' gsol gyi rim pa cung zhig bsdus pa bdud las rnam rgyal bcas par (4) (tsa)bka' bsrungs a phyi zhe drag gtso 'khor gyi snying po gsal ba drag po gzhon pa 'khor bcas su sgrub pa/ bstan srung a phyi'i rgyun rgyun gsol phrin las myur mgyogs zhes bya ba dang bcas par (27) (tsha)a phyi chos kyi sgron ma'i gsol kha(6) (dza)bka' srung rnams la nang mchod 'bul ba'i tshig bcad (2) (wa)mgon po bya rog ma'i bsnyen sgrub kyi zhal gdams (2) (zha)chos skyong mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang a phyi'i rjes gnang bsdus pa (3) (za)tshe dang ye shes kyi mgon po dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i bsnyen sgrub (10) ('a)gza'i las byang 'phrin las kun 'grub bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs (17) (ya)drang srong la ka kha'i tshig bcad (1) (ra)dregs pa'i las byang (6) (la)'dir mkhyen dgongs dpangs gzu dmod bcol drag po srog gi spu gri nag po (6) (sha)nyes byas dang drag bskul nyams pa srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba (3) (sa)sku lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi las byang lhun grub ces bya ba (ha a)dge bsnyen rdo rje byang chub kyi gsol kha khyon grangs nyis brgya dang drug cu re bzhi bzhugs/ sarba masba laṃ/// /

(3)༄༅/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa na skyes lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i cho ga dbang bzhi chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i cho ga'i dbang gi sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pa bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lhan skyes grub pa'i dbang phyug gtso// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs la btud de// rgyud 'grel rnam dag gzhung dang man ngag bzhin// smin byed dbang gi lag len 'dir brjod bya// de yang gang dag rdo rje theg pa'i lam du zhugs te/ dka' ba med par tshe gcig la sogs pas sangs rgyas nyid 'grub pa ni rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa las 'byung la/ de ltar 'jug pa la'ang dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro bar nges shing*/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la 'jug pa gal che bas/ de'i tshul shes par bya ba la/ rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa dang mi 'os pa'i dbye ba dang*/ snod du rung ba dang*/ mi rung ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ yon tan can la gsol ba gdab pa/ slob dpon gyi dang por bsnyen pa bya ba/ cho ga'i rim pa ji ltar lag tu blang ba'o// dang po ni/ ji skad du/ yang dag shes shing rgyud shes pa// dpal ldan khrag 'thung gsang sngags shes/ khro med gtsang zhing mkhas pa dang*// sbyor shes ye shes pha rol 'gro// zhes dang*/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs dang brkam chags bdag nyid bstod// mnyam par ma bzhag khyim la spyod// gshol 'dzugs pa dang tshod pa dang*// rmongs pas dam chos 'tshong ba ni// tshogs sam dkyil 'khor slob dpon min// zhes pa'i skyon can spangs shing*/ gong gi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'am/ yon tan shas che bar gyur pa'i slob dpon bsten par bya'o// gnyis pa ni ji skad du/ gsol 'debs slob ma'i mtshan nyid dag

/gnas lnga'i yon tan ldan pa'am// dad pa yi ni nges 'gro ba// theg gsum don las mi 'da' zhing*// theg pa mchog la mngon dga' dang*// slob dpon la ni rab dad cing*// 'gro la snying brtse bden par smra// mchog 'dod don la sbyor nus pa// zhes dang*/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug khengs dang brkam chags rnam g.yeng ldan// drag dang rmongs dang snyoms las can// gzhan gyi srog la snying rje med// gzhan gyi nor la sred pa ni// bla mas yongs su spang bar bya// zhes shātra rak+ṣi ta'i gzhung las bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan mi ldan slob dpon mkhas pas legs par brtags te blang dor bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i slob dpon du 'os pa la snod ldan gyi slob mas sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i sems kyis dbang bskur ba don du gnyer bas gsol ba lan gsum du gdab cing*/ slob ma'i rgyud la tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod pa'i yo byad kyang ci 'byor ba bsham/ bzhi pa ni/ slob dpon gyis ji skad bshad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar thun du bcad nas bsnyen par bya'o// lnga pa cho ga'i rim pa lag tu blang ba la/ sdom ni/ sa chog sta gon dkyil 'khor sgrub// bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur dang*// rjes chog dang ni rnam pa drug /dang po lnga ste sa bslang dang*// brtag sbyang gzung dang bsrung ba'o// dang po ni/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ ri bo'i sul dang tshang tshing phug /sman ljongs rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang ni// gdod nas dag pa'i dur khrod dam// phun tshogs 'tshe ba med pa dang*// dben zhing gang du yid 'jug pa// der ni dpal chen dkyil 'khor bri// zhes gsungs pas/ gtsug lag khang sogs dben zhing shis pa'i gnas su/ gzhi de la mnga' byed pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa la bslang dgos na brda sbyar zhing*/ gnang bar rig nas gang du bya ba'i sa der gnas bdag gi mchod gtor bshams la/

sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang phyag rgya drug la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi steng du gnas pa yum dang bcas par skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ nang mchod bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la myang*/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarbā sdarmā sla ā snganunasla twang oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ yul bdag grong bdag gnas bdag 'khor bcas spyan drangs pa las/ yul bdag grong bdag gnas bdag sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā te+u+o bi shwa mu khe+u ཿsarba thā khaṃ urta te hra ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛrtswa dam ba li ta swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul la/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra a0ཾ pra tībra swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po gzhan yang rung*// sa 'di bdag gis bslang bgyis na// dkyil 'khor ched du stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ rjes su gnang zhing 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par dmigs la mchod gtor bsdu zhing gshegs su gsol/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wā raṃ sogs chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ spos dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dus gsum 'byung ba'i mgon po rnams// bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol// mgon po rgyal ba sras mchod cing*// slob ma rnams la sman slad du// dpal ldan rdo rje he ru ka'i// dkyil 'khor dam pa bri 'tshal bas// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis// bdag la byin rlabs mchog gnang mdzod// ces lan gsum du gsol ba gtab cing*/

dur khrod pa rnams kyi gtor ma bsangs sbyangs bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ da sha diklo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra a0ཾ pra tībra swā hā/ de bzhin du pā sngaṃ sogs nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ 'gron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po sogs dang*/ oṃ kha kha sogs gsum gyis dbul/ lha'i tshogs rnams zhes pa nas/ 'dod don gsol ba yan gyi rjes su/ khams gsum gnas pa'i lha dang klu// gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// gang dag rdzu 'phrul cher ldan zhing*// 'byung po bstan pa la dga' ba// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan don du// sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du// dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba// ji ltar bsams pa'i las byed na// khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod// de ltar khyed la bdag gis ni// don rnams gsol gyis mi bslu bar// rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma dang*// legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ ye shes pa rnams basmra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gnas su'ā ta gabras gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ gang du brtag pa dgos pa'i gnas yin na/ rgyas par ni/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i dka' 'grel pasga can dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i dkyil chog dang*/ bsdus par ni pra smya༄༅ rak+ṣi tas sbyar ba'i dkyil chog las bshad pa ltar/ lto 'phye brtag pa'i cho ga sogs byas la sa brko zhing bslangs nas/ sa'i skyon lnga bsal cing stegs bu bcos/ nyes pa mi bskyed pa'i thabs bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gang du 'di ltar bya mi dgos pa'i sa ni/ khang bzang rdo leb gzhi dang ni// gtsug lag khang ngam zhabs kyis bcags// ba glang lhas sam rgya mtsho'i 'gram// der ni brko sogs bya mi dgos// lag pa sa la bzhag nas su// rang gi snying po brgyad rtsa brgyad// ces pa ltar/

slob dpon he ru ka'i chas dang ldan pas de'i nga rgyal gyis/ sa gzhi'i dbus su sems skyil gyis 'dug la/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la reg cing*/ yi ge bdun pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzla zhing*/ oṃ'u khaṃ/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rdo rje nang bsdams brkyang ste sar bzhag la/ oṃ mai di nī basmri' wa basmrā bla hūm̐/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ dril bu 'khrol bzhin du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsgom mo// bzhi pa ni/ stegs bu'i dbus su 'dug la mchod gtor rnams bsham zhing*/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bsgoms la/ spos phor ram reng bu dang bcas pa thogs te/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur// ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni che ge rdo rje 'dzin// 'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal// dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsol// ces snyan gsan phab nas/ sgo'i slob dpon nam/ slob ma rnams kyis phyogs so sor gnas pa'i mdun du/ mahal dang mchod pa bshams la shar nas/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga zhal cig phyag gnyis zhes pa nas/ ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ snying ga'i sa bon las zhes sogs/ pi wang ma la sogs pa bzhis mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur bstan gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag med dbang phyug sku dang dbyer med cing*// bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rgyal ba sras bcas la sogs sprin 'phro ba'i// rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod mahal bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa'i don du dbul bar byas la/

de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes phyag dang bcas te bskul/ de bzhin du byang nas/ rang nyid lā ma zhes dang*/ hā gle la sogs lha mo bzhis mchod cing bstod la mahal phul te/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes dang nub nas/ rang nyid dum skyes ma dmar mo sogs/ pukhye la sogs bzhis mchod cing bstod la mahal phul te/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes dang*/ lho nas/ rang nyid gzugs can ma ser mo sogs/ rū pa basmri sogs bzhis mchod cing bstod la mahal phul ste/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes phyag dang bcas te slob dpon bskul bar bya'o// slob dpon gyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo brkyang ste rtse sprad pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ basmro ngispa/ bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces shar du phyogs pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ oṃ satsa ta thā ga ta pā da babla nam ka ro mi/ zhes sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal bar mos/ rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum mnga' ba/ khro gnyer bsdus shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i phreng ba dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgyas rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa'i mig g.yas ma las nyi ma/ g.yon ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po khro bo'i tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje 'od zer dang ldan pas mtshan par gyur/ rdo rje'i lta bas g.yon skor du bltas la/ bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can// rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid bdag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas rgyal po che// bdag ni stobs chen rdo rje can// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal po bdag /nga ni phyag na rdo rje brtan// zhes bsgyings pa dang bcas pa'i pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu bsil te/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dbang ldan du song la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// sangs rgyas deng du bdag la gson// nga ni dpal ldan he ru kaḥ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor gyis// lha klu lha min gsang ba pa// brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs// sa 'dir ma gnas gzhan du dengs// gal te bdag bsgo las 'das na// rdo rje khro bo bzhin 'bar ba'i// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// zhes dang*/ sumā ni lan gsum brjod cing sa gzhi la yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ g.yas su bskaur ba lan gsum bya zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod/ me nas g.yon du'ang bskor ba bya ste/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang*/ rtse gsum pa dang*/ rtse lnga pa dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'gros bya zhing*/ shar lho nub byang rnams su g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang dang*/ zlum po dang*/ so ga rnams kyi 'gros dang*/ phag mo'i nga rgyal gyi khro mo'i stangs stabs de bzhin byas pas/ stangs stabs rkyang par 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan yang mnyam pa'i stabs dang mi mnyam stabs// rus sbas bung ba'i phur sogs brgyad// rdo rje'i 'gros kyis kun nas bskor// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bskrad par bya// zhes bshad pa ltar spro na bya zhing*/

ma grub kyang skyon med de/ bgegs bskrad pa ni bskor ba la sogs pas 'grub bo// zhes bzhed pas so// de nas slob dpon dbus su gnas pas/ seng ldeng ngam/ lcags sam/ mi rus las byas pa'i phur bu srid du sor brgyad/ sboms su sor phyed dang gsum pa nyid dam/ sor bcu gnyis dang sor bzhi'i tshad can bcu/ yungs dkar gyi phye ma dang*/ tsan dan dmar po la sogs pa'i dris byug tshon skud sna lnga'am/ dar dmar po'am/ me tog gi phreng ba btags shing phyogs mtshams mi 'chol ba'i yi ges spras pa rnams snod gsar pa 'brus bskang ba'i steng du bkod la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phur bu rnams mi dmigs pa las/ dum skyes ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag 'dzin zhing*/ sked pa man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can du gsal bar gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ basmra a0ཾ sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lhas dbang bskur bas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ suṃ' ni sogs phyogs bzhi'i sngags las grub pa'i kha gdong ma zhes pa nas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa bkug nas/ phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar nub kyi mdun rgyab tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i khron pa zab mo bcu'i nang du bcug pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khro mo rnams la bka' bsgos zhes pa nas/ phur bus btab par gyur/ rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje tho bar gyur/ ces dmigs pas gzung zhing*/ g.yon phur bu thogs la/ oṃ lnga lnga sogs pas gdab cing*/ murnga ra'i sngags kyis brdung ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol lam/ stegs bu'i mthar phyogs g.yon skor dang*/

dbang ldan nas mtshams g.yas skor du gdab cing*/ steng 'og gi shar nub kyi mdun rgyab tu gdab par bya'o// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen po'i de bzhin nyid du rang bzhin gcig par gyur/ ces bsgom/ lnga pa ni/ āḥlas byung ba'i sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ rdo rje'i ra ba steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can sogs/ sngags kyi byin rlabs yan gyis bsrung bar bya'o// gnyis pa sta gon la'ang*/ sa lha lha dang bum pa dang*// slob ma thig tshon lhag gnas lnga'o// dang po ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i gzhi der dri'i mahal zlum po me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa mthar mchod pas bskor zhing*/ gtor ma'ang bsham/ sgrub po rnams lho nas byang du phyogs pas 'dug la/ lag pa g.yas su zla ba la hūm̐ gsum gyis mtshan pa sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas sa la lan gsum bsnun pa'i sgra dang*/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bskul bas ye shes pa dang tshul gcig tu gyur pa'i baṃ las sa'i lha mo gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan zhing*/ ral pa'i thor tshugs 'chang ba/ na bza' dkar po dang rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ g.yon pas gser gyi bum pa dang*/ g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ pasga dkar po la gnas pa/ bdag gi bka' nod bzhin pas 'khod par gyur pa la/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pā ri wā ra a0ཾ pra tībra swā hās mchod yon dang*/ a0ཾ gyi gnas su pā sngaṃ dang*/ nyer spyod rol mo'i sngags bcug la mchod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te+u+o ཿsogs gsum gyis gtor ma phul te/ spos snod rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya sesbe yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/

lan du lha mos/ mgon po khyod kyis shes mod kyi// bsod nams phung po dri med pa// de ni khyod nyid la gzhol cing*// kun nas khyod kyi dbang du gnas// khyod kyi bka' ni gang stsol ba// de ni bdag gis bgyid la brtson// zhes gnang ba byin te gzhi de nyid du thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la rdo rje bsdams pa sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ basmri' wa hūm̐/ gsum brjod/ rdo rje bcing ba las/ hūm̐ yig 'bar ba'i tshogs spros nas sa 'og gi bar rdo rje byas/ oṃ basmra ḍi sda tispa zhes gsum gyis brtan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa gzhir dri'i chus phye ma med par byugs shing*/ lha'i gnas mi 'chol ba'i phyir/ skya thig dang gsher thig gdab ste/ ji skad du/ ji ltar mos pa'i tshangs thig gdab// de yi dbus dang g.yas g.yon du// mtshan ma byas la phyogs gnyis su// bya rjes btsal te gnyis pa dang*// phyed tshad gnyis kyis mtshams bzhi ru// rgya gram dbus su zur thig bya// de steng rtsa ba'i thig btab pa'i// 'khor lo'i brgyad cha sgo tshad de// de yi bzhi cha cha chung ngo*// rtsa ba'i phyi rol gcig dang gnyis// gcig gnyis gcig dang gcig gi mthar// thig drug zur nas ngos su ste// dang po dang ni gnyis pa'i steng*// tshangs las rim gyis ring bar ni// cha chung gsum mthar son pa yi// gnyis thig cha chung gnyis rtser reg /stegs bu mda' yab thig dag las// drug bdun brgyad dor thig gsum gdab// 'dod snam mtha' nas cha bran lnga// dor bar gyen du cha chung bzhi// de yi rtse nas ngos su thig /cha chung bcu dang ldan pa'o// rtsa ba'i rtse nas byung ba'i thig /cha chung bzhi pa ngos stengs su// cha phran gnyis gnyis thad kar ni// cha chung brgyad de gsum 'khyog pa// ka ba'i rtse mor sgo tshad gsum// gzhal la cha mnyam brgyad bgos pa'i// gsum pa bdun pa'i phyi nas dang*// lnga pa'i nang mthar sum cha bcad// shar bu rin chen rta mig ser// chu srin gser dang rmig pa dang*// rin chen rmig pa gser mda' yab// de rnams so so'i rgya yi tshad// tshangs pa'i g.yas g.yon cha chung ni// phyed dang drug dor phyed gsum gyi// snam bu'i thig ni phyed dang bzhi// gnyis pa gsum pa cha chung drug

/dor nas cha chung gsum mthar thig /bzhi pa cha chung bzhi dor lnga// lnga pa cha chung phyed dang bzhi// dor bar cha chung phyed dang lnga// drug pa gsum der cha chung lnga// de steng bdun brgyad dgu bcu rnams// tshangs thig g.yas g.yon cha chung bdun// cha chung lnga ni bcu gcig pa'o// snam bu gnyis pa'i nang thig gi /tshangs steng cha bran lnga gzung ste// bzhi pa'i phyi thig la reg dang*// gnyis pa'i tshangs las snam bu'i dbus// cha bran bzhi nas cha gnyis kyis// gong gi zlum thig rtser gzung ste// g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba ni// thig gcig skyogs po gsum ldan 'gyur// de nang cha chung phyed de bzhin// de steng gcig dang gnyis dang gcig /pasga chos 'khor rwa rtse'o// rwa yi rtsa bar sgo tshad de// cha bran gnyis ni rtse mo'i khyon// snam bu lnga pa'i tshangs dbus nas// cha phran gnyis ni dor ba dang*// drug pa'i nang nas phyed dang lngar// ka rgyan rtse nas rim pa ltar// bskor ba rdo rje'i rwa yin no// rwa rtse'i mtha' mar cha phran ni// gnyis gnyis dor bas pasga dang*// rdo rje'i phreng ba byas pa'i mthar// cha chen re re me ri dang*// dur khrod kyi ni sa gzhi'o// rtsa thig nang du cha phran gnyis// dor ba sgo yi khyams yin te// nang du mu khyud cha phran gcig /'dab ma la ni cha chen gnyis// pasga'i lte bar cha chen te// de yi phyi rol ge sar ni// cha phran gcig nas zlum por bskor// de ltar thig ni legs btab bo// 'di nas bdud rtsi dri bzang sbyar bas kha shar du phyogs te/ gtso bo'i gnas su gru bzhi dang*/ lha gnas gzhan rnams zlum por byug cing*/ so so'i sngags brjod/ me tog gi tshom bu phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams g.yas skor du dgod/ de'i mtha' mchod pas bskor ba/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa nas/ mdun bskyed ltar cho ga gsum gyis lha bskyed/

ye shes pa spyan drangs zhing rgyas gdab/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba'i rjes su/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ spos dang rdo rje dril bu thogs la/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag kun dngos bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// phag mor lhan cig yang dag gnas// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag che ge zhes// nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// nye ba ru ni mdzad par rigs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slar yang chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ sngar gyi sngags rgyas/ sta gon gyi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod/ gsum pa ni/ bum bskyed cho ga gzhung ltar skabs 'dir grub rjes su 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar btang zhing*/ phyi rol mchod pa'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar nye reg byas nas dril bu 'khrol bzhin/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod la/ las bum gyi chu cung zad bsang gtor du bcug la bzhag go /bzhi pa ni ji skad du/ mkhas pa'i slob ma gcig dag gam// gsum mam yang na lnga 'am ni// bdun nam nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar// zung du ma them yongs su bzung*// zhes grangs nges pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ mdor na slob ma phan tshun du// nang mi gshin pa mi gzung ngo*// zhes pa ltar sel med pa'i snod ldan brtags te/ sngon du ma thob na dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la bkod pa mdun du 'khod pa la/ sbyang dang bsam pa dag pa la 'god cing*/

mahal gsol gdab nang dbang bur bya ba// tshogs bsag sdom bzung byin rlabs mchod pa dang*// so shing srung skud khyor chu chos bshad cing*// ku sha byin la ltas brtags bar chad bsrung*// zhes pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ sbyang chas rnams bshams la/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs a kā ros byin gyis brlabs la/ na maḥsarbā ta thā ga te'i sngags kyis slob ma la g.yas dang g.yon du bskor la bsog snod du blug de bzhin du chang bu dang mar me zung re lag pa gnyis kyis so sor gzung la g.yas g.yon bskor la gong gi snod du blug cing*/ sumā ni'i sngags bzla/ yungs kar gyis brab rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas phyi rol du dor ba ni/ zhi ba dang*/ drag po'i sbyang ba zhes pa'i bgegs sbyang ba zhes bya'o// de nas g.yas su me dang*/ g.yon du chu dbus su til bkod de/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsal ba zhal gdangs pa'i ljags la raṃ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes dmigs shing*/ rkang zhabs rlung gis lte ba'i me sbar/ des snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag por sdig sgrib thams cad bsdus nas sdig par gyur pa gdungs te/ sna nas thon til la thim par bsgom du gzhug la/ mtheb srin gyis til blangs te/ oṃ basmra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha nā smiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis dbul la/ mchod cing bstod de nongs pa bshags shing*/ mthar me yang chur dor la las bum gyi chus de'i sngags bzla zhing*/ khrus bya ba ni/ sdig pa sbyang ba zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// 'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed// de las gzhan pa'i dngos grub 'dod// gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i// dad pa mang du byed pa yi// blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya// tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la// 'jig rten pha rol don mi 'byung*// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu rab tu rgyas// zhes bsam pa dag pa la dgod cing*/

gsum pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la sngon 'gro slob ma sta gon zhu ba'i don du mahal phul la/ bzhi pa/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// ces rjes bzlos lan gsum bya zhing gsol ba btab bo// lnga pa ni/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis slob ma la reg pas 'od du zhu ba drangs te zhal du bzhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pasgar babs pa he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems/ rdo rje'i lam nas thon/ yum gyi pasgar gnas pa'i lha la dbang bskur te/ phyir phyung slob dpon gyi mdun du 'khod pa la/ slob ma'i gtso bo gcig la dmigs te/ slob dpon gyis/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten mthun pa gshegs nas su// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gy-is shig

/ces brjod/ drug pa ni/ slob ma rnams kyis thal mo sbyar zhing lnga rnam dag bya ba ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las gyur pa'i// zhes pa nas/ rnam dag bsam yas yang dag brtan par bgyis// zhes ba'i bar rjes zlos lan gsum bya'o// bdun pa ni/ skabs 'dir u ka ra dang*/ rga los dge bsnyen la sogs pa'i sdom pa blang zhing*/ sdom ldan la sdom pa gong ma bskyar ba'i phyag len 'dug pa ni/ lam log pa las khyad par du gyur pa so sor thar pa ris bdun gang rung dang*/ lam dman pa las khyad par du gyur pa smon 'jug gi sdom pa thob pa/ lam ma rdzogs pa las khyad par du gyur pa sngags sdom 'dzin pa gsum las/ dang po gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs pa'i slob ma la sngags sdom 'dzin du 'jug pa'i phyir slob mas/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pasga'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/

de yang gong du so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gang rung gis rgyud sbyangs pa gzhir bcas kyang*/ byang sems dang sngags sdom gnyis 'dzin par mi 'dod na/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur ba'i snod du mi rung la/ phyi ma 'dzin par mi nus na/ slob dpon gyi dbang yan chad bskur mi rung bar gsungs pas/ slob ma la brda legs par 'phrod par bya'o// brgyad pa ni/ slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yas khu tshur las srin lag dri bzang po'i chus brlan pas/ slob ma'i gnas rnams su thig le bya zhing*/ snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par pasga'i ze'u 'brur āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ dkar pos mtshan par bsgom/ dgu pa ni/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du gsol ba la/ oṃ basmra pukhyaṃ pra tībra swā hā/ zhes sogs nyer spyod lngas spyi bor me tog spos dang mar me zhal zas mdun/ dri snying ga rnams su dbul cing mchod nas/ bcu pa ni/ 'o ma can gyi shing sogs srin bus ma zos shing*/ bu ga dang 'dzer pa med pa drang ba tshad sor bcu gnyis dang ldan pa dri bzang gi chus byug srad bu dmar pos bcings pa'i me tog gis rtse mor brgyan pa las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pa/ slob ma'i snyim par gtad de/ shar ram/ byang du blta ba'i mdun du/ ba lci 'am/ dris byug pa'i mahal khru gang gru bzhi par/ phyogs mtshams mi 'chol ba'i tshom bu bkod pa la/ oṃ basmra hā sa ha/ zhes brjod nas rtse mo gcig shos cung zad 'chos te ltos pa med par dor ro// de'i mtshan ma ni/ slob dpon dang bdag la bstan na mchog gi dngos grub thob/ gyen dang mthur du bstan na mkha' spyod dang sa spyod/ phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyi dngos grub bam/ shar byang nub lho bzhir rim pas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dngos grub 'grub cing*/ phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub med par rtogs par bya'o// bcu gcig pa ni/

slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i skud pa dmar po'am/ dmar ser du kha bsgyur ba gsum ltab tu byas pa/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i srad bur mos la/ dum skyes ma'i sngags lan bdun bzlas pa mdud pa gsum ldan/ bud med dang skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yas g.yon du bcing zhing*/ oṃ bulka mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ las bum gyi chu rdo rje dang bcas pas kyang reg cing*/ khaha ro hes bsrung ngo*// bcu gnyis pa ni/ baṃ las skyes pa'i dung gi chur gyur par dmigs shing*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shulkaḥsarba sdarmaḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsā gla sho sda༄༅ ya sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum 'thung du zhugs pas slob ma'i sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs par mos/ bcu gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan 'da' bar byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa byas par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros brtan zhing mi g.yo ba// de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa'i 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su gzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rab byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes pa'i don dkrol nas zab rgyas kyi chos bshad/

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsrung bar bya'o// bcu bzhi pa ni/ ku sha rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa mang ba hūm̐ dang*/ nyung ba sda༄༅ིཿlas byung ba'i chun por dmigs shing*/ sa bon gnyis lan bdun bdun dang*/ khaha ro he bzlas pa/ stan dang sngas kyi don du/ oṃ basmra tisbra baṃ/ zhes byin la/ do nub rmi lam dge ba'am// mi dge ba gang byung yang nangs par nga la smros shig ces bsgos te/ slob ma rnams rang rang gi gnas su/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor pa la mos pa rtse gcig pas/ seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis ku sha'i sngas gdan dang bcas nyal du gzhug cing*/ 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis rang nyid bsrung ngo*// bco lnga pa ni/ de nas snga bar langs te/ slob ma'i rmi lam dris la/ ltas bzang dge bar mthong na spro ba bskyed cing*/ ri las lhung ba la sogs pa'i mi dge ba dang*/ slob dpon la mtshan ltas ngan pa dag mthong na/ bcu drug pa ni/ zhing skyong dang mkha' 'gro thams cad la mchod gtor dbul la gsol ba gdab/ zhi ba'i sreg blugs 'bul zhing bgegs zhi ba'i cho ga gzhan yang ci 'grub la 'bad par bya'o// lnga pa thig mtshon lhag gnas la'ang gnyis te/ thig gdab pa dang*/ tshon dkye ba'o// dang po ni/ dar ram ras kyi srad bu gzhon nu ma ma nyams pas bkal ba kha dog lnga pa snyoms shing grims pa/ mdud pa'i skyon dang bral ba srid du dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur/ sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha 'byung ba dang*/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i lag g.yon gyi mdzub mo'i steng du/ sor mo'i rtse nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar ser dmar ljang nag po rnams rim pa bzhin bkod pa mthe bos mnan/ lhag ma sor mo rnams la dkris te/ slob dpon nub nas shar dang*/ slob ma shar nas nub tu gnas pa'i bar du brkyang la/ thig skud kyi nang gi mtha' gnyis dang dbus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes dang*/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thig skud rnams bum aṃ hrīḥkhaṃ hūm̐ las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs lnga'i he ru ka'i rnam par gyur/

nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rang rang gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'dus pa rigs lngar gsal ba'i thugs kar buṃ aṃ hrīḥkhaṃ hūm̐ las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin ye shes kyi thig skud gsal bar gyur/ oṃ āḥshā shwa ta basmra su traṃ me pra yabra ma hā mahal la ṇa yaṃ hūm̐ zhes dang*/ shā shwa ta'i gnas su ratha saṃ' wa a mi tā'*/ a mo lnga silki/ ak+ṣo+u zhes bcug nas gsol ba btab la/ mig gnyis dza las skyes pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kha dog ser po 'od 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ dīkwa dṛsnga aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes pa brjod cing mig shin tu myur bar g.yo ba'i rdzi ma 'degs pa/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bus/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa bskul te so so'i thugs ka'i ye shes kyi thig skud spyan drangs/ rang gi lag par gnas pa'i srad bu la thim par gyur/ dang por lnga tshan lnga so so dang*/ rjes su lnga tshan lnga gcig tu bsgril cing*/ oṃ a sbyo sbya a nu ga tā sarba sdarmaḥpa ra hra ra a nu pra wisnga sarba sdarmaḥ.asngatra a nu pra wisnga sarba sdarmaḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ ye thig de nyid slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi khar pasga'i snod la sogs par bzhag pa la/ yab yum gyi snying po dang yi ge gsum bzlas la me tog dang spos dang mar me dang dris mchod/ lag pa mnan nas khaha ro he'i sngags kyis bsrungs la/ mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi zla 'od 'bar bar gyur/ basmra dṛsngi ma ṭas brtan par bya/ slar yang khaha ro hes bsngags pa'i bdud rtsis bran la rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas reg ste/ oṃ basmra sa ma ya sogs kyi sngags yi ge gsum dang lhan cig brgya rtsa bzlas pas lhag gnas bya/ oṃ sarbā saṃ sho sda ni hūm̐ phaṭ ces brjod cing*/ sgo'i rtsa thig ma gtogs dbye bar 'os pa phyis nas/ dkyil 'khor la bsang gtor bya zhing*/ g.yas skor du dris byug me tog sil mar bkram la/

nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar gyur pa la/ oṃ basmra wī ṇe sogs kyis mchod/ rang nyid lhan skyes dang slob ma dum skyes mar gsal bar gyur/ slob dpon gyis ye thig sngar ltar gzung ba'i sne slob ma'i lag tu gtad cing*/ dzaḥzhes dang*/ des kyang dzaḥzhes brjod cing drangs te/ lte ba'i thad du gzung la/ sngar bzhin gnas pas slob dpon gyis g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb mdzub bam/ mtheb srin gyis thig skud gzung zhing*/ oṃ basmra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐ hūm̐ swā a hā/ ma lus 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i// sangs rgyas la sogs khyed rnams kyis// 'gro don mdzad pa'i dus yin zhes// thig skud sgras ni bskul ba'o// zhes slob dpon g.yon skyil krung phyed pa dang*/ g.yas rkang mthil sa la btsugs te 'dug cing*/ slob ma de las bzlog pas tshangs thig dang po'i steng du me ri'i bar brkyang ste thig gdab bo// de bzhin du lho byang du 'khod nas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab pa phyogs g.yon skor yin la/ me rlung nas zur thig dang po/ srin po dang dbang ldan nas gnyis pa mda' thig gi bar ro// slob dpon me nas byang lta dang*/ slob ma dbang ldan nas lhor phyogs pa'i shar gyi rtsa thig de bzhin du rlung nas lhor lta bas nub/ de nyid nas shar du lta bas byang*/ me nas nub tu lta bas lho'i rtsa thig rnams g.yas su bskor zhing gdab ste/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos pa ni kun la shes dgos so// thams cad du rgyab kyis 'gro bas bskor ba sogs kun la shes par bya'o// de'i tshe mtshan ma yang*/ chad pas slob dpon 'chi 'gyur zhing*// ring thung khyer na nad kyis 'debs// phyogs 'khrugs slob ma nyon mongs 'gyur// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// rab tu sgrim ste gdab par bya// zhes so// tshangs thig gi logs gnyis nas cha chung gnyis gnyis te/ cha chung bzhi po/

thar pa'i sgo yi gegs su gyur pa'i bdud bsal bar bya'o// zhes mos la/ hi haṃ las byung ba'i mig gnyis nyi ma dang zla bar gyur/ zhes khro bo'i lta stangs dang bcas te/ hī hī brjod cing sgo yi rtsa thig dang bcas pa dbye'o// zlum thig bskor ba'i tshe/ lte bar seng ldeng gi phur bu/ steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa la 'og rdo rje rtse gcig pa hūm̐ las skyes par bltas la/ oṃ lnga lnga sogs phur gdab kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla zhing*/ murnga ra'i sngags kyis brdungs pa de la ye thig nyis ldab tu dkris te bskor ba pasga can las bshad do// de nas oṃ basmra pukhye pra tībra swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ basmra muḥ ye shes kyi thig skud nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs kar zhugs shing*/ sa la btab pa'i ye thig nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ oṃ basmra be ga kra ma hūm̐/ zhes bteg gnyis pa ni/ rdul mtshon mi'i rus pa'i phye ma bsres pa'i rin po che'am 'bras sam sa'i khams las byung ba dag kha dog so sor mtshon gyis bsgyur/ snod so sor hūm̐ yig bris pa dbus su nag po/ phyogs bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang dgod/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdul tshon rnams/ baṃ maṃ raṃ haṃ yaṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i he ru ka'i rnam par gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/ gong gi sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi rang bzhin ye shes kyi rdul mtshon gsal bar gyur/ mig gnyis dzaḥlas sogs/ so so'i thugs ka'i ye shes kyi rdul mtshon spyan drangs/ rdul mtshon so so la thim par gyur/ oṃ basmra tsi tra sa mā ya hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ slar yang mig gnyis dzaḥzhes pa nas asngu sha dzaḥ zhes 'bar ba'i blta bas gzi brjid bskyed cing*/ rdul mtshon so sor hūm̐ yig re re gsal bar gyur par bltas la/ bden pa gang gis rdul mtshon mang zhing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang sems dpa' rnams sems can la rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul mtshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig

ces bden pa bskul nas/ dbus su phur bu btab yod na hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bton te/ phur bu rang gi lag gi rdo rje la thim par mos la phur khung tshon sna lngas dgang*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi mtheb mdzub kyis dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du/ rtsig pa phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga rnams sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad ldan 'then zhing*/ 'di ni me long dag pa ste// sems can khams ni sgrol byed pa// dpal ldan bde chen rgyal po ste// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// 'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas// zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ mnyam nyid= sor rtog= bya grub= chos dbyings zhes sbyar/ de yang*/ drang zhing mtho ba snyoms pa dang*// nas gang gis ni ma reg par// ri mo kun gyis bri bar bya// zhes so// de las bzlog pa'i skyon ni// sbom pos nad bskyed phra bas ni// nor rnams rab tu brlag par byed// 'dres pa yis ni rims 'byung zhing*// yo bas rnam 'gras chad pa yis// slob dpon dang ni slob ma dag /'chi ba ru ni shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar sbrel ran pa dang tshon pra brtag de nas slob dpon nam ri mo mkhan la sogs pas tshon dkye ba ni/ dbus kyi pasga'i lte ba ljang khu'am/ nyi dkyil mtshon pa dmar po/ ge sar ser/ 'dab ma'i phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ mu khyud la gri gug sngon po'i phreng ba/ lte bar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa dang*/ rdo rje gri gug dmar po/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la gri gug bzhi phyogs mdog mtshams su bum pa'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re bri ba'am/ sa bon nam/ so so'i kha don can gyi lha mtshan kyang rung ngo*// khyams kyi shar dkar sngo gang rung*/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba la/ sgo'i g.yas g.yon du bum pa gnyis gnyis bri bar slob dpon ratha rak+ṣi ta sogs bzhed do// 'dod snam dmar po'i phyogs su lha mo bzhi bzhi/

sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rje/ pha gu ser po la rin po che bkra ba/ dra ba'i gzhi nag po la gser gyi ska rags las 'phyang ba'i dra ba dang dra phyed pa la sogs 'phyang ba/ ba ku lī gzhi sngon po la ril ba mgo thur stan lta bu dkar po/ mda' yab dkar por tshon nag pos pad 'dab phyed pa'i dbyibs/ logs rnams su ba dan zur bzhir gdugs/ sgo'i mun pa nag po/ ka ba dang rta babs kyi glang rgyab/ rwa rtse dang glo'i rwa rnams phyogs mdog ka rgyan dang chu srin ji ltar mdzes pa/ gser ser/ shar bu ba ku lī lta bu/ rin chen dmar po/ rta mig ljang khu la de'i dbyibs kyi ri mo/ mda' yab kyang gong bzhin la/ de'i steng gi pasga sna tshogs/ 'khor lo dang ri dwags ser/ sna tshogs pasga'i lte ba ljang*/ ge sar ser/ 'dab ma sna tshogs su spel ba'i gzhi dkar dmar/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum bzang las thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing sogs sgrub thabs las bshad pa ltar bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad dang*/ rgyal srid rin po che bdun la sogs pas phyug par bri/ rdo rje rwa ba'i gzhi ser po la rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba'am/ yang na sna tshogs pasga'i gzhi ri rab mtshon pas/ shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser ba/ lte ba dang 'dab ma'i bar gyi re kha ge sar mtshon pas ser po/ pad ra dang rdor phreng gi bar gyi re kha ni rdo rje'i 'khor yug gi khongs su gtogs par phreng ba las gsungs pas/ shar mthing*/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang bar bri zhing*/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang gzhi yang de bzhin du bri bar bzhed pa 'dug pa yang ji ltar mdzes pa bgyir rung ngam sems so// me ri kha dog lnga ldan du bya zhing*/ de dang rdo rwa'i bar gyi re kha dkar po'am nag po/ dur khrod kyi gzhi nag po la ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan ma rnams bri zhing*/ me ri'i rtser re kha mi bya ste/ 'od zer 'phro ba tshad med pa'i phyir ro zhes bla ma gong ma dag gsung ngo*// de nas rdo rje dril bu bcas te dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum bya zhing*/

yi ge brgya pa brjod de/ lhag chad brtag cing skyon bsal la/ las sngags dang hūm̐ brjod cing dri bzang gi chu bdud rtsi dang sbyar bas dur khrod kyi mtha' khyab par byug rdul tshon lhag ma nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gshegs gsol gyi sngags dang*/ ye shes kyi rdul tshon nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs kar bzhugs par gyur zhes brjod/ rgyan dgod pa ni/ rgyal ba'i bum pa dang*/ las thams cad pa shar sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas/ bum pa gzhan yod na sgo yi phyogs so sor bkod pa'am/ dur khrod kyi phyi rol gyi sgo'i thad rang rang gi phyogs su bzhag go /zhes pasga can las bshad pa ltar gang bde bya zhing*/ bla bre dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rnga yab la sogs pa hūm̐ gis bsngags te/ oṃ basmra hra ra ṇa khaṃ zhes dbul/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar ji ltar 'byor ba'i mchod pa mdzes par bsham zhing*/ sngon 'gro dang nang gtor phyi rol gyi gtor ma sogs kyang tshogs par bya'o// //gsum pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ sgo yi slob dpon yon na phyogs so so dang*/ med na rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'khod pa'i mdun du nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad 'du byas shing*/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa nas bzlas pa dang thun bsdus pa yan sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor khaha ro hes bsangs/ shū sbya༄༅ tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ dkar la dmar ba' mdangs can 'phros pas sna bub g.yas nas thon/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas pa hūm̐ rdo rje sems pa'i rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ thod pa dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur gyi bar gyis/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sa chog dang*/ lha sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa'i dbye bas rnam pa bzhi po rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang ro gcig tu gyur/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ phem gyis bskul cing ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dbang gi lha dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ pi wang ma la sogs pas mchod cing*/ yi ge bzhi pa dkyil 'khor drug po ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ yo ga shulkaḥsogs kyis nga rgyal gzung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha sogs go cha gnyis bkod/ ye shes padang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dab gi lha la sngar bzhin mchod cing*/ dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas btab la dbang gi lha rnams lha so so la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams mchod phreng ltar dbul cing*/ bstod pa'i rjes su gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ 'khor gyi sngags ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ sgrub mchod nar ma lta bu yin na/ bum bskyed dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma btang nas mgron bsdu ba'i bar bya'o// de nas sgrub pa'i grogs dkyil 'khor srung du bcug dpon slob gzhan rnams phyi rol tu song ste/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa bsham/ bsang sbyang nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ igla zhes pa nas yu khe'i bar gyis bskul cing*/ sa slang gi skabs ltar mchod/ oṃ kha kha sogs lan gnyis kyi phyogs g.yon bskor dang mtshams g.yas bskor du gtor ma phul la/ 'dod don gsol cing phrin las bcol te/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ basmra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes dmigs la/ tsog pur 'dug pa'i lag pa gnyis pus mo'i nang du son par bya zhing*/ g.yon pas dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i chu'i snod bzung*/ g.yas pa'i thal mo bkan pa'i gung mo dang ming med cung zad bskum pas chu la reg nas/ mi smra bar chu la lan mang du byab cing*/

rna ba'i bu ga gnyis dang*/ mig gnyis dang*/ sna'i bu ga dang*/ lag pa dang*/ lto ba dang*/ mgo bor lan gsum du nye reg byas la/ slob dpon gyis rting mnan nang du 'ongs te/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas rdo rje'i rkang pas bskor zhing*/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing*/ dkrol bzhin pas oṃ su+u ni su+u sogs brjod nas dkyil 'khor la g.yon du bskor ba lan gsum dngos sam yid kyis byas la/ nub kyi sgor gnas pa g.yas brkyang stabs dang*/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bkan pa las mdzub mo brkyang pa bsnol thabs su bzhag pa so sor sbreng zhing*/ sgo phye bar bsams la/ oṃ basmrorta ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes nub nas shar dang*/ lho nas byang dang*/ byang nas lho/ shar nas nub kyi sgo phye bar bsams shing de nyid du gnas bzhin pas me tog gi phreng ba thogs te/ oṃ pa ra ma su khā sha ya su la li ta bi lā sa na mi tai na mā mi' ga wātraṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi hi hi hi pra tībra ku sumazwa li nā tha hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor du dor zhing*/ slar yang 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pas rang gi spyi bor bcings te phyag byas la/ deng sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin mdzod cig /ces gsol ba gdab bo// bzhi pa bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma la dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos so// dang po ni/ khrus byas mahal dri lan gdong g.yogs dang*// me tog gsol gdab rnam lnga sems bskyed cing*// sdom bzung byin brlab gsang gdams phyag bya ba// bye brag nyes dmigs bka' gnyan dam la bzhag /gsal btab byin dbab me tog dkyil 'khor bstan// zhes bya ba rnams las thog mar las bum gyi chus khrus byas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du/ oṃ basmrū mi= sogs mahal phul la/

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'am bla mas/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes 'dri ba la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes bdag nyid dam slob mas lan btab par mos shing*/ gtso bo las spros pa'i las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par gyur/ zhes mos pa'i/ bla mas/ oṃ tsak+ṣurba1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=333gt;<FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=-293gt;1$0000270ha1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-333gt;1$0000270bla wa ra mā na ye hūm̐ gis bdag nyid dam/ slob ma la gdong g.yogs dmar ser gang rung bcing*/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gzung ngam gtad/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pa'am 'debs su gzhug bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag bdag gis bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams gang*// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems pa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar// deng nyid du ni sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol// zhes lan gsum gyis lnga rnam dag bya/

rang nyid dam slob ma he ru kar gsal ba'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur/ ces mos la/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsing un༄༅ da yā mi/ zhes brjod du bcug la sems bskyed de/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya phraṃ hoḥ silki basmra ya thā su khaṃ/ gis brtan par bya'o// sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bgyi bas// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spong ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pasga'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/

rang ngam slob ma'i gnas gsum du srin lag gi rtse mos dri'i chu blangs la thig le bya zhing*/ spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pasga'i steng du āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las/ 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus te yi ge so so la thim par gyur par dmigs te/ spyir gsang bar gdams pa ni/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas spyi bor reg cing*/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing*/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// las kyi rdo rjes hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas khrid de yol ba'i nang du bcug par bsams shing*/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes thal mo spyi mgrin snying gar sbyar zhing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag bya zhing skyabs su song nas/ las kyi rdo rje'am slob dpon gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs te/ sgo'i khyams su gnas pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'am slob dpon gyis rdo rje spyi bor bzung la/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/

dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// thod pa'i bdud rtsi mthe bong ming med sbyar bas myang ngam sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis 'grub// oṃ basmra u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥzhes dang*/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos te/ nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ zhes dam la bzhag nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab la/ rang nyid dam slob ma he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i lte ba'i aṃ las me 'bar bas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang*/ mgrin pa'i oṃ bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ lus thams cad du zag med kyi bde ba skyes par gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ smya༄༅ na a we sha ya a a hrīḥpaṃ/ zhes pa'am/ tispa ma hā kro sda a we sha ya hūm̐/ shrī he ru kā ya bisga he bisnga rā dza ya sdi ma he swā hā/ zhes brjod cing ro ras dang*/ zla tshan gyis gos pa'i 'doms bkris kyi ras/ byi la'i brun/ bdud rtsi lnga dang thang chu/ yi dwags kyi kha nas byung ba'i gu gul rnams bsres la/ dur khrod kyi sol ba'i me la sogs par blug pa'i spos phor/ lag pa g.yas su 'dzin pa'i g.yon dril bu 'khrol ba'am/ las kyi rdo rjes spos 'grims shing*/ bla mas ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i rol mo drag tu dkrol bas/ de'i tshe sku babs na rdo rje'i gar dang*/

nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ gsung babs na sngon med pa'i tshigs su bcad pa smra ba dang*/ thugs babs na dus gsum gyi shes bya shes pa dang*/ sngon med kyi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye'o// gal te ring du 'phar na dbab pa dang*/ dge mi dge'i ltas dri ba sogs gzhan du gsal zhing*/ de la tispa basmra zhes rdo rje mgor bkod de brtan par bya'o// rang ngam/ slob ma la/ khyod kyi mig lam ji ltar snang*/ zhes dri ba la/ dkar ser dmar ljang mthing khrar mthong*/ zhes gang mthong ba'i lan btab pas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams 'grub/ ces gsung bar mos pa'i lung bstan/ rang ngam slob ma'i lag pa'i me tog pra tībra basmra hoḥzhes pa'i sngags kyis ltos pa med par dor ro// de yang lha'i gzugs kyi ni mdzod spu'am dbu'i gtsug tor du phog na mchog gi dngos grub/ spyan nam zhal du sngags kyi dngos grub sogs 'grub par bshad la/ mtshan ma la ni lha dang nye ring gi dngos grub myur bul dang*/ gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang dang nye ba'i rigs su shes la/ rtsig pa'i steng ngam phyi'am/ rdo rje ra ba'i nang du babs na sngags kyi dngos grub phra mo 'thob cing*/ lan gsum bskyar yang rdo rje ra ba'i phyi ru lhung na dngos grub med par shes par bya'o// de'i tshe ming yang gdags te/ gtso bo la babs na/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs can gyi ming gdags pa ni/ mchog gi dang po'i rdo rje/ de bzhin du dpe med/ dga' ba'i/ ro mnyam/ rnam par rgyal ba'i/ a la la/ sems dpa'/ bde ba chen po'i/ yan lag med pa'i/ ye shes lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje zhes pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen rdo rje/ de bzhin du/ yid bzhin nor bu'i nam mkha'/ gzi brjid/ nyi ma'i/ 'od byed/ nga rgyal rdo rje zhes sogs kyi gsang tshan kyang gdags so// sems can stobs can khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu bzung bar gyis// zhes me tog blangs te spyi bor bzhag

oṃ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ basmra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes gdong g.yogs bsal bas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ zhes mos shing*/ slob ma la dkyil 'khor spyi dang bye brag me tog gang la phog pa'i lha sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mdun bskyed ltar bstan par bya'o// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos la bzhi ste/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang*// bzhi pa'i rang bzhin ngo bo ste// de yi rang bzhin de la gnas// zhes gsungs pas/ bum pa'i dbang dang*/ gsang dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang ngo*// dang po la'ang slob ma'i dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis kyi dang po la/ mahal gsol gdab rig dbang sngags dbang dang*// brtul zhugs gnyis dang lung bstan dbugs dbyung ngo*// zhes pa rnams las/ dang po dbang gi dngos gzhi rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i don du sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ sogs mahal dang*/ yul 'khor rta dang glang po la sogs pa phul nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dam slob ma rnam rgyal bum chu/ pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur pa'i mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ lha mo lnga'i phyag na rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod bzhin pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ basmra ī ṣidwa hūm̐/ oṃ ratha ī ṣidwa traṃ/ oṃ pasga ī ṣidwa hrīḥ oṃ karma ī ṣidwa āḥ oṃ bulka ī ṣidwa oṃ/ oṃ basmro da ka ī ṣidwa hūm̐/ su ra ta phraṃ a haṃ/ zhes bum chu spyi bor blug des sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma las rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid dam slob ma la thim pa la/ oṃ basmra pukhyaṃ nas nai wi sngaṃ gyi bar gyis mchod/ de ltar mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi dri ma dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang 'phrin las sgrub pa la dbang ngo*// rang ngam slob ma dbang rdzas con pan khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/

pad nyi'i steng du aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba las byung ba'i cod pan du gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ lha mo lnga'i phyag na rin po che'i dbu rgyan bsnams nas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod bzhin pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste// rin chen kun gyi mchog byed pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba bulka ḍā ki ni basmra wa9 ni ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā mu ku ṭa ī ṣidwa hūm̐/ ces cod pan mgor bcing zhing*/ oṃ basmro da ka ī ṣidwa hūm̐/ su ra ta phraṃ a haṃ/ chu dbang kyang bskur/ des sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma las rigs kyi bdag po rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim pa la/ oṃ basmra pukhye pra tībra sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas/

nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin po che'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// rang ngam slob ma dbang rdzas rdo rje khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du smra༄༅ིཾ las pasga smra༄༅ིཾ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po pasga dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur pa'i 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ lha mo lnga'i phyag na rdo rje bsnams nas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod bzhin pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ basmra ī ṣidwa hūm̐/ zhes snying ga sogs gnas gsum du reg cing*/ lag pa g.yas kyis gsor la/ oṃ basmrod ka ī ṣidwa hūm̐/ su ra ta phraṃ a haṃ/ chu dbang bskur/ des sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma las rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/

dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ basmra pukhyaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ pasga'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang 'phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// rang ngam slob ma dang dril bu khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur/ don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ lha mo lnga'i phyag na dril bu bsnams nas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod bzhin pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lte ba'i thad du 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ basmra a sdi pa ti phraṃ ī ṣidwa mi tispa basmra sa ma ya phraṃ/

oṃ basmrod ka ī ṣidwa hūm̐/ su ra ta phraṃ a haṃ/ chu dbang dang*/ des sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma las rigs kyi bdag po don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim pa la/ oṃ basmra pukhyaṃ pra tībra sogs mchod/ de ltar don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog gi dri ma dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// rang ngam slob ma/ khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du bum las 'khor lo bum gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ lha mo lnga'i phyag na rdo rje dang dril bu mnyam par spyi bor bzung ste ming gi dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod bzhin pas/ rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab bzhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan pas// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ basmra satwa phraṃ ī ṣidwa mi basmra nā ma ī ṣe ka ta/

dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje la'o// oṃ basmrod ka ī ṣidwa hūm̐/ su ra te phraṃ a haṃ/ chu dbang dang*/ des sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma las/ rigs kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim pa la/ oṃ basmra pukhyaṃ pra tībra swā hā/ sogs mchod/ de ltar rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gi dri ma dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang 'phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// rig pa'i dbang de rnams thob pas/ spang bya ma rig pa lnga dag nas/ rig pa'i ye shes lnga 'grub par byed pa yin no// sngags dbang ni/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mthar snying po'i sngags kyis bskor ba las/ sngags 'phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du zhal nas 'thon/ bdag nyid kyi'am slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mthar g.yon skor du 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis lus gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// snying po yi ni yi ge mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa ni// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// oṃ shrī basmra he he ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la su raṃ swā hā/ oṃ basmra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yab yum gyi snying po lan gsum bzla zhing rjes bzlos bya'o// bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes me tog dkyil 'khor ram bla ma la dbul/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes bla ma'am dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gsung bar mos shing*/ me tog spyi bor bzhag de ltar sngags kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas snying po bzla ba la dbang zhing*/

dpal he ru ka'i gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/ dngos grub ma lus pa thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so// rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ pad zla'i gdan la rang ngam slob ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur zhes mos la/ rdo rje bzung la sbyin zhing*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta silki basmra sa ma ya tispa e ṣa phraṃ sda༄༅ ra yā mi hiḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐ḥ zhes snying gar bzung ngo*// spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ rang ngam slob ma dbang rdzas khā*/ཾ ga dang*/ ḍa ma ru dang*/ thod pa sogs oṃ khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang phyag rgya drug la sogs pas brgyan cing g.yas brkyang ba'i gnas pa yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa zhu ba las byung ba'i/ dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur par dmigs te/ g.yas su cang te'u dang*/ g.yon du thod pa gru khug g.yon par khā*/ཾ/ tshangs skud se ral khar byin te/ khā*/ཾ cang te'u lhung bzed dag /dpa' bos byin pa blangs nas ni// he ru ka yi phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// zhes khā*/ཾ ga lha'i sku bde ba chen po/ ḍā ma ru shes rab stong pa nyid/ thod pa de gnyis 'dus pas bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa'i don yin no// zhes don bshad la/ lung bstan pa dang dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'am/ rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pas/ chos gos kyi grwa g.yon pas 'dzin cing*/ g.yas mchod sbyin nam skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya gang rung dang ldan pas/

'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod// rang nyid sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// he ru ka dpal zhes bya ba'i// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no// shrī he ru ka nā ma sarba ta thā ga ta silkiḥs ma ya phraṃ'u rū ba swa/ khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las rnam rgyal zhing*// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// zhes brjod do// ༈ //gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la'ang*/ mahal gsol btab dbang stegs la 'khod cing*// dam tshig gsum sbyin dbang bskur brtan byas la// lha mchod pa dang 'gro don rjes gnang sbyin// dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa'i de nyid bstan// zhes pa rnams las/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i don du sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// sogs mahal phul la/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che// dpa' bo chen po bdag la stsol// 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa// de ni deng 'dir stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab ste/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo dang mi ring bar dbang stegs kyi khri ngos gnyis su seng ge dang*/ dbus su rdo rjes bteg pa'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar/ sna tshogs pasga 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa la/ slob ma rnams phyag rgya lngas brgyan la bzhag pa'i spyi bor gdugs phub cing*/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes pa dang*/ nyer spyod kyi mchod pa yang bshams la/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ oṃ ma hā basmra hūm̐/ zhes lag pa g.yas dang*/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ oṃ basmra lngagra aḥ zhes g.yon du bzung zhing*/ rang ngam slob ma slar yang rdo rje sems dpa'/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba gsal bar gyur/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes dam tshig gsum 'dzin pa dang ldan pa la/

dbang gi lha rnams kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ī ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ btags nas/ dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa la/ khyod kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi slob dpon gyis shig ces gnang ba byin te/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim/ oṃ basmra pukhye pra tībra swā hā sogs kyis mchod/ rang nyid dam slob ma dpal he ru kar gsal ba la/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis// gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// 'dod yon lnga la spyod par gyis// deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis// lus dang srog la mi lta bar// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos// 'gro ba'i don ni dpag med byos// zhes lha mchod pa dang*/ 'gro don gyi rjes gnang byin par mos/ thar pa chen po'i pho brang rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dur khrod rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa 'di rang gi sems kyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ sems nyid kyi rtogs pa'i yon tan mi 'dra ba las/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun du shar ba mtshon pa ni/ sgo dang rgyan la sogs par snang ba dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang*/ sems nyid phung khams skye mched du shar ba'i rang bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa/ de'i gsal snang ma 'gags pa las/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi ste/ lha'i de nyid do// de ltar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes dbang gi nges pa rnyed nas btang rag gi mahal dbul/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs// //gnyis pa gsang dbang gi don du/

sa gzhi spos chus sogs mahal dang*/ gsol btab dbang bskur dag pa brjod pa'o// de yang sin sdu ra la sogs pas byugs pa'i mahal dang*/ sman dang gser la sogs pa khams kyi rin po che ci 'byor ba dbul zhing*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas bla ma mnyes par bya ba'i don du mtshan dang ldan pa'i rig ma phul te/ gur ram yol ba'i phyi rol du gnas par mos shing*/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ gsang ba'i rdzas la/ ngan rtog dgag pa dang*/ 'a ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar oṃ tsak+ṣu' bla sogs gdong g.yog cing dngos sam yid las byung ba'i rig ma rdo rje phag mor gsal ba/ bla ma'am gtso bo la phul bas/ yab yum bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing kha zhes pa nas/ pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi steng na gnas pa shes rab rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha sogs go cha gnyis dang*/ spyi bor 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ yab kyi gsang ba sogs mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi sangs rgyas thams cad zhu ba'i ngo bos dbang bskur bar gyur/ ces mos la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gi gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyis// deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur ro// zhes byang chub kyi sems mtheb srin gyis rdo rje nor bu dang*/ pasga las dbyung zhing btsir nas phyung ba blangs la rang dang slob ma'i lcer bzhag cing*/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod cing btung*/ bla ma yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems/ rdzas gsang ba myangs pas/ lus thams cad du bde ba khyad par can skyes/ gtso bo las spros pa'i lhan skyes yab yum snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam par gyur nas/ mgrin par thim pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags shing*/

bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ting nge 'dzin nyams su myong bar gyur pa'i don la bzhag oṃ basmra pukhyaṃ pra tībra swā hā/ sogs mchod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes mig dar bsal/ de ltar bla ma'am gtso bo yab yum gyi sku la brten nas byang chub kyi sems rdzas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ 'a ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ ngag gi dri ma dag rtsa rlung gi gdams pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes brda' sbyar la/ sa gzhi spos sogs btang rag dbul// ༈ //gsum pa la yang mahal gsol ba btab// shes rab dbang bskur dag pa brjod pa'o// zhes pas mahal dbul zhing phyag byas la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du/ sa gzhi spos sogs dbul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor cig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag bya sgrub pa po// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// ji lta khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang na// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes gsol ba btab/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/ rang ngam slob ma dang*/ shes rab ma dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas shing*/ gzugs dang lang tsho ldan pa'i gdong bcings/ oṃ tsak+ṣu' bla sogs slob dpon nam/ gtso bo'i yum las spros pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rnam pa mi'i bu mo phul du phyung ba'i phyag g.yon pa rang gi'am/ slob ma'i g.yas su gtad de/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// rang nyid dam slob ma lhan cig skyes pa yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i bu ga phaṭ ser pos bkag pa/
