yum gyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las/ a las pasga dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze'u 'bru as mtshan zhing bde ba 'bab pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ rang gi lte bar oṃ basmra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying gar oṃ sarba bulka ḍā ki nī ye basmra wa9 nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mgrin par oṃ shrī basmra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la su raṃ swā hā/ dpral bar oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lha mo'i lte bar oṃ shrī basmra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la su raṃ swā hā/ snying gar oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mgrin par oṃ basmra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dpral bar oṃ sarba bulka ḍā ki nī ye basmra wa9 nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gnas rnams su sngags kyi yi ges mtshan pa/ de ltar rang dang rig ma lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang yig 'bru sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'dis bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du bya ba chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pas/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin pa'i bar dga' ba/ de nas snying ga'i bar du mchog dga'/ de nas lte ba'i bar du khyad dga'/ de nas nor bu'i rtse mor sleb cing 'pho med du bcings pas lhan skyes nyams su myong*/ rlung gi sbyor bas lus thams cad bde bas khyab par gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ gal te khu ba lhung na rang nyid kyis btung bar bshad do// de la oṃ basmra pukhyaṃ pra tībra sogs mchod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gdong g.yogs phye la/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ phyag rgya bsten pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes nges par byas la btang rag gi mahal sa gzhi spos sogs dbul//

༈ //bzhi pa'i don du mahal gsol ba gdab// lha bstim don gzhag ngo sprad dag pa brjod// ces pa las/ sman dang 'bru bzang po la sogs pa'i mahal sa gzhi spos sogs phul nas/ phyag byas te/ khyod zhabs pasga'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/ oṃ tsak+ṣu' bla wa ra ma na ye hūm̐ zhes gdong g.yogs bcing*/ gtso bo las spros pa'i lhan skyes yab yum rang gi smin mtshams nas thim pas/ bde stong zag med kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par gyur/ lus gnad bcas sems ma bcos par mnyam par bzhag ye shes de nyid ngo sprad pa'i phyir/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral thar sbyin zhi ba ste// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pa'i don ni/ dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi nyams myong zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i lhan skyes las 'das pa/ don dam pa'i sems kyi chos nyid sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang ro mnyam pa/ bden pa gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni/ ches phra bas rtogs dka' ba/ mi phyed cing nam mkha' ltar mtha' las 'das pa/ nyon mongs pa'i rdul dang bral ba'i thar pa sbyin pa ste/ de lta bu'i ye shes de bskyed bya skyed byed gnyis su med pa nyid kyis/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ zhes pa'i don du rtogs par bya'o// zhes brda sbyar/ oṃ basmra pukhyaṃ pra tībra sogs mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gdong g.yogs dkrol/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so// de ltar slob dpon rang nyid bdag 'jug blang zhing*/

gtang rag gi mahal sa gzhi spos sogs dbul bar bya'o// ༈ //lnga pa slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir/ bden pa'i byin rlabs bsdus pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid// 'dod mchog dam tshig mchog gyur pa'i// bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor yin// bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// ces dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin nyid la nges par skyes// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ gzhan khrus bya ba nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang*/ dbang dngos gzhi rnams rang dang slob ma'i khyad par gyi/ 'don pa bsgyur zhing mtshams sbyar bas 'grub par 'gyur ro// lag pa mchod cing tshogs kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bya ba ni/ lag pa g.yon pa/ khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ me tog dgod cing*/ stong pa'i ngang las lag mthil pasga 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ mdun nas g.yon skor du haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ zhes dang*/ mthe bong la sogs pa lnga dang*/ sen mo rnams la rim pa bzhin/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭ phaṭ haṃ rnams go cha'i dpa' mo dang dpa' bo'i rang bzhin bol du lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor sor mo me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba'i khams lnga lha mo lngar gsal bar gyur/ so so'i sngags la/ basmra pukhyaṃ pra tībra swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ na mo' ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kalpārdi saṃ ni' ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭo7 ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃ sna༈ ka ra lo grī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha srū dzā ༄༅ su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shosnga༄༅ ta shū la khā*/ཾ ga sda༄༅ ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā ska/ dzi nāṃ wa ra sda rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā sdā mrābla kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yab dang*/ oṃ na mo' ga wa ti basmra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo āwa a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīsnge shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarbā' tā yā wa he ma hā basmre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo basmra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa ljaṃ ka ri ni tru*/ ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro sda ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi prā+e da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzu ni phru ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo basmra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ oṃ baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ haṃ yoṃ= hriṃ moṃ= hriṃ hrīṃ= huṃ hūm̐= phaṭ phaṭ= oṃ ha= na ma hi= swā hā hu= bau ṣa ṭa he= huṃ hūm̐ ho= phaṭ phaṭ haṃ= sha dang zan sbrags pa res kyang mchod cing*/ bdud rtsi'i thigs gtor gyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes lag pa'i lha rnams rang la thim par gyur/ mchod rdzas de rnams tshogs kyi yo byad dang bsres la thabs shes kyi rdzas ji ltar tshogs pa/ stag gi pags pa la sogs pa'i steng du bkod/ oṃ khaha ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir/

hūm̐ oṃ khaṃ aṃ trāṃ dang*/ bāṃ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ sgron ma lngar gyur pa rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rlung gis bskyod/ me sbar zhing bskol bas sa bon dang bcas pa'i rdzas rnams zhu ba/ nyi ma 'char ka lta bu'i kha dog can de'i rlangs pa las grub pa'i dngul chu'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i khā*/ཾ ga kha 'og tu blta ba/ de nyid kyang zhu nas bcud dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī sogs nas/ ha k+ṣaḥ yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ steng nas steng du brtsegs te gnas pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spros/ sems can gyi don byas nas snyoms par zhugs pas yi ge gsum la thim/ yi ge gsum yang dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces byin gyis brlabs la/ tshogs mgron spyan drangs shing byin dbab pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// bcom ldan bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// sprul pa brgyad 'gyed tirti pa// pukhya ha ri'i dgon pa nas// dpal ldan grub chen nā ro pa// gro bo lung gi gnas mchog nas// rje btsun chen po lho brag pa// mthon mthing rgyal mo'i zur phud nas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la'i zhabs// dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa nas// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod nas// 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal// 'bri gung dpal gyi pho brang nas// rgyal ba'i dbang po ratha shrī// dag pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// bcom ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// ma bzhin brtse ba'i mkha' 'gro dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas// bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong rnams// mos gus gdung bas spyan 'dren na// sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs mdzod la// rang bzhin dbyings nas sku bzhengs nas// sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren gshegs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas gshegs nas kyang*// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// sgrub pa po la dngos grub zhu// sa gzhi bkra shis mdzad du gsol// kye/

tshogs khang pho brang gzhal yas 'di// o rgyan gnas su byin gyis rlobs// 'dir tshogs tshogs mgron thams cad kun// dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs// rin chen la sogs sna tshogs snod// pasgā zwar byin gyis rlobs// bcud kyi tshogs 'khor rgya chen 'di// ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// 'bras rgun bu ram bcos pa'i chang*// shes rab ma da na mchod 'di// dbang bzhi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shog /ba la sha lnga 'bras khur dang*// thabs chen maṃ sa'i mchod pa 'di// rtog med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas chos sku thob par shog /dbang po lnga dang bcas pa yi// sna tshogs keng rus mchod pa 'di// bde stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas longs sku thob par shog /byang sems rkang dang khu ba zhag /ga ṇa raca'i longs spyod 'di// gsal stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas sprul sku thob par shog /zho sha la sogs dam tshig rdzas// padwa a mṛ ta mchod 'di// dam tshig bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas bslab gsum don rtogs shog /bu raṃ la sogs mngar gsum dang*// dkar gsum a0'i mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas skye med don rtogs shog /'dod yon phyi nang gsang mchod rnams// rigs lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas 'khor dang myang 'das kyi// yon tan rin chen thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dkar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// bde chen sku ru 'gyur ba'i rdzas// spyad pas rin chen chos sku la// nyams rtogs dbyer med 'brel gyur cig /mnar sems zhe sdang 'khrug pa kun// byams pa chen por 'gyur bar shog /brjod pa āḥyi 'od zer gyis// 'dod chags las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dmar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// 'gag med gsung sgra sgrog pa'i rdzas// spyad pas gsung dbyangs drug cu yis// gdul bya ma lus tshim gyur cig

/zag bcas bde ba'i nyams myong kun// zag med bde bar 'gyur bar shog /brjod pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// gti mug las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// mthing la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// gnyis med chos skur 'gyur bar shog /spyad pas sems rgyun ye shes lnga// rgyun chad med par 'brel gyur cig /rmongs shing ma rig gti mug tshogs// 'od gsal chen por 'gyur bar shog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// rtog bral bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor 'di// lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la sogs// dus gsum bde gshegs dpa' bo dang*// phyi nang mkha' 'gros bzhes su gsol// a la la stai dgyes par mdzod// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa yis// bdag cag 'dir 'dus thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs// ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// sems gnyis med chos skur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum ma thob bar du yang*// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa yis// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol// nang gi bar chad nang du sol// mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// ces brjod cing*/ tshogs phud gtor ma la phul te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong la gtor ma so so'i gzhung ltar btang*/ las kyi rdo rjes ma da na'i snod lag pa g.yas pas bzung*/ g.yon pas ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ mthong ba'i chos ni dag pa la// med do snyam pa'i rtog pa thong*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// lhan cig gcig pa nyid du gsol// zhes brjod cing*/ slob dpon nas rim par drang ngo*// len pa po rnams kyis kyang*/

g.yon pas phyag rgya de nyid dang*/ g.yas pas blangs la/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral zhing*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de nyid la ni gus pas 'dud// ces brjod/ de nas bza' ba la sogs pa dbul zhing*/ thog mar lag pa g.yon pas blangs te longs spyod/ rtsod pa la sogs pa bag med pa'i spyod pa spangs la/ rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa'i bsam pa bya ste/ yang bskang ba bya bar spro na/ na mo gu ru/ bde mchog gi bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ta ma bcos spros bral bde ba chen po'i dbyings// rab 'byams zhing 'di kun bzang mchod sprin spros// srid zhi phun tshogs khams las grub pa'i rdzas// 'dod yon dga' bde skyed byed phyi nang gsang*// de bzhin nyid sogs tshogs kyi mchod pa 'dis// dus gsum sangs rgyas khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal sras tirti nā ro grub chen brgyad// mkhas grub paṇa chen rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// gangs can grub mchog mar mi dwags po rje// bde gshegs phag gru thub dbang ratha shrīḥ rtsa ba brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dang*// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// bde gshegs kun 'dus bde mchog he ru kaḥ rdo rje phag mo rigs bzhi'i ḍā ki ma// 'khor lo gsum dang sgo mtshams lha mo brgyad// yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// bstan srung mahā kā la 'khor dang bcas// chos kyi sgrol ma tshe ring mched lnga dang*// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// bdag dang sems can ma rig nyon mongs pa'i// shes dang shes min sgrib gsum nyes tshogs dang*// khyad par sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya rnams// bag med dam las 'gal ba mthol lo bshags// de ltar thugs dam bskang zhing bshags pa'i mthus// rim gnyis drod thob lam mchog rtse mor phyin// sku lnga yongs rdzogs tshad med byang sems kyis// 'gro rnams smin cing grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig

yig brgya brjod cing nongs pa bshags/ zhes pa bde mchog gi tshogs bskang gi tshul tsam du gyi na pa chos skyabs pas bris pa yang kun la phan bde'i gnas su gyur cig/ ༈ //rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu mngon brjod las gsungs pa ni/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol// rnal 'byor ma mchog pasga'i bde// a la la la la la hoḥdagyes pa rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma tshogs mchod par mdzod// a i' a ā ra li hoḥ /rab dgyes mgon po dgyes bzhugs mdzod// mkha' 'gro dra1$00001103lt;FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=13gt;<FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=83gt;1$0000270ྭ1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-83gt;1$0000270 ba'i bde ba gsol// dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod// zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa// bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol// thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod// a la la la la la hoḥ /bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur// bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol// bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas// chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur// bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod// pasga rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis// bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod// ces brjod cing*/ bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan// nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni// 'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob// phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig /ces smon lam btab/ slob dpon gyi lag pa gnyis mthe bong dang*/ mdzub mo rtse sprad/ lhag ma brkyang ba kha yi thad du bzhag la/ chang gi kha phru de'i dbus nas lhag ma'i steng du btab nas/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi ubrisnga ba liṃ ubrisngā k+ṣu ཿswā hā/ zhes brjod pa'i 'byung po 'chol pa rnams la sbyin no// snod bshal ba'i chu shin tu lhag ma la dbang ba'i yi dwags rnams tshim pa'i ched du dor ro// ༈ //drug pa rjes kyi bya ba gnyis las/ rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba dang*/

rjes kyi yan lag go /dang po ni tho rangs kyi cha la lcogs na lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kyang bya zhing*/ phyi rol du 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma sngar bshad pa ltar btang*/ nang du zhugs nas dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing phyag byas la mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung dbul zhing bstod de/ zhes pa/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra a0ཾ pra tībra swā hā/ nas shapa1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=243gt;<FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=-273gt;1$0000270da1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-243gt;1$0000270'i bar gyis mchod/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyis// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*// dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud// ces bstod de/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa de yis lha mo mchog gis ni// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan// nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni// 'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob// phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis khams gsum sems can kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs te// bcom ldan he ru ka dpal sku gsung thugs// ye shes yon tan phrin las mchog grub shog /ces smon lam gdab/ oṃ basmra he ru ka sa ma ya/ sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba bya/ slar yang shar sgo nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod cing*/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa'i// mgon pos de kun bzod par mdzod// so so skye bor gyur gang dang*// rnal 'byor ma thob dbang gis dang*// nye bar mkho ba ma tshang zhing*// brjed dang shes bzhin ma yin pas// cung zhig cho ga ma tshang ba// de dag kun nas bzod par 'os// zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/

oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ basmra muḥ zhes pas/ rdul tshon dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ a kā ro brjod cing de'i don/ a zhes bya ba chos thams cad kyi sgo gdod nas skye ba med pa nyid do// zhes dran bzhin pas/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yon dril bu 'khrol zhing*/ g.yas rdo rje'i rtse mos shar sgo nas gtso bo'i bar gyi mtshan ma phyis nas/ rdul tshon cung zad spyi bor bzhag gzhan rnams mtha' nas rim par bsdus te/ rgyal ba'am bum pa gzhan gang rung du blugs nas khyer la/ chu klung chen po'i 'gram du klu chog bya ba ni/ gzhi de nyid du rdul tshon gyi pasga 'dab brgyad dkar po 'dab ma rnams la phu re re bris pa'i mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i mdun du/ pasga dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la mtha' yas la sogs pa'i klu brgyad lus stod lha ltar yid du 'ong zhing*/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ thal mo sbyar te 'khod pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med du gyur/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a0ཾ sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum gyis sbyin zhing*/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang bgyid stsal pa// de kun khyed kyis bzod par mdzod// zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la/ rdul tshon klu rnams kyis bkur sti chen pos rang rang gi mchod pa'i yul du spyan drangs par gyur par dmigs la chur dor zhing*/

bum pa chus gang ba khyer la dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bsangs gtor byas la/ oṃ basmra kī la ya ud1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=203gt;<FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=-273gt;1$0000270kā1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-203gt;1$0000270ིla ya/ sarba bilta1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=243gt;1$0000270'a1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-243gt;1$0000270na basmra sda ra āsmya༄༅ pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ hoḥ zhes rkam pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu rnams rim pa bzhin bton pa/ oṃ ru ru hru ru kwa la tispa silki lo tsa ni sarba acha sā sda ni swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur bu'i dbal bkru zhing*/ phur gdan la gtor bas/ bgegs rnams kyi rmas pa sos te phur ba'i ye shes pa rnams/ rang gi lag gi rdo rje la thim par gyur/ zhes bsgom zhing*/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das su gsal ba'i snying gar oṃ ha dkar po sogs dpa' bo'i go chas bsrungs te/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ rigs rnams kun gyi mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang*// sems dpa'i tshul 'chang 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang*// dngos grub mchog brnyes dril bu zhabs la sogs// rin chen bla ma brgyud par bcas rnams kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rmad byung ba'i// 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor lhur byed pa// bdag cag rnams kyi mchog tu 'dod pa'i don// bde ba chen po'i bkra shis 'phel gyur cig /rnal 'byor ma rgyud mthar thug rgyud sde rnams// dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar bcas 'khor gyi dbus// zab mo'i gsang ba mtha' dag 'doms mdzad pa// bcom ldan he ru ka dpal yab yum la// spangs rtogs rmad byung dge legs mnga' ba'i mthus// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs kun// yid bzhin 'byor ba'i bkra shis ma lus pas// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig /zag med dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin can// rigs kyi yum gyur mkha' 'gro ma la sogs// mtshams su mchod pa bzhi yi bdag nyid kyi// bde chen 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma rnams la// srid dang zhi ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa// grangs las 'das pa mchis pa'i bden pa des// sgrub pa po rnams lhan skyes ye shes kyis// lus ngag yid gsum rab tu tshim gyur cig

/ces sogs bkra shis brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ bum rdzas la sogs rdzas rnams ni// ci bde bar ni gnas par bya// de nas bdog pa thams cad kyis// dge 'dun rnams ni mchod par bya// byis pa rnams kyang tshim pa dang*// skye bo kun la cung zad sbyin// zhes gsungs pa ltar mchod sbyin ci 'byor ba bya zhing*/ dbang thob pa kho nas tshim par mi bya bar/ blang dor gyi gnas shes par byas la dam tshig bsrung ba la 'bad pas/ ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon kun 'grub par 'gyur te/ de nas dam tshig la gnas pa'i// sbyor ba legs par khong chud par// slob dpon las ni rab tu blang*// bsrung dang bsten dang bza' ba yi// dam tshig 'di ni bla na med// de la 'bad pas btsal rtsol bya// de yis 'bras bu rab rdzogs byed// ces bstan to// rgyud sde'i mthar thug rnal 'byor bla med kyi// ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa'i yang snying la// brten nas skal ldan tshe 'dir mchog stsol ba'i// smin byed dkyil 'khor cho ga'i rim pa 'di// 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can khrod dag tu// rim par byon pa'i dril zhabs u*| dang*// rga lo a seng phag gru yab sras kyi// zhal las 'ongs pa'i dal 'gro'i rgyun chen 'di// snyigs dus 'dren mchog sdarma kīrti dang*// mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis las brgyud de// dbang gi chu bo gnyis 'dres rgya mtsho las// bdag blo bum bzang snod du 'di bstsal to// dge ba 'di yis srid gsum sems can kun// snod bcud rnam dag gdod ma'i lhan skyes sku// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por 'grub gyur te// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'bras bu mthar phyin shog /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i cho ga dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di nyid kyang*/ don du gnyer ba rnams kyi re ba yongs su bskang ba'i phyir/ 'bri gung pa ratha'i ming can gyis/

stod lung bsam grub bde chen gyi gzhis kar bris pa'o// //༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga'i sgrub thabs don gnyis mchog stsol ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas rnam dag rang bzhin chos kyi sku// 'gyur med bde chen ros gang longs spyod rdzogs// gnyis med zung 'jug rnam rol sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum bla ma he ru ka dpal 'dud// gdod ma'i lhan skyes lam gyi lhan skyes su// bsgrubs nas 'bras bu'i lhan skyes mngon bya'i phyir// 'phags yul las 'ongs rgyud gzhung man ngag dang*// bod yul mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin 'dir bkod bya// 'di la gsum/ nyams su blang bya'i chos ngos bzung ba/ ji ltar nyams su blang tshul/ sgrub thabs dngos so// dang po la'ang gsum/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'di sde snod bzhi par 'dod tshul dang*/ sde snod gsum ga dang gsum char gyi snying por bzhed tshul/ rgyud sde bzhi so so'i dbye ba dang*/ bye brag sgrub thabs 'di rgyud gang la brten tshul lo// de la dang po rang re thams cad kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ thabs mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des/ yul wā rā ṇā si dang*/ bya rgod phung po dang*/ shing sā la zung gi tshal du/ bden pa bzhi dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa dang*/ nges pa don gyi chos 'khor bskor te/ sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum du gsungs so// ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi gdul bya nyon mongs pa stobs chen po mi bzad pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ o ḍi ya na dang*/ 'og min la sogs par gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa gsungs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ skye bo 'dod chags can don du// de yi byed po rdo rje sems// zhes gsungs so// gsang sngags sde snod bzhi pa ltar na/

sde snod gong ma gsum ni/ rdo rje theg pa la sbyor ba'i rgyur 'gro la/ gsang sngags kyis ni tshe gcig gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar byed pas 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya ste/ gsang ba lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ rgyu la sbyor ba rgyu yi chos// 'khor lo shin tu bskor byas nas// 'bras bu'i theg pa nye lam zhig /dus tshigs phyi mar 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i khyad chos las/ sde snod gsum ga dang*/ gsum char gyi snying por bzhed de/ de yang rgyal ba'i chos tshul ji snyed pa thams cad kyi don/ thabs shes rab gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi brjod bya shes rab zab mo/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba stong nyid du ston pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa thabs kyi gdams pas khyad par du byas te/ gong gi bogs bton pas/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur zhing*/ stong pa nyid las kyang thabs kyi gdams pa 'byung bas na/ gsang sngags sde snod so sor bsdu ba dang*/ gsum char gyi snying por yang 'gyur ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ de yang gdul bya sems can la/ 'dod chags kyi tshul rnam pa bzhir snang ba'i gnyen por bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde bzhir byung ba/ dpal sam bu ṭa las bshad cing*/ de ltar nyon mongs pa'i stobs che chung bzhi la/ lam gyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang ba'i tshul gang zag gi khyad par bzhi la dgongs pa ste/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor rgyud// rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ de ltar nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyud sde bzhi las/ 'di ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ de yang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med rgyud dang gsum las/

'di ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ de la'ang*/ dgyes rdor dang*/ tsakra su ra/ gdan bzhi/ ma hā ma yā dang bzhi las/ 'di ni 'khor lo sdom pa'o// de la'ang rtsa ba dang bshad pa man ngag gi rgyud dang gsum las/ sgrub thabs 'di ni/ grub chen dril bu zhabs dang*/ tirti pa/ iglā' ti bar pa/ u*| kā ra/ rtsā mi/ rga lo tsā ba rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams kyi rtsa ba ni/ man ngag gi rgyud nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i le'u gsum pa 'di la brten nas mdzad par 'dug ces mkhas grub gong ma'i yig cha las byung ngo*// spyi don gnyis pa ji ltar nyams su len tshul la gsum ste/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor rnam gsum shes bya ste// byin gyis brlabs dang rab brlabs dang*// bsam gyis mi khyab gzugs rdzogs pa'i// rnal 'byor sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags// zhes pa'i rkang pa gcig gi don/ ratha rak+ṣi tas bskyed rim du bkral ba ni/ phung po khams dang skye mched lha'i nga rgyal du byas te bsgom pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa lnga dang*/ srid par skye ba'i rim pa la sogs pa'i cho gas rab tu btags te/ bsgom pa dang gnyis ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par rga lo'i lugs/ dpal phag mo gru pas/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po la gnang ba'i phyag len du/ mngon byang lngas bskyed/ srid gsum sbyong byed sku gsum lam khyer gyi gnad tshang bar ston pa 'di lta bu la bla ma'i man ngag dang*/ rgyud don gyis kha bkang ste bri bar bya ba la/ spyir bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa nyams su len par byed pa la/ gnad 'di dag gal che ste/ rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ rang bzhin lam gyi bar do ru// gnyug ma'i ye shes ngos bzung phyir// snyan brgyud gdams ngag len yang 'tshal// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin ngo bo bden pas stong pa la/

glo bur gyi dri mas de la gos pa med de/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi bcos slad dang bral ba ni/ bde stong lhan cig skyes pa don gyi ye gdod ma'i shes pa rang 'od yul med kyi gsal mdangs 'gag med du bzhugs pa de/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su/ gzhi skye ba med pa'i mdangs 'gag med kyi lhar bskyed pa la bskyed rim yongs grub tu ming gdags pa'i bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim snang cha phra ba phra ba'i nang tshan so so ba rnams kyang*/ bdag gzhan ngo bos stong pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog cing*/ de nyid kyang dngos su lhar ldang lugs/ 'bras bu sku gsum gzhi 'bras dbyer med nyams su len pa'i dus su/ sku gsum dang rjes su mthun pa'i bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pas/ sku gsum mngon du byed pa'i gnad shes pa la brten/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i lugs kyis/ sems kyis lus byin gyis brlabs pas/ dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor shar tshe/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phrin las kyi sgo mtha' yas pa 'byung ba'i gdams pa zab mo khong du chud nas/ 'khrul med kyi gdeng dang ldan pa zh-ig 'byung bar 'gyur ro// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa sgrub pa'i thabs dngos ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i sdom ni/ 'du bya bdud rtsi byin rlabs myang*// gtor ma btang zhing mchod byin brlab// skyabs sems sgo gsum dag pa dang*// tshad med phung sogs byin gyis brlab// srung 'khor bsgom zhing sgrib sbyangs la// tshogs bsag rten dang brten pa bskyed// gnas gsum byin brlab go cha dgod// ye shes spyan drangs mchod cing bstim// dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod pa dang*// bstod la bde chen nyams myong bya// bzlas pa'i yan lag rdzogs pa'i mthar// thun bsdu gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam mtshams kyi bya ba'o// zhes pa las/ rnal 'byor pa gang zhig theg pa thun mong ba'i rim pas rgyud sbyangs shing*/

'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba rdzogs par thob pas/ de'i dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ ri bo'i rtse 'am dur khrod sogs/ rnal 'byor dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su bris sku dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad 'du bya zhing*/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu cang te'u la sogs mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par byas la/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ oṃ khaha ro he huṃ ham̐'u phaṭ kyis nang mchod bsangs/ oṃ swā ༄༅ wa shulka༈ཿsarba sdarmāḥswā ༄༅ sa shulko+uhaṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ hūm̐ oṃ khaṃ āṃ trāṃ dang*/ bāṃ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ sgron ma lngar gyur pa rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rlung gis bskyod/ me sbar zhing bskol bas sa bon dang bcas pa'i rdzas rnams zhu ba/ nyi ma 'char ka lta bu'i kha dog can/ de'i rlangs pa las grub pa'i dngul chu'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i khā*/ཾ ga kha 'og tu lta ba/ de nyid kyang zhu nas bcud dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga lnga nga*/ tsa tsha dza khwa nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ka ṇa/ ta tha da sda na/ pa pha bā ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ steng nas steng du brtsegs te gnas pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spros/ sems can gyi don byas nas snyoms par zhugs pas yi ge gsum la thim/ yi ge gsum yang dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas bdud rtsi myang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/

oṃ khaha ro he sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swā ༄༅ wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung sogs byin rlabs gong ltar byas la/ pad kor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sā' ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ uskya༄༅ da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki sbya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛrmyatru/ sa ma ya rak+ṣatru/ sarba silki ke pra yabratru/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaisngaṃ/ 'uzwa tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ska tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sadzu khaṃ bi shulka ye sa hā yi kaṃ' watru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul te/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ klu'i= gnod sbyin= srin po'i= 'byung po'i= yi dwags= sha za'i= smyo byed= rjed byed= mkha' 'gro'i= ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin stsol// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces phrin las bcol te/ gtor ma gtsang sar dor ro// mchod pa rnams khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ mchod yon/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/

byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ oṃ basmra a0ཾ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ā tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= pā sngaṃ= pukhyaṃ= sdā paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gablaṃ= nai wi sngaṃ= shapa1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=243gt;<FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=-273gt;1$0000270da1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-243gt;1$0000270= zhes so so'i sngags rgya rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab bo// bdag dus deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs/ yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= zhes lan ci rigs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i tshogs// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni he ru kar gyur cing*// sems can thams cad he ru ka'i// go 'phang mchog la dgod par bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur/ dpal he ru ka nga'o snyam du lhag par mos te/ shrī he ru ko+uhaṃ/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing kha/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

gar gyi nyams dgu dang*/ phyag rgya drug la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/ yum dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal ba'i lte bar/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga lnga nga*/ tsa tsha dza khwa nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ka ṇa/ ta tha da sda na/ pa pha bā ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥhuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lan gsum brjod/ yi ge'i 'phreng ba 'od zer kha dog lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yon skor rim pa gsum du gnas pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros/ bgegs thams cad bskrad cing bcom nas/ slar yang sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ gzhan phan bsam pa byams pa ste// snying rjes gzhan gyi sdug bsngal 'joms// gzhan bdes tshim pa dga' ba ste// sems can gzhan snyoms btang snyoms so// sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa brjod cing*/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom mo/ mgo bo'i dbus su buṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po phyag g.yas 'khor lo gdengs shing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte bar aṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ mgrin par hrīḥlas pasga gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ rkang pa'i long bu gnyis kyi 'og tu heḥlas rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu rnams g.yas pas rin po che dang*/ pasga dmar po dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje gdengs shing*/ g.yon rol pa dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas bsgyings ba dang bcas pas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ spyi gtsug tu hi las dpal he ru ka rdo rje nag po/ g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ mig gnyis su oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rna ba gnyis su hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/

g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ sna bug gnyis su trāṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ser po/ lce'i rtsa bar aṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar khaṃ las ser sna rdo rje ljang khu/ de rnams kyi g.yas pas rin po che dang*/ pasga dmar po dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje gdengs shing*/ g.yon rol pa dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ snying gar haṃ las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lte bar lāṃ las ltung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang pos 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ snying gar māṃ las gsod byed ma nag mo g.yas dang pos rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mgrin par pāṃ las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo g.yas dang pos pasga 'dzin pa/ dpral bar tāṃ las pasga gar gyi dbang phyug ljang gu g.yas dang pos ral gri 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis pas gri gug g.yon dang pos thod pa/ 'og mas khā*/ཾ ga 'dzin pa/ gsang bar khaṃ las pasga dra ba can ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dud kha/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum lcags kyu/ gri gug tshangs mgo/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ khā*/ཾ/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lnga ka'ang gcer mo skra grol ba/ spyan gsum ma/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'o// oṃ pra kṛ ta pa ri shulkaḥsarba sdarmaḥpra kṛ ta pa ri shulka༈ོུhaṃ/ zhes pad kor dang 'khyud tshul bya'o// yang g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis phyogs rnams su se gol rim pa bzhin du gtog cing*/ shar du oṃ su+u ni su+u ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ byang du oṃ gṛrmya gṛrmya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nub tu oṃ gṛrmya༄༅ pa ya gṛrmya༄༅ pa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

lhor oṃ ā na ya hoḥ' ga wān basmra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kyi yi ge rnams/ g.yon skor du nag ljang dmar ser ba'i kha dog can tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab cing 'bar ba/ de'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can du gyur/ 'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra1$00001103lt;FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=13gt;<FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=83gt;1$0000270ྭ1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-83gt;1$0000270 ba dang*/ gur gyi nang du bla bre dang*/ phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab par gyur/ oṃ me dī ni basmra༄༅ི'a wa basmrā bla hūm̐/ oṃ basmra pra kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ basmra pazwa ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ basmra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ basmra sha ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ basmra kwa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ yang sngar ltar phyogs bzhir se gol dang bcas te/ oṃ su+u ni sogs brjod cing*/ phyogs bzhi'i sngags las grub pa'i g.yon skor gyis khwa gdong ma nag mo/ 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ phag gdong ma ser mo rnams su gyur/ slar yang se gol dang sngags lan gnyis gnyis su bzla zhing*/ mtshams su phyogs bzhi'i sngags gnyis gnyis kyi 'od zer 'dres pa las/ g.yas skor gyi shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ brgyad ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lte ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tho ba dang*/

g.yon pa rang 'dra'i lha mo sku smad phur bu'i dbyibs can 'dzin pa rnams las sprul pa du ma phyogs mtshams dang*/ shar nub kyi khro mo gnyis steng 'og dang bcas pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa bkug hūm̐ rdo rje'i ra ba phyi ma'i rgyab tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i khron pa zab mo brgyad kyi nang du bcug nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khro mo rnams la bka' bsgos pas/ phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams g.yas skor du gdug pa can rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btab par gyur/ oṃ lnga lnga lnga༄༅ ta ya lnga༄༅ ta ya/ sarba dusnga༄༅ཾ bilta1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=243gt;1$0000270'a1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-243gt;1$0000270ཾ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ basmra kī la ya basmra sda rod āsmya༄༅ pa ya ti/ sarba dusnga༄༅ཾ bilta1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=243gt;1$0000270'a1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-243gt;1$0000270ཾ kā ya wāka tsing basmra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ rdo rje tho bas phur bu brdungs pas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug par gyur/ oṃ basmra murta ra basmra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen po'i de bzhin nyid du rang bzhin gcig par byas te/ bgegs lhag ma rnams rgyang ring du bskrad nas/ lha mo rnams rwa ba la thim pas/ chu la chu brdabs pas zegs ma 'thor ba bzhin du 'od zer phyir 'phros pas rdo rje dang pasga dang 'khor lo'i rwa ba zlum po bar mtshams med cing dum bu gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam pa thams cad du 'gro ba bgegs dang bral ba'o// oṃ basmra pra kā ra hūm̐/ oṃ pasga pra kā ra hūm̐/ oṃ tsakra pra kā ra hūm̐/ zhes brtan par bya'o// rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pasga dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/

sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ he ru ka dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i zhabs mthil gnyis rang gi tshangs bug la gtad pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dngul chu'i kha dog can gyi mtha' mar/ yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi mkhyen brtse dang nus mthu thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ he ru ka'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim pas/ hūm̐ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams dang zhabs mthil nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pas/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang*/ 'khor ba thog med kyi sdig sgrib dang*/ dam tshig nyams chag thams cad dag lus sems la bde stong gi nyams myong khyad par can/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la skyes par gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ basmra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tispa/ dṛ ko me' wa/ su tophyo me' wa/ a nu raco me' wa/ su pophyo me' wa/ sarba silki ke pra yabra/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsingaṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ 'a ga wān/ basmra he ru ka mā me mudwa/ he ru ko+u' wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas pa ci rigs pa'i rjes su/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/

he ru ka'i zhal nas khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag go zhes gsungs shing*/ he ru ka rang nyid la thim par gyur/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi lus he ru ka'i sku/ shel gyi gong bu phyis pa ltar dag cing gsal ba'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ hūm̐ sngon po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba/ de'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa/ rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying gar thim par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*// dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis/ dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ zhes dmigs la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra a0ཾ pra tībra swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā sngaṃ= pukhye= sdā pe= ā lo ke= gable= nai wi snge= shapa1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=243gt;<FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=-273gt;1$0000270da1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-243gt;1$0000270'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ basmra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin du/ waṃ she= mṛ taṃ ge= mu razwe= hā gla= lā gla= gī ti= smy-i tsai= pukhye= sdā pe= dī pe= gable= oṃ rū pa basmri huṃ ham̐'u phaṭ/ ra sa basmri= spazhe basmri= oṃ sdarmā sda༄༅ tu basmri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma bzhis sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa thogs te mchod par gyur par mos te/ oṃ padwa a mṛ ta pū dza me lnga sa mu dra hra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes nang mchod nas thigs gtor bya'o// mchod pa'i lha mo rnams bcom ldan 'das ma la thim/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde stong zag med kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ pad kor 'khyud tshul gyis/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bde stong ye shes kyi de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag de ltar phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las gyur pa'i// lus dang ngag dang gzhan yang yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bgyis dang de bzhin bgyid bstsal rnams// thams cad rgyal ba rnams kyi mdun du bshags// gang yang de bzhin gshegs kun bsod nams dang*// gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i byang chub la brten dang*// rang sangs rgyas dang bla ma mchog rnams kyi// dge ba kun la bdag ni rjes yi rang*// dus gsum kun tu gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ nam mkha'i phyogs khyab brtse ldan yon gnas tshogs// chos dang skyon spangs 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la// gus pas bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi// sdig pa thams cad rtsad nas zad byed cing*// gang 'dir bsod nams tshogs ni nyer bsags pa// dngos bral gzung 'dzin rnam spangs chos bdag med// dbyer med byang chub sems ni bdag gis bskyed// tshangs pa dbang po sogs kyis rnyed dka' ba// dri med rnam dag rnyog pa yod ma mchis// brtse ldan sras bcas rgyal bas gsungs pa'i lam// rnam dag bsam yas yang dag bsten par bgyi// bgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las// bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag gis rang nyid skad cig ma// sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bya// zhes lan gsum brjod de/

bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rim pa bzhin du/ he ru ka zhes bya ba'i yi ge dkar dmar sngo ba'i kha dog can gsal bar gyur/ he ni bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka dang rgyu med las skye ba spangs pa/ ru ni gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i tshogs dang bral ba/ ka ni mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'o// de lta bu'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mi shes pa'i sems can rnams bdag dang bdag gi ba la sogs pa'i yongs su bzung bas 'khor bar gyur to// de bas na bdag he ru kar gyur nas/ gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i chos khong du chud par 'gyur ba de ltar don bya'o// oṃ swā ༄༅ wa sogs kyi sngags don dran pas/ khams gsum po thams cad rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid do// sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis rang gi sems nyid oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam par brtsegs thabs su gnas pa las/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams spros/ 'gro ba thams cad 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas te snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba/ yi ge gsum la so sor thim zhing*/ de dag kyang steng nas rim gyis hūm̐ la bsdu/ de yang zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du 'dus nas/ nā da yang shin tu phra ba mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shū sbya tā smya༄༅ na basmra swā ༄༅ wa āb ko+uhaṃ/ zhes sngags kyi don dran par bya ba ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// slar yang rang gi sems nā da shin tu phra ba'i gzugs dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyen du bsgreng ba nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de ltar bsgom pa yang*/ gzhi dus 'chi ba'i 'od gsal las langs ma thag 'od gsal gyi rlung sems tsam las nyon sgrib ma dag pa dang*/ dag pa'i sgyu mar longs skur ldang ba'i rgyud smin byed kyi gtso bo yin pas/ 'di la bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i lam khyer zhes pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po gru gsum pa/

rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa/ rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa rnams so so'i sa bon gyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i lhun po gru bzhi pa/ lcog brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa'i steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pasga'i ze'u 'brur hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus mthing kha'i lte bar/ paṃ las pasga 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs bzhi dmar zhing*/ ge sar dang me rlung ser po/ lte ba dang bden bral ljang gu/ dbang ldan nag po'i mdog can du gyur/ pasga'i lte bar zla ba la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ yang a ā sogs nas aṃ aḥ dkar po phrag gnyis g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba/ mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi steng du/ nyi ma la ka kha ga lnga nga*/ tsa tsha dza khwa nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ka ṇa/ ta tha da sda na/ pa pha bā ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ḍa ka da sda ya la/ ka kha sogs nas ḍa ka da sda ya la/ dmar po phrag gnyis g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba/ dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de dag gi bar du nā da zhugs pa las/ de yang thig le nas ū yig gi bar rim gyis grub pa'i hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spros te 'gro ba thams cad kyi zag bcas kyi phung po sbyangs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lhar byas pa dang*/

phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug dang*/ rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa thabs dang shes rab mnyam par sbyor ba'i mthus/ zhu ste hūm̐ gi nā da la thim pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ zla nyi sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin du rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// 'di ni pha ma'i khams dkar dmar gyi dbus su bar srid zhugs nas skye ba len pa ji bzhin du/ bar srid mtshon pa nam mkha'i nā das/ nyi zla'i dbus su zhugs te sku yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa ni/ gzhi'i skye ba sbyong byed dang rdzogs rim gyi skabs su/ dag ma dag gi sgyu ma'i sku gnyis kyi khams rags pa bzung ste/ sprul skur ldang ba'i rgyud smin byed kyi gtso bo yin pas/ skye ba sprul sku'i lam khyer ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsing basmra swā ༄༅ wa āb ko+uhaṃ/ oṃ basmra shulkaḥsarba sdarmaḥbasmra shulko+uhaṃ/ rdo rje'i rwa gur 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba'i me ri dang bcas pa sngar ltar gsal ba'i lte b.ru+uṃ las mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang nag ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rin chen rdo rjes spras shing stegs bu bzhis bskor ba la/ lha mo'i tshogs 'khod pa/ ka ba bzhi bzhis nye bar btegs pa'i rta babs bzhis mdzes pa la/ pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo gdugs dang*/ ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum bzang las 'thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing rgyal srid rin po che la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rin po che du mas bkra ba'i pha gu dang*/ gser gyi ska rags bzhi la btags pa'i chu srin gyi kha nas do shal dang do shal phyed pa la sogs pa 'phyang ba/

bya 'dab kyi 'og dang steng du ba ku lī dang*/ kra ma shī'as bskor ba la sna tshogs pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyis spud pa/ nang gi steng 'og thams cad kyi shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i phyogs mdog dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pasga 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gis 'phreng bas bskor ba/ snying po'i pasga'i mthar gnas pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i thog gi rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che tog dang bcas pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol du shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ gtum drag tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ rdo rje 'bar ba/ keng rus can/ dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du/ mi bzad bzhad pa/ bkra shis tshal/ mun pa drag po/ ki li ki lā sgrogs pa ste/ dur khrod chen po de rnams su shing dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ klu dang*/ sprin gyi dbang phyug dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten rnams brgyad brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ ro langs dang*/ 'byung po du ma rgyu ba/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rol pa la sogs pa'i bkod pa dang ldan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi pasga'i lte bar nyi ma dang 'jigs dus/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma la dbugs bral gyi gdan dang bcas pa/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga 'od 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ hūm̐ la thim pas/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od kyis khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sbyangs nas he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka sku mdog zar ma'i me tog gsar pa ltar sngo sangs/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa'i zhal can/ dbu skra ral pa'i con pan gyi rtse mor nor bu/

mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon gyi phyogs su zla ba phyed pas spras pa/ sum khugs su 'khyogs shing gyes pa'i dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas sbrel ba'i thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse bran can skra mtshams su bcings shing*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang thal chen gyis byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i bar dang*/ 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo bltabs pa'i steng du brdzis pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus su rol pa'i mdun du/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ gzhon nu mdzes ma/ lang tsho dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ dbu skra grol ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug sdigs mdzub dang bcas te 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas pasga'i snod bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang*/ g.yas bskum pas 'khril ba/ bde ba chen po'i nyams rgyas pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa'o// phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/ mdun du mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga g.yon du lā ba ma ljang gu/ rgyab tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ g.yas su gzugs can ma ser mo bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa'i gru mor khā*/ཾ ga dang ldan pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas mdzes shing*/ spyan gsum mnga' ba/ skra sil bur grol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis ro'i gdan la gnas pa/

mtshams kyi 'dab ma la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ de ltar rang lha de'i rnam pas yas rim mam/ mas rim bzhin sku'i cha shas rags pa zhig gsal btab la/ yid ngor cha med pa lam mer 'char thub na/ de la grim lhod ran par sems rtse gcig tu bzhag cing*/ de nas thog mar gsal btab pa de min pa rnam pa gang yang*/ re zhig de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ dang po'i dmigs pa de kho na la sems bzhag mi gsal na yang gsal btab la bsgom ste/ rnam pa gsal bar gyur gyur gyi bar bslab/ de yang gang gsal btab pa de 'char zhing de las gzhan gsal ma btab pa mi gsal la/ gsal ba de nyid mig gis mthong ba las kyang lhag par gsal bar mthong ba snyam byed pa dang*/ de nyid la bying rgod kyi mtha' dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag pas/ thun 'khyong ba'i brtan pa gal che'o// de nas lha'i sku rags pa la nges pa rnyed nas/ zhal phyag sogs phra mo rnams rdzogs par 'char ba la sngar bzhin bslab/ de la brten nas yum dang bcas pa la sngar bzhin bsgom/ de nas rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa la gong bzhin sbyangs/ rten dang brten pa thams cad kyi bskyed rim phra rags ma lus pa cig car du lam mer 'char ba la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa zhig ma byung gi bar rnam pa gsal ba la bslab par bya'o// de ltar rang lha'i sku rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor snang ba yang*/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o// tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni lā ma'o// chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o// sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o// yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka rdo rje'o// zhes dag pa dang bcas te yun ring du bsgom la/ dus kun tu rang lha de'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas shing*/ mos pa'i shugs yal ba na/ yang sngar bzhin lha'i rnal 'byor la mnyam par bzhag

de ltar 'bad pas/ dang por bcos ma'i sgo nas gzhir gnas kyi sku mngon du sgom pa yin kyang dus re zhig na lha'i nga rgyal gyi shugs de brtan nas rang lha de'i skur nges pa brtan par 'byung zhing de yang thun bar du de las mi g.yo bar bsgom mo// de ltar ma 'byongs par lha'i rnam pa gsal ba dang*/ nga rgyal brtan pa gnyis re mos su bskyangs pas/ mthar tha mal gyi snang ba mi 'char bar/ bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi snang ba 'di nyid 'char ba na/ tha mal snang ba'i yid ngo dag par byed nus pa yin la/ sngar bshad pa'i bcos min gyi nga rgyal brtan pa na/ tha mal gyi zhen pa yid ngor dag par byed nus pa yin no// de nas snod bcud kyi snang ba gang shar lha dang gzhal yas khang du bltas la/ de dang de'i ngo bor 'char nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin brtan po byung na/ lus bskyed rim gyis tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyangs pa zhes bya'o// de nas/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pasga la āḥdamar po/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃ ljang gu/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar po/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser po/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang pheṃ gyi sgras bskul te/ pheṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ pi wang ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod pa/

oṃ basmra wī ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod cing*/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bcing bzhin pas/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa dang gnyis med du gyur/ par bltas la dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas nas/ lag gnyis g.yon dang g.yas dang snying gar rnam lnga 'dod kor dang*/ mthar 'khyud pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ yo ga shulkaḥsarba sdarmaḥyo ga shulko+uhaṃ/ zhes chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag la/ bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo*// ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ basmra wī ne/ basmra waṃ she/ sogs dang*/ rū pa basmri sogs bcu drug gis mchod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum bzhi phag mo dang bcas pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ī ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas/ lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur te chu lhag ma las/ bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan zhing*/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pa nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang bas/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod par gyur pa la/ rgyas par na mchod 'phreng nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ bsdus par na/

oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra a0ཾ pra tībra swā hā/ a0ཾ gyi gnas su/ ādwa mā ṇaṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= pāsngaṃ= pukhyaṃ= sdā paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gablaṃ= nai wi sngaṃ= shapa1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=243gt;<FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=-273gt;1$0000270da1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-243gt;1$0000270= zhes dang*/ oṃ basmra wī ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pi wang ma la sogs pas sngar ltar mchod/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ swā da swā ༄༅ wa āb ko+uhaṃḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod nas thigs gtor rim bzhin 'bul zhing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du= 'phags mchog klu sgrub snying po'i= grub chen dril bu zhabs kyi= grub chen dzā len sda ra'i= rnal 'byor nag po spyod pa'i= tirti shes rab bzang po'i= nā ro ye shes dngos grub kyi= rnal 'byor ka9 ri pa'i= bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i= paṇa chen u ka ra'i= rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags pa'i= dpal chen rga lo tsā ba'i= bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i= skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i= spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi= bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje'i= slob dpon dbang phyug bsod nams kyi= mkhas grub grags pa shes rab kyi= kun mkhyen tshul rgyal ba'i= mtshungs med grags pa rdo rje'i= gtsang pa blo gros bzang po'i= mkhan chen rin chen bzang po'i= rje btsun bsod nams mtshan can gyi= rje btsun sna tshogs rang grol gyi= mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi= bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i= rgyal dbang dkon mchog ratha'i= rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i=

dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal gyi= dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po'i= sku bzhi'i dbang phyug sdarma rā dza'i= rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi= dpal ldan mgar chen pa'i= rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i= khyab bdag pasga'i rgyal mtshan gyi= mtshungs med sdarma khya dza'i= khri chen rig 'dzin blo gros kyi= khyab bdag chos nyid nor bu'i= gru 'dzin dgyes dngos thugs rje nyi ma'i= mgar chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi= mtshungs med chos kyi blo gros kyi= bstan 'dzin zhi ba'i blo gros kyi= mtshungs med chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi= oṃ shrī basmra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la su raṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ basmra bai ro tsa nī ye= oṃ ḍā ki nī ye= lā me= khaha ro he= rū pi ṇī ye= oṃ ma hā kā lā ya= oṃ ma hā kā lī= oṃ sarba sdarma pā la ye= zhes pa'i mthar/ yi ge gsum btags te/ bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ yi dam chos skyong gi tshogs la mchod/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i bu ga phaṭ ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las a las pasga dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze'u 'bru as mtshan zhing bde ba 'bab pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba/ de nas snying ga'i bar mchog dga'/ de nas lte ba'i bar khyad dga'/ de nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor son pas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa dang rnam lnga'i 'dod kor gyi rjes su 'khyud tshul dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa basmra swā ༄༅ wa āb ko+uhaṃ/ zhes bde stong dbyer med kyi don nges pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// oṃ na mo' ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ ma hā kalpārdi saṃ ni' ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭo7 ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃ sna༈ ka ra lo grī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha srū dzā ༄༅ su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shosnga༄༅ ta shū la khā*/ཾ ga sda༄༅ ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā ska/ dzi nāṃ wa ra sda rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā sdā mrābla kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes yab dang*/ oṃ na mo' ga wa ti basmra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo āwa a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīsnge shwa rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarbā' tā yā wa he ma hā basmre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo basmra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa ljaṃ ka ri ni tru*/ ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro sda ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi prā+e da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzu ni phru ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo basmra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yum gyi bskang ba brgyad pas bstod do// de nas rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la'ang*/ dpal rga lo'i lugs kyi dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum ltar bsgom pa'i rgyas par nā ro'i chos drug ltar nyams su len tshul gzhan du shes shing bsdus pa ni/ bdag nyid he ru kar gnas pa'i sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i rtsa 'dab so so'i dbus su spyi bor haṃ dkar po/ mgrin par oṃ dkar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po lte bar āḥdamar po/ āḥlas gtum mo'i me 'bar/ 'khor lo gsum gyi yi ge bsregs shing*/ haṃ las dkar cha'i rgyun bab pas yi ge gsum slar gsos te gnas gsum gyi yi ge las kyang dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro bas bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/

zhes bsgom pa'i brtan pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga 'char ro// de ltar yun ring du 'bad pas skyo ba na bzlas pa bya ste/ bgrang 'phreng mi rus las grub cing gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i ras kyi srad bu la brgyus pa/ oṃ khaha ro hes bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pasga dang nyi ma'i steng du bgrang phreng hrīḥlas pasga gar dbang dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang pos pasga dmar po/ gnyis pas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dang pos dril bu/ gnyis pas thod pa dang khā*/ཾ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan can/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ basmra a0ཾ pra tībra swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod la/ oṃ swa hā hu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa'am/ oṃ pasga smy-itse shwa ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i rjes su/ pasga gar dbang yongs su gyur pa las bgrang phreng gi rnam par gyur/ zhes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bgrang 'phreng lag pa g.yon pas bzung ste/ zhi ba la mdzub mo dang*/ rgyas pa la gung mo dang*/ dbang la ming med dang*/ mngon spyod la mthe'u chung gi steng du bzhag la mthe bong dang 'phreng rdog lha'i rang bzhin du mos shing*/ mthe bong gis 'phreng ba gcod pa'i tshe lha rnams dgug cing spyan 'dren pa'i tshul du dmigs nas/ khyad par du rnam par rtog pa shas che na rnam rtog gi rlung brtan pa'i bzlas pa bya ste/ bdag he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs te bzlas pa byas pas sngags kyi 'phreng ba rlung dang lhan cig tu rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas thon/

khams gsum gyi sems can lhar gsal ba'i sna bug g.yas par zhugs/ snying gar hūm̐ gnas pa la thim zhing*/ hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba sems can gyi sna bug g.yon pa nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yas par zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim zhing 'khor bar gyur pa la dmigs te bzlas pa bya'o// nyon mongs pa shas che na thig le brtan pa'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags 'phreng dkar po byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin can/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang las brgyud gsang ba'i rdo rje las thon/ yum gyi' gar zhugs/ a wa lku tī las thon te rang gi zhal du zhugs shing rgyun mi 'chad du 'khor bar gyur par mos la bzlas/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ni/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar nā da'i rnam pa las sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ me tog gi 'phreng ba lta bu sna bug g.yas nas thon/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i rnam par gyur nas/ 'gro ba'i don byas te/ slar sngags 'phreng sna bug g.yon du zhugs nas thon/ lte ba'i nā da la thim par gyur pa'am/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba 'khor ba las 'od zer ser po 'phros shing 'du bar gyur/ zhes bsgom/ yang las bzhi'i bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na/ gtso bo'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar sa bon hūm̐ yig mchog tu gsal ba'i mthar sngags 'phreng mu tig gi 'phreng ba ltar 'khor ba las 'od zer kha dog dkar po byung*/ yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ yum gyi mkha' nas rdo rje nor bu'i lam du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par gyur/ de bzhin du rgyas pa la/ yab yum gyi sngags dril te 'khor ba las 'od zer ser pos tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par gyur/ dbang la/ yab yum gyi sngags lcags sgrog gi 'phreng ba lta bu 'khor ba las 'od zer kha dog dmar pos khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad dang longs spyod dbang du bsdus par gyur/

drag po la/ sngags 'phreng dmar nag me lce chad pa'i tshul du spros pa las/ 'od zer kha dog mthing khas dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad par gyur/ zhes dmigs pa ste de las bzlas rim rgyas par spro na gzhan du rtogs par bya'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ shrī basmra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la su raṃ swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nye snying yi ge bdun pa'o// oṃ basmra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bulka ḍā ki nī ye basmra wa9 nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying ngo*// mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ gyis mtshan pa'i mthar rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ tshur 'dus rang rang gi sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par gyur/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaha ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags so// 'di la grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ gtso bo la 'bum phrag gcig yum dang 'khor la khri/ dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon du 'os pa yin na/ ye shes dbab pa'i sngags la'ang khri bzla bar grub chen dā ri ka pa sogs bzhed la bde mchog 'byung ba las/ gtso bo'i snying po ni las thams cad 'grub par gsungs te/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das dngos grub// myur du 'grub ste gzhan du min// zhes mchog tu bsngags la/ nye snying ni/ char dbab pa dang gter dang ni// ngag gi dngos grub bsgrub par bya// zhes las tshogs dmigs bsal bsgrub par bshad pa'i/ 'dir grangs kyi bzlas pa snying po'i sngags la bya zhing*/ 'bum phrag gcig tu bzla ba la yang*/ de nyid kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa las/

rdzogs ldan dus su gcig bzlas pa// gsum ldan dus su gnyis 'gyur bzlas// gnyis ldan dus su gsum 'gyur bshad// rtsod dus bzhi 'gyur du ni bzla// zhes pa'i 'grel ba ratha rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa las rdzogs ldan la ni zla ba gcig ces pa sngags gang gis 'bum phrag gcig bzlas par gsungs pa dang*/ 'bum phrag gnyis la sogs pa yang ste/ de nyis 'gyur la sogs pa gzhan la rigs par bya'o// zhes bshad pa'i dgongs pa 'chad pa na/ deng sang rtsod dus yin pa'i 'bum phrag bzhi bzla dgos par/ bla ma phal cher bzhed pa bzhin snga ma rnams la bzhi 'gyur bzlas na legs shing*/ bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg kyang bya'o// bzlas pa'i phan yon ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ bskal pa stong la sogs pa yi// sdig pa ma lus dag byed chu// zhes gsungs pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i dug gsum gyi dbang gis sgo gsum gyi mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga la sogs pa'i las nyon shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad dag pa dang*/ gong du bshad pa bzhin mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub la nye bar byed pa'i dgos pa yod do// de ltar thun so so la bzlas pa ci nus byas pa'i rjes su/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rten gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu nas 'khor rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams yum la/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar du 'dus te/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ngang las/ slar yang rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃ ljang gu rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/

ces bsgom/ kha zas kyi tshe chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos la/ oṃ sa ma ya shulka sarba sdarmā sa ma ya shulko+u haṃ/ lce hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gcig pa'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ a mṛ to da ka huṃ hūm̐ ṭha ṭha trāṃ aṃ khaṃ hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas thog mar lag pa g.yon pas blangs te longs spyad/ khrus kyi dus su dbang bskur ba dang gnyid kyi skabs su snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdu zhing*/ sad pa'i tshe rnal 'byor ma'i glus bskul bar lta ba la sogs pa'i spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor yang bya'o// de ltar sgrub pa po'i dam tshig la gnas shing rnal 'byor la brtson pa rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur te/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pa'i zhabs kyis/ dam tshig ldan zhing bla ma la gus dang*// sgom sgrub brtson la dngos grub thams cad 'byung*// tshe dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dpal dang dbang phyug gzi brjid las rnams 'grub// bstan bcos thams cad la ni mkhas pa dang*// rgol ba 'joms pa'i smra ba chen por 'gyur// rdo rje 'chang chen nyid kyang myur du thob// ces so// de ltar gsang sngags rgyud don rgya mtsho las// bskyed rdzogs don gnyis nor bu'i bcud phyung ba// rgya bod mkhas grub ded dpon las 'ongs pa'i// dpal ldan 'khor lo'i dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs// bka' brgyud 'di yi mkhas grub phal mo che'i// thugs nyam bzhes pa'i byin rlabs mchog gyur pa// gang gis bsnyen na dgos 'dod rmad byung zhing*// bdag gzhan don gyi 'bras bu mthar phyin phyir// bstan 'dir mos shing sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs can// rin chen dpal sogs don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis// ring nas bskul pa'i re ba bskang ba'i phyir// rnal 'byor spyod pa bdag gis bris pa'o// 'di la ma rtogs log pa'i dri mchis na// mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan mkhas grub bla ma dang*// bcom ldan 'khor lo'i dbang phyug btsun mor bcas// dpang gyur ye shes dam can rnams la bshags// rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu gang mchis pa// srid dang zhi bar mi gnas mnyam pa nyid// bdag gzhan zung 'jug lhan skyes mngon gyur te// srid pa'i 'jigs las 'gro rnams sgrol gyur cig

/bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog lhan skyes lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ don gnyis mchog stsol ces bya ba ni/ lcags pho khyi lo hor zla gnyis pa'i dus dge ba la/ zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa mchog gi sprul sku rim par phebs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ stod lung pa'i thig le las gzhis ka chen po bsam grub bde chen mthong smon du 'bri gangu ratha'i ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// (64)༄༅/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lnga mchod pa'i cho ga kun tu bzang pa'i dga' stan ces bya ba bzhugs// bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga mchod pa'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston ces bya ba/ bla ma dang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan lhan skyes thabs chen bde ba'i sku// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid yum dang bcas// zung 'jug bde chen gnyis med rab sbyor ba'i// lhag pa'i lha mchog 'khor lor bcas pa rnams// mchod cing bstod de tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir// rgyud dang gzhung 'grel man ngag ji lta bar// dpal ldan bla ma'i phyag bzhes rim pa bzhin// ma nor 'jug bde gsal bar 'dir brjod bya// de yang bdag gzhan gyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa la sogs dgos po rgya chen po don du gnyer ba'i blo ldan/ rdo rje 'dzin pas ji ltar bstan pa la som nyi spangs pa'i sngags pas/ mchod pa'i cho ga bgyi ba la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba'i rim pa'o/dang po la'ang gsum te/ yo byad 'du bya ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ ji ltar dbul ba'o// dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su byi dor legs par bya zhing rgyan dgram/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor dang rang gi mdun du g.yon phyogs nas brtsams te/ chu gnyis sam bzhi'i snod thod pa'am/ dung ngam/ zangs la sogs pa dang*/ ma rnyed na 'dab ma kyong bus kyang rung bar bshad pa bzhin/

mchod yon du mi'i rus pa'i phye ma dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ dri bzang pos sbyar ba'i chu dang*/ zhal bsil du til dang bdud rtsi lnga blugs shing*/ bsang gtor du rtswa ku sha zhabs bsil du nas dang 'o ma dang me tog dkar po dang ldan pas spras shing so so'i mdun du bzed zhal dang bcas pa la/ yi ge gsum dang*/ las thams cad pa la zhal bzhi pa'am/ dum skyes ma'i sngags lan bdun dang*/ yi ge bdun pa brgyad rtsa brgyad bsngags/ nyer spyod cing 'byor pa dag kyang phyag bzhes ltar bsham zhing*/ sdom pa 'byung ba las/ myos byed gtor ma med par las// myur du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// des na sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis// gtor ma rab tu bsngags par gsungs// zhes dang*/ myos byed btung ba'i bye brag rnams// dam tshig cho ga mchog rnams dang*// sna tshogs ro dang bcud rnams zhes 'byung la/ gtor ma dang tshogs kyi rdzas bza' ba dang btung bar bcas pa yang bsham/ lus kyi cha las byung ba'i nyer spyod kyi rdzas dngos su bsag par ma nus kyang*/ bdud rtsi a mṛ tas nyer spyod so sor bran na rdzas chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bar sems pa dpyad do/ gnyis pa ni/ mchod rdzas rnams sumā ni'am/ khaha ro he bsangs/ swā ༄༅ was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du zhes pa nas/ so so'i phyag rgya rol mo dang bcas pa bya'o// gsum la ni/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na/ bstod pa'i mchod pa dang bcas lnga/ dang po ni/ mchog tu gtsang zhing yi gar 'ong la sogs// yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mchod yon 'di// bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug btsun mor bcas/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod par bgyi// rnam lnga 'dod kor bya zhing rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas mchod yon sbreng la// oṃ shrī tsakra su ra sarbā bī ra yo gi nī basmra a0ཾ pra tībra pū dza me lnga sa mu tra hra ra na sa mā ye hūm̐ swā hā// zhes pa'i mthar se gol dang bcas pa bya'o// shin tu dag cing dri ma dang bral yang*/
lha rdzas dri bzangs dang bcas zhal bsil 'di// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dri nga sel

(66)ba'i phyir// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin stsol// g.yas khu tshur gyi mtheb 'dzub sbyar bas me tog gzung ste/ mthe'u chung nas bkrol cing*/ ādwa mā nam/ nyes pa'i tsha gdung kun tu bcil gyur kyang*// skye dgu'i gdung ba mtha' dag zhi slad du// rab tu sim pa bskyed pa'i gsang gtor gyis// dkyil 'khor lha rnams rtag tu mnyes par bya// bsang gtor byas te/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ sgyu 'phrul dra1$00001103lt;FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=13gt;<FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=83gt;1$0000270ྭ1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-83gt;1$0000270 ba dbang po'i gzhu 'dra'i sku// phra rab rdul gyis gos pa'i gnas min yang*// kun rtog bag chags dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir// zhabs bsil yo byad dag gis bsnyen bkur bgyi// g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi mtheb mdzub kyis me tog bzung la/ kha gyen du phyogs shing rol pa'i tshul gyi mdzub mo nas rim gyis bkrol te/ pa sngaṃ/ zhes pas bzed zhal du dbul lo// de nas phyi'i nyer spyod lnga dbul ba ni/ 'jig rten 'di'am 'jig rten gzhan dag na// chu dang thang skyes yid las byung ba yi// me tog rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// he ru ka dpal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// pukhyaṃ/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis de ltar sbyar zhing*// spos kyi shing dang lha yi bdug pa sogs// bdug spos rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// sdā paṃ// rin chen nyi zla sgron me la sogs pa'i// snang gsal rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// ā lo kaṃ /sbyar dang yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i// dri chab rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// gable/ bza' dang btung ba'i bye brag mtha' yas pa'i// zhal zas rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// nai wi/ glu dbyangs yid 'phrog du ma dang sbyar ba'i// rol mo'i rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// shapa1$00001103lt;FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=-293gt;<FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=233gt;1$0000270'u1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=03gt;1$0000270/
