zhes dang nang gi nyer mchod lnga ni/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis// rdo rje nyi ma pasgar byung*// me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa// rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min zhing*// lte bar gtum mo'i me yis ni// nges par bsregs pa de ni spos// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// yi ge hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal// mar me 'bar ba yang dag 'od// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// bde ba chen po'i gzhi la gnas// byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*// de nyid kyis kyang byugs pa dag /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod// dbang po thams cad yang dag brtan// de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje// bza' ba'i snod du mchod par bya// rdo rje pasga yang dag sbyar// zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*// rnal 'byor pa yi mi shigs sgra// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// sngags dang phyag rgya spyi 'gro ltar bya'o// rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las ā li'i phreng ba spros te lha mo rnams su sprul la mchod par gyur/ rdo rje lha mo pi wang brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog sngo// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// pad kor dang*/ g.yon khu tshur bsgreng ba pi wang 'dzin pa la/ g.yas kyi sor mos rgyud bskul ba ltar bya zhing*/ oṃ basmra wī ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bsdu ba bya/ rdo rje lha mo gling bu 'bud// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog ser// lag gnyis sor mos gling bu bsgyur tshul/ wang she rdo rje lha mo rnga chen brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog dmar// lag gnyis kyis rnga kha 'phred bstan brdung tshul/ mṛ taṃ ge rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog ljang*// thal mo gnyis rnga kha gyen bstan steng nas brdung tshul/

mu razwe/ bzhad pa rdo rje lha mo ni// dmar skya phyag gnyis bzhad dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par rol// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha phyir bstan ste kha 'gram du bzhag la/ hā gle/ sgeg pa rdo rje lha mo ni// sngon mo phyag gnyis sgeg dang bcas// rkang pa phyi ma gnyis sngar ltar sbyar te/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dkur bzhag ste 'gying ba'i tshul gyis/ lā gla= glu yi rdo rje lha mo ni// ser mo ting ting shags dang bcas// khu tshur gnyis mtheb mdzub so sor sbyar ba ting shags dkrol ba ltar byas te/ gī ti= gar gyi rdo rje lha mo ni// ljang gu phyag gnyis gar dang bcas// thal mo gnyis bskor zhing g.yas g.yon du gar bsgyur la/ smy-i te= mdog dkar rdo rje me tog ni// g.yas na me tog cang te'u dang*// g.yon pa thod pa khā*/ཾ ga /mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings mnyes mdzod// me tog ma'i rgyas/ pukhye= mdog mthing rdo rje bdug spos ni// g.yas na bdug spos cang te'u dang*// tshig phyi ma gnyis sbyar zhing*/ bdug spos ma'i rgyas/ sdā pe= mdog dmar rdo rje mar me ni// g.yas na mar me cang te'u dang*// mar me'i rgyas/ dī pe= mdog ljang rdo rje dri chab ni// g.yas na dri chab cang te'u dang*// dri ma'i rgyas/ gable= gzugs kyi rdo rje me long bsnams// dkar mo g.yas mtha' cang te'u dang*// g.yon pa thod pa khā*/ཾ ga /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// g.yon khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo gyen du bslang ba bzhag nas/ oṃ rū pa basmri/ ro yi rdo rje mkhar gzhong bsnams// dmar mo sogs gong bzhin// rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba zhal zas stob pa'i tshul gyis/ ra sa basmri= reg gi rdo rje na bza' bsnams// ljang gu= /gos zung 'bul zhing*/ spazhe basmri= chos dbyings rdo rje chos 'byung bsnams// dkar mo= bsdams pa'i mtheb mdzub dang mthe'u chung so sor rtse sprad/

sdarma sda༄༅ tu basmri/ zhes mchod cing rim gyis sa bon la bsdu'o// slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las sprul pa'i rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyis dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ so so'i sngags rgya dang bcas te/ gang gi mthu yis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpung*// ma lus mkha' yi lam du rgyu byed cing*// mi mthun phyogs 'joms rtsibs stong ldan pa yi// 'khor lo rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī tsakra su raṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī tsakra ratha pra tībra swā hā/ nyi ma'i 'od ltar rab tu 'bar zhing gsal// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mtha' dag thogs med du// bsams pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur ba yi// nor bu rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// ma ṇi ratha/ rab tu 'tshams shing mdzes pa'i gzugs dang ldan// bud med yon tan mtha' dag gis 'byor zhing*// yid bzhin reg na bde ba sbyin byed pa// btsun mo= pra/ི ratha/ rin chen sna tshogs gter la dbang bsgyur zhing*// dregs ldan gzhan gyis brdzi bar mi nus pa// rab yangs sa chen dpung gi mthus bzung ba'i// khyim bdag= gṛ haspa ti/ thal ka myos pa'i dri bsung dang ldan zhing*// mche ba drug ldan phun sum tshogs pa'i stobs// sa srung lta bur yud kyis bgrod pa yi// glang po=hasti ratha/ bai ḍūwa yi mdog can spu sdug cing*// dpag tshad du ma nyin bzhin 'khor ba'i 'gros// cang shes mgyogs 'gro kun gyi gtsor gyur pa'i// rta mchog= a shwa ratha/ tshan po che yi shugs ldan brtul phod pa// phyogs su rnam par rgyal ba byed pa la// kun tu mtshungs pa med par gyur pa yi// blon po= pa ri nā ya ka ratha/ zhes ri mor bkod pa'am/ phyag rgya spyi 'gro dang sbyar ro// slar yang 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te mchod par gyur/ mtha' yas zhing na gzugs kyi bye brag ni// mchog dman bar ma'i khyad par ci snang ba// bde ba chen po skyed par byed pa yi// gzugs kyi rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī tsakra sogs dang*/

rū pa kā ma gu na basmra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gzugs ma'i rgyas/ 'jig rten kun tu sgra yi dbye ba ni// zin dang ma zin la sogs ji snyed pa// grags stong sngags kyi rol par 'char ba dag /sgra yi rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// rol mo dkrol zhing*/ sha0/ rab 'byams zhing na dri yi rnam pa gang*// yongs su gyur dang de bzhin sbyar la sogs// rnam kun rdo rje'i dri brnyan dang ldan pa'i// 'dod yon lha mos rtag tu mchod par bgyi// dri ma'i rgyas/ gable/ dpag tu med pa'i gnas dang zhing khams su// ro yi khyad par rnam pa drug la sogs// zag med ting 'dzin zas mchog ster byed pa// ro yi rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// ro ma'i rgyas/ ra se kā ma/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rnams na reg bya'i tshogs// rnam pa du mar nyer spyad gzhi rnams kyang*// phul byung bde ba 'pho med bskyed nus pa'i// reg bya'i rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// gos zung*/ spazhe sogs dbul/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /basmra wā pa se pra tībra swā hā/ zhes na bza' yang dbul/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub thabs ltar nang mchod ltar bla ma yi dam chos skyong la dbul zhing*/ gsum pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ bltas dang rgod dang lag 'dzin dang*// 'khyud dang gnyis sprod sogs mchod pas// dbang bskur bar ni 'gyur ba dang*// rgyud rnams kun gyi don rtogs shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa basmra swā ༄༅ wa āb ko+uhaṃ/ 'khyud tshul bya ba ni/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas goms las// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa// de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// zhes bya ba'i don dran par bya zhing*/

lnga pa bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ta chos kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba med rtags su// sku mdog mthing nag cung zad sngo ba'i mdangs// byang chub sems dang stong nyid dbyer med pa'i// rtag chad 'gro 'ong bral la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i ngang*// bdud rtsi ro yi nges gang tshul ston pa// mchog la phan mdzad rdo rje phag mo dang*// gnyis med rol bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad pa'i tshul// phyag g.yas rdo rjes rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod// phyag g.yon dril bus dngos por 'dzin pa spong*// snang stong dbyer med 'khyud la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten spyod grol dbu skra gyen du bcings// ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan// chos nyid thugs chud rdo rje'i thag pas rgyus// yul dang yul can dbyer med khyod la bstod// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pasga'i gdan// byang chub myu gu smin mdzad nyi steng du// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan// ma rungs tshar gcod mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgrib gnyis sreg mdzad me dpung nang na bzhugs// nyon mongs gdung sel zla ba phyed pas spras// 'phrin las bzhi yis sems can don mdzad phyir// sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan la phyag 'tshal bstod// yid bzhin re skong nor bu gtsug na mdzes// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya drug /mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pa'i skur gsal ba// mi bskyod dbu rgyan can la phyag 'tshal bstod// spang bya spong zhing gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir// stag gi pags pa mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// bdud bzhi 'joms phyir rno dkar mche ba gtsigs// thugs rjes 'dzum bcas khros la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa'i las bzhi dang*// lus tshor sems chos dran pa nyer bzhag rnams// dga' dang mchog dga' dga' bral lhan skyes bdag

/snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal// rtag pa la sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi// bum pa bzhi dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod// mtshams su mchod pa'i gzugs kyis gnas pa yi// thabs shes dbyer med de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang/ rkang pa brgyad kyis bstod par 'dod na/ oṃ/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// bskal pa chen po mtha' yi me lta bu// ral pa'i tshogs kyi cod pan bcings pa ste// mche gtsigs drag cing 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal// phyag ni 'od zer stong phrag 'bar ba po// dgra phra zhags 'phyar mdung dang khā*/ཾ 'dzin// stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'phyang bar mdzad// du ba mun chen mdog mtshungs sku la 'dud// oṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la ni phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum yum gzhan gyis mi thub rig pa'i dbang phyug che// 'byung po thams cad 'jigs mdzad kun tu 'bebs ma rdo rje chen mo nyid// rdo rje gdan ma mi pham gzhan gyis mi thub dbang mdzad g.yo ba'i spyan// dug kyang skem par mdzad ma 'jigs su rung ba'i khro mo gtsigs byed mo// skrag byed gsod byed rab tu 'byed par byed cing pha rol las rgyal ma// rnam par rgyal ma rmugs par mdzad cing rengs dang rmongs par mdzad pa mo// rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// de nas/ mdun bskyed kyi sa bon nam nā da las/ snying po dang*/ nye snying gi sngags kyi rnam pa thon pa las/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs spros shing*/ yang de nyid la thim par gyur/ zhes dmigs la/ snying po dang nye snying gang rung bzla zhing*/ 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe yang*/ 'khor so so'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi rnam pa thon pa sogs sngar bzhin byas la/ bzla ba ni dam tshig gi bzlas pa zhes bya'o// lag pa mchod cing tshogs kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bya ba ni/

lag pa g.yon pa bsangs sbyangs/ me tog dgod cing*/ lag mthil pasga 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ mdun nas g.yon skor du haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ zhes dang*/ mthe bong la sogs pa lnga dang*/ sen mo rnams la rim pa bzhin/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭ phaṭ haṃ rnams go cha'i dpa' mo dang dpa' bo'i rang bzhin bol du lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor sor mo me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba'i khams lnga lha mo lngar gsal bar gyur/ so so'i sngags la/ basmra pukhyaṃ pra tībra swā hā/ ne wi sngaṃ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rkang brgyad dang yi ge gsum brjod la/ sha dang zan sbrags pa res kyang mchod cing*/ bdud rtsi'i thigs gtor gyi rjes su/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes lag pa'i lha rnams rang la thim par gyur/ mchod rdzas de rnams tshogs kyi yo byad dang bsres la thabs shes kyi rdzas ji ltar tshogs pa/ stag gi pags pa la sogs pa'i steng du bkod/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas gnyis su med par gyur yan gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ tshogs mgron spyan drangs shing byin dbab pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// bcom ldan bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// sprul pa brgyad 'gyed tirti pa// pukhya ha ri'i dgon pa nas// dpal ldan grub chen nā ro pa// gro bo lung gi gnas mchog nas// rje btsun chen po lho brag pa// mthon mthing rgyal mo'i zur phud nas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la'i zhabs// dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa nas// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod nas// 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal// 'bri gung dpal gyi pho brang nas// rgyal ba'i dbang po ratha shrī// dag pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// bcom ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog

/nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// ma bzhin brtse ba'i mkha' 'gro dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas// bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong rnams// mos gus gdung bas spyan 'dren na// sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs mdzod la// rang bzhin dbyings nas sku bzhengs nas// sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren gshegs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas gshegs nas kyang*// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// sgrub pa po la dngos grub zhu// sa gzhi bkra shis mdzad du gsol// kye/ tshogs khang pho brang gzhal yas 'di// o rgyan gnas su byin gyis rlobs// 'dir tshogs tshogs mgron thams cad kun// dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs// rin chen la sogs sna tshogs snod// pasgā zwar byin gyis rlobs// bcud kyi tshogs 'khor rgya chen 'di// ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// 'bras rgun bu ram bcos pa'i chang*// shes rab ma da na mchod 'di// dbang bzhi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shog /ba la sha lnga 'bras khur dang*// thabs chen maṃ sa'i mchod pa 'di// rtog med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas chos sku thob par shog /dbang po lnga dang bcas pa yi// sna tshogs keng rus mchod pa 'di// bde stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas longs sku thob par shog /byang sems rkang dang khu ba zhag /ga ṇa raca'i longs spyod 'di// gsal stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas sprul sku thob par shog /zho sha la sogs dam tshig rdzas// padwa a mṛ ta mchod 'di// dam tshig bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas bslab gsum don rtogs shog /bu raṃ la sogs mngar gsum dang*// dkar gsum a0'i mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas skye med don rtogs shog

/'dod yon phyi nang gsang mchod rnams// rigs lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas 'khor dang myang 'das kyi// yon tan rin chen thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dkar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// bde chen sku ru 'gyur ba'i rdzas// spyad pas rin chen chos sku la// nyams rtogs dbyer med 'brel gyur cig /mnar sems zhe sdang 'khrug pa kun// byams pa chen por 'gyur bar shog /brjod pa āḥyi 'od zer gyis// 'dod chags las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dmar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// 'gag med gsung sgra sgrog pa'i rdzas// spyad pas gsung dbyangs drug cu yis// gdul bya ma lus tshim gyur cig /zag bcas bde ba'i nyams myong kun// zag med bde bar 'gyur bar shog /brjod pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// gti mug las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// mthing la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// gnyis med chos skur 'gyur bar shog /spyad pas sems rgyun ye shes lnga// rgyun chad med par 'brel gyur cig /rmongs shing ma rig gti mug tshogs// 'od gsal chen por 'gyur bar shog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// rtog bral bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor 'di// lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la sogs// dus gsum bde gshegs dpa' bo dang*// phyi nang mkha' 'gros bzhes su gsol// a la la stai dgyes par mdzod// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa yis// bdag cag 'dir 'dus thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs// ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// sems gnyis med chos skur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum ma thob bar du yang*// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa yis// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol// nang gi bar chad nang du sol// mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// ces brjod cing*/

tshogs phud gtor mar phul te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong la gtor ma so so'i gzhung ltar btang*/ las kyi rdo rjes ma da na'i snod lag pa g.yas pas bzung*/ g.yon pas ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ mthong ba'i chos ni dag pa la// med do snyam pa'i rtog pa thong*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// lhan cig gcig pa nyid du gsol// zhes brjod cing*/ slob dpon nas rim par drang ngo*// len pa po rnams kyis kyang*/ g.yon pas phyag rgya de nyid dang*/ g.yas pas blangs la/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral zhing*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de nyid la ni gus pas 'dud// ces brjod/ de nas bza' ba la sogs pa dbul zhing*/ thog mar lag pa g.yon pas blangs te longs spyod/ rtsod pa la sogs pa bag med pa'i spyod pa spangs la/ rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa'i bsam pa bya ste/ rdo rje'i glu yang dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu mngon brjod las gsungs pa ni/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol// rnal 'byor ma mchog pasga'i bde// a la la la la la hoḥ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma tshogs mchod par mdzod// a i' a ā ra li hoḥ rab dgyes mgon po dgyes bzhugs mdzod// mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde ba gsol// dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod// zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa// bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol// thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod// a la la la la la hoḥ /bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur// bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol// bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas// chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur// bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod// pasga rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis// bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod// ces brjod cing*/ bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan// nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni// 'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob// phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig

/ces smon lam btab/ slob dpon gyi lag pa gnyis mthe bong dang*/ mdzub mo rtse sprad/ lhag ma brkyang ba kha yi thad du bzhag la/ chang gi kha phru de'i dbus nas lhag ma'i steng du btab nas/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi ubrisnga ba liṃ ubrisngā k+ṣu ཿswā hā/ zhes brjod pa'i 'byung po 'chol pa rnams la sbyin no// snod bshal ba'i chu shin tu lhag ma la dbang ba'i yi dwags rnams tshim pa'i ched du dor ro// dkyil 'khor bsham pa dang 'brel na mchod bstod bzod par gsol cing gshegs su gsol nas shis pa brjod pa sogs kyi chog lta bya'o// bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha dbang phyug rnal 'byor mar bcas mchod pa'i cho ga 'di// don du gnyer ba 'ga' yis yun ring nas// bskul ba'i re ba bskang phyir 'bri gung pa// ratha'i ming can gyis bkod dge gang gis// 'gro kun bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// sgrib pa gnyis byang dpal ldan he ru ka'i// go 'phang bla med myur du 'grub gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga mchod pa'i cho ga kun tu bzang pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis stod lung bsam grub bde chen gyi gzhis kar bris pa'o// lan gcig zhus pa'o/

(74)༄/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad nyang lugs kyi thig rtsa rgyud lung thun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ zhi khro sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ skal ba dang ldan pa gang dag smin grol gyi lam la 'khod pa'i phyir/ thig gi cho ga cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang gnyis las thig ring dang man ngag gi thig go /dang po ni/ bcu drug thig spyi ltar btab/ rtsa thig nang gi sgo tshad bzhi so sor gtubs la/ bcu drug char dkrol/ de re re yang cha bzhir bgos pa'i tshangs thig gi gzhogs phan tshun du/ dkyil 'khor nang ma rnams kyi sgo tshad sum cu so gnyis pa re re 'byung*/ de la dkyil 'khor so so'i cha dang re'u mig dgu pa'i gdung gi dbye tshul ni/ lte ba nas cha chen dgu bskor ba ni dbus kyi khor yug lcags ri la nang du de'i cha chung gnyis bcad/ de'i phyi rol g.yas g.yon dang mdun rgyab tu cha chen re re bsnol ba'i thig gi ni (75)rdo rje'i gdung mig mangs ris su bris pa'i le'u tshe dgu pa 'byung*/ gdung gi phyi mtha'i tshangs stengs nas cha chen dgu'i bar gyi tshad ni/ phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba yin/ de nas cha chen dgu bskor ba ni/ yang dag dang*/ gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ phur pa bzhi'i lcags ri'i phyi thig la nang du cha chung gnyis re bskor ba sngar dang mtshungs/ phyogs bzhi'i tshangs thig gnyis pa dang*/ zur thig phrad pa ni/ zur gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi'i lte ba yin lags/ de nas cha chen dgu mtha' dang phyed dgu bskor ba ni/ ma mo dang*/ rig 'dzin/ 'jig rten/ drag sngags bzhi'i 'khor yug yin no// phyi'i rtsa thig nang du nang gi sgo tshad gsum gyi thig gnyis dbye ba ni/ dbang phyug gi khyams chen yin la/ de'i nang gi cha chung gcig pa ni/

phyi'i gdung gru bzhi'o// dbus kyi dkyil 'khor spyi 'gro ltar thig gis phye zhing*/ phyogs mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi lte ba'i zur bzhi'i bya rjes su steng du mu ran la reg par bsnol te thig btab pas/ phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi zur thig dang*/ mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshangs thig gnyis pa rnam 'grub/ de la phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams gtso bo ltar dbye zhing*/ mtshams bzhi'i tshangs zur ma gtogs thig mangs rnams dbye la/ gtso bo la blta ba'i mu ran nang mar reg par phyogs bzhir thig btab cing*/ de la nang bses kyi thig btab tshul man ngag gi thig ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshangs zur gyi thig spyi 'gro ltar btab cing*/ dbus nas cha gnyis gzhal bar sgo tshad drug tu bgos la/ thig drug btab pa'i zur nas bskor/ de'i phyi rol cha chen phyed bskor la/ dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i bka' srung rnams 'khod pa'i 'khor yug dbus nas 'khor yug phyi thig bar tshad pa'i tshad kyis mtshams bzhir bya rjes steng du thig bzhi re'u mig tu gdab cing*/ phyi nas cha chen gcig bcad pas nang gi rdo rje gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su 'byung*/ slar yang phyogs mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i phyir/ dbus kyi gdung gi nang thig phyogs gcig gi tshad kyis phyogs mtshams dkyil 'khor brgyad po so so'i re'u mig ngos rnams snyoms par tshad pa'i mtha' thig gru bzhir btab cing*/ de'i phyi nas gdung gi tshad mnan pas phyi'i gdung bzhi 'grub/ phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi zur nas zur du brkyang ste thig bzhi btab pas/ phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi zur thig (76)rnams 'grub cing*/ zur gyi le'u tshe bzhi'i zur nas zur du lo bzhi gtub te thig btab pas/ mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi'i tshangs thig gnyis pa rnams 'byung*/ de dag gi bya rjes rnams su bsnol te brkyang nas thig btab pas phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshangs thig gnyis pa dang*/

mtshams bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi zur thig rnams 'grub/ phyogs mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rnams lte ba nas rang rang gi gdung nang ma la reg par bskor bas/ so so'i dam chen 'khor yug rnams kyi phyi thig dang*/ nang nas cha phran gnyis bskor bas/ khor yug gi nang thig 'byung*/ de dag dang zur thig 'phrad par ngos bzhir thig gdab pas/ mda' yab kyi phyi thig dang*/ nang gi chas dbyes pa'i thig drug rta babs rim bzhi'i rtse mo mchod rten gyi dbyibs su dkyil 'khor dgu kha la 'gres shes par bya'o// phyi'i gdung gi phyogs bzhi'i lte ba'i sgo tshad gcig bcad de gru bzhir btab pas phyi'i gdung 'khor lo'o// de'i phyir sgo tshad gsum bcas de ngos bzhir gdab pas/ dkyil 'khor phyi'i khyams chen dbang phyug gi sa/ de'i phyi thig nas lte ba'i bar chad bzhi'i bgos pa/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i sgo tshad re re ste/ 'khor lo'i brgyad cha sgo tshad de// zhes pa'i don/ lha snam phyi ma nas sgo tshad gnyis spar ste/ rang chas bgos pa'i phyi'i thig drug rim bzhin gdab/ rta babs spyi mthun glang rgyab rdo rwa dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ thig drug gis zur nas bskor ba'i phyi rol du cha chen phyed kyi bskor ba dkyil 'khor phyi'i mu ran la bka' sdod kyi sa/ de'i phyi nas cha chen phyed bskor ba pasga'i rwa ba/ de'i phyir cha chen gcig phyogs mtshams kyi phye ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyir cha chen phyed 'khor lo'i rtsibs stong phrag gi sa/ de'i phyir cha chen phyed bskor ba rdo rje'i rwa ba/ de'i phyir cha chen gcig bskor bas 'od zer 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba'o// dkyil 'khor nang ma rnams kyi dbus su/ cha chen gcig dang de'i nang du cha chung gcig bskor bas lte ba dang rtsibs gdan/ de'i phyi nas cha chen gcig dang*/ nang nas cha phran gcig bskor ba/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang mu khyud/

rtsa thig nang gi tshad bar 'khyams gnyis dang nang gi gru bzhi ni gru chad bzhi'o// zhes pa 'di yang rang nyid kyi brjed pa gso ba dang*/ don gnyer rnams la phan pa'i phyir du/ 'bri gung pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis lcags mo phag gi lo sa ga zla ba'i nyer lnga pa spro lung bla brang gi dbang ldan pho brang du bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni ngag gi dbang po'o// lan gcig zhus so/ masbalam/ (77)༄༅/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub chen dang sman sgrub kyi nyams yig dmar byang zin bris bzhugs so/ ༄༅/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud// bka' brgyad sgrub chen phyag bzhes kyi// lag len dmar khrid zhal shes kun// nyams su blang ba 'di ltar bya// slob dpon mtshan nyid bcu ldan pas// slob ma snod ldan zung min la// rgyud dbang sngon song bsnyen pa bya// de nas sgrub chen gang byed kyang*// thog mar yo byad bsags pa ni// dben gnas mthun rkyen mdzoms pa ru// phyi nang sgrub khang tshad ldan nang*// dgra bsrung mtshon cha bgegs bsrung rdzas// nad bsrung sman dang 'tsho bcas bsag khyad par dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i rdzas// 'chams chas gar chas ging chas dang*// bsnyen rdzas sgrub rdzas dbang gi rdzas// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas dang*// bskang rdzas thun rdzas dam tshig rdzas// tshogs 'khor yo byad rgyas par bsag /de nas yon mchod chos zhu rnams// thams cad tshogs la 'di ltar bya// tsha tsha chu gtor sbyin bsreg dang*// gsung rab 'ur 'don mdo bsgrub bya// lha bsangs gser skyems rgya rngan btang*// de nas zhub can dmag dang ni// khro ging rnga rol thun sogs kyis// phyi nang bgegs bskrad rdzas bdug btang*// de ltar log 'dren tshar bcad nas// phyogs bzhir tho rtsig rgyal chen mchod// sgo drung sri mnan sgo byang gdags// yang na sri mnan ma byas gong*// nang du log la sa chog bya// ma ṭaṃ bsgral la thig chog bya// slob dpon lha dang slob ma dang*// bum pa dkyil 'khor la sogs pa// sta gon rim pa skabs bstun gyi// rdul tshon byin brlab dkyil 'khor bri// bzhengs grub yig brgya nyer gcig bar// bskor zhing dkyil 'khor chad lhag nor 'khrul gsos// de nas dkyil 'khor rgyan dbul ni// makri dgu yi lding khri'i steng*// rgyan ldan bum pa dgu yi khar// mtshan ldan thod pa 'brus bkang bzhag

/srog rten dgu dang rang rang gi /tsa ka li dang dam rdzas gzhug /mar me dgu dang phur pa dgu// shel rdo hūm̐ yig de bzhin no// yang na lha grangs phur pa rnams// de rnams sku gsung thugs yon du// 'phrin las rten du shes par bya// steng du gdugs dang bla bres brgyan// tshangs pa'i rmu thag thog steng drang*// ldeng khri'i 'og tu mazwi'i khar/ dpal gtor dgu dang sman raka bsham// shar du sman dang lho ru baṃ// nub tu tshe dang byang du phur// mahal rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar// yang na dbus su sman khang bzhugs// gzungs thag rdo rje so sor then// gtso bo'i dpal gtor shar du bzhag /dkyil 'khor gra bzhir tshe 'bar gyi// zhun mar bzhi yang bzhag par bya// phyogs bzhir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi /gtor ma bzhi dang las gtor rnams// so so'i gnas su bsham par bya// gtsang phur nyer brgyad zhi sogs kyi/ gdab phur brgya rtsas tha ma bskor// de nas phyi nang gsang mchod rnams// rgyas par bshams te g.yas su bskor// mda' brgyad gri brgyad me long brgyad// dar dpyangs tshon skud sna lnga yi// drwa bas phyogs mtshams khyab par bya// las phur bcu yang sgrub khang ngam// dkyil 'khor phyogs mtshams steng 'og gzugs// de nas stag sham sgab bskor sogs// sgrub yig gzhung bzhin ci dgos rnams// mdzes par gsham pa phyag len yin// khyad par dur khrod rdzas brgyad dang*/ dpal gyi chas bcu la sogs pa// dbang rdzas bye brag phal cher rnams// gang 'dzom dkyil 'khor phyi nang du// rang rang gnas su bzhugs pa yin// de la dgos pa ci yod na// dkyil 'khor phyi nang rdzas rnams kun// sgrub rdzas rten rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas/ /bskang rdzas byin brlab dbang bskur rdzas// kun kyang dam tshig rdzas su gsungs// ting 'dzin dag kyang de bzhin no// de nas mnga' dbul rtags bstod bya// yang na las bsgo'i skabs su gsungs// de rjes sgrub sgo'i phyi logs su// gru gsum mtshan ngan thod pa ru// cho ga bzhin du dam sri mnan// drag po'i bro brdung zil gnon bya// de nas phyi nang sgo byang gdags// mchod bstod gtor 'bul bka' bgo bya// de rjes khro ging la sogs thun// rdo rje slob dpon las slob rnams// chas gzab phyi nas zhu len dang*/

khrus byas nang btang 'cham rngam bya// gral bsgrig me tog bkye bsdu dang*// rgyu 'bras chos bshad mahal dbul// gal te rgyun dbang bskur dgos na// skabs 'dir slob ma sta gon bya// phyag rgya rkyang cig dkyil 'khor du// sang ni dbang bskur bya bar gsungs// de yi rim pa mi dgos na// bzhag la dkyil 'khor rgyan dbul bya// de nas rdo rje slob dpon sogs// skyems drangs mnga' gsol las bgos bya// de nas bsnyen sgrub dmigs pa 'bogs// skabs 'dir tshogs 'khor dga' ston bya// nyin mtshan ring thung skabs bstun pa'i// thun bzhi thun drug gang byed kyang*/ tshad gzungs (chad) len bar bar du/ /nyul le bskrad cing sgo byang bsgrog /gar chas sprad la dkyil 'khor mthar// glu gar rol mo sna tshogs kyi// mchod bstod byas la byin chen dbab// de tshe sgrub po gzhan rnams kyis// drag sngags so lnga rtsa bgrang*/ khyad par rnal 'byor nus ldan gyis// khro bcu'i srung 'khor rgyun tu bsgom// gzhan rnams bsnyen sgrub dag la 'bung*// gal te bying 'thibs dpa' zhum na// nga rgyal bskyed cing 'dzab bro bya// res 'ga' bag grang byin chung na// dam rdzas myang zhing rgyan gos gzab// glu gar rol mos byin chen dbab// de sogs las sbyor gegs sel gces// nyi shar phyed yol nam gung sogs// tshe sgrub tshe 'gugs dag la 'bad// nam langs bsangs mchod rgya rngan btang*// gra lnga gser 'od rgyun tu sgrog /dkyil 'khor byang ngam byang shar du// rnam 'joms bsgrubs la khrus chog bya// grib sel dag la 'bad pa gces// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs dus// bsnyen sgrub kha bskang yig brgya bgrang*// nyin gsum mtshan gsum thun drug tu// cho ga'i gzhung bsrang tshogs 'khor bya// rdo rje glu bro gar 'cham gos// spro na skabs 'dir bya bar gsungs// ha cang spyod rtsing mi bya'o/ de yi rim pas nyin mtshan 'da'// snga dro dgong zas spyod lam dus// nang du 'dzab rgyun mi gcod cing*// gzhan rnams zas spyod grub pa dang*// 'khar rnga sogs kyi brda sbyar nas// sgrub sgo'i drung du tshogs pa dang*// rnam 'joms chu yis khrus byas nas/

khro ging la sogs 'cham rol dang*// gu gul dud pas bgegs bskrad la// dkyil 'khor bskor zhing gral bar nyul// slar yang phyir don khro ging 'chams// gzhan rnams rol mo dbyangs bcas kyis// gtor 'bul bya zhing sgo byang gyer// de nas dkyil 'khor bskor ba sogs// sngar bzhin yang yang bya ba yin// de yis rigs 'gres zhag grangs ni// bdun sogs nyer gcig tshun chad du// bsgrubs pas grub rtags byung ba'i tshe/ (chad) sgrub dbang zhu ba ni/ rdo rje srin po'i nam langs dus// slob mar bskur ba'i cho ga bzhin// rdo rje slob dpon bdag 'jug cing*// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes la sogs// grub chen gzhung bzhin phyag len dang*// dbang chog che chung nang bzhin du// zhabs gdams snyan rgyud kha bskang nas// dus bzhir phyogs bzhir dbang bzhi bskur// rgyal tshab dbang bskur 'os rigs dpyad// dbang re la ni tshogs 'khor bya// de bzhin sgrub dbang lhan thabs su// sman gyi skabs su sman dbang bskur// de ltar baṃ dang tshe la sogs// rang rang skabs su shes par bya// yang na so sor bskur kyang ni// 'gal ba med pa bla mas gsung*// dbang bskur rim pa kun grub nas// tshogs 'khor la sogs dga' ston bya// de nas dngos grub blang chog ni// rang rang gang 'dod dngos grub rdzas// 'dod yon longs spyod so sor bsam// glu gar rol mo la sogs kyis// silki zhu ba'i dus skabs su// dngos grub rdzas rnams so sor sbyin// de yi rim pa kun grub nas// bskang ba sbyin sreg la sogs pa// phyi nang tshogs gtor rgyas par 'bul// gal te rkyen bzlog bya 'dod na// khro rol rgyas bsdus gang rung ni// skabs 'dir bya ba bla mas gsungs// de yi rim pa kun grub nas// de la dpon slob thams cad kyis// mar me thogs la dkyil 'khor bskor// smon lam gsol btab rgyas par bya// de nas gtaur tshogs lhag sogs// de nas las gtor tshogs lhag sogs// sgrub khang steng thog ci bde bar// dar phyar dung 'bud gtor gshegs bya// de nas nang du dkyil 'khor la// btang rag mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya// nyes bshags bzod gsol yig brgya bgrang*// ye shes brtan bzhugs 'jig rten gshegs// bkra shis rab gnas gang grub bya// de nas las phur bcu la sogs// dbang ldan mtshams nas rim pa bzhin// dkyil 'khor bsdus la bsgrub rdzas rnams// slar yang sa stegs kha ru bzhag

/bum bskor bya zhing dngos grub blang*// de nas dngos grub cha lngar bgo /cha gcig bla ma cha gcig gzhan// cha gcig yon bdag cha gcig ni// las 'dzin rnams kyis thob pa yin// cha gcig dkyil 'khor sa stegs 'og /yang na dben par gtor du sba// de nas dkyil 'khor sa stegs khar// sna tshogs rdo rje g.yung drung ris// bris la slob ma thams cad kyis// gos bsdu khri brtsig bla ma bzhugs// mnga' dbul rgyan gsol brtan bzhugs bya// bkra shis rdzas dbul bkra shis brjod// phyag 'tshal yon dbul bka' drin zhu// dga' ston tshogs 'khor rgyas par bya// de nas phyi nang sgo byang bsdu// nang mtshams bkrol la ci bder bya// de nas phyi mtshams bkrol ba ni// rdo rje slob dpon 'khor dang bcas// chas gzab rnga rol gar 'chams sogs// rgyas par byas la gtor ma dang*// btang rag mchod 'bul rgyas par 'bul// tho bsdus phyi mtshams dgrol bar bya// gal te bstan 'dzin (81)slob ma la/ chos bka' yongs rdzogs ma grub par// dkyil 'khor mi gshegs bskang bshags dang*// dus babs skabs su tshogs 'khor bya// khrid lus rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor bsdu// gzhan yang bye brag shes par bya// sman sgrub lag len zhal gdams ni// skam rlon sman bsdus khrol bur bsgrub// mtshan bzang gsang yum rig mar bcas// sman btag phye ma zhib par bya// mngar gsum 'o mas sna grangs chu// bskol la bran te gar sla'i tshad// bcangs pas mi zhig tsam du bya// nam zla dus bzhi'i skabs bstun pa'i// tsha grang snyoms par byas pa la// nus ldan phabs phye legs par bsre// de nas grangs 'jal srang la bteg /kha sbyor thod pa mtshan ldan nang*// gzhug la rgyas gdab dkyil 'khor dbus// sman khang nang du gzhug par bya// dar zab g.yogs la mchod pas bskor// bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad bskyed rim dang*// byin dbab gzungs thag rdo rje 'then// bsnyen sgrub dmigs pa gnad du bsnun// phyi nang gsang ba'i grub rtags tshad// byung nas tho rangs nam seng dus// sman dbang bskur la dngos grub blang*// de sogs sgrub chen phyag len ni// rang rang gzhung du gsal ba lags// zhal shes snyan rgyud man ngag dang*// bstun nas nyams len mkhas pa yi// khyad (chad)lags te e ma ho/

de ltar bka' brgyad la sogs pa'i// bla med gsang sngags bsnyen sgrub tshul// bla ma'i gsung rgyun ji bzhin du// gang shar yi ge bris pa la// chos bdag rnams kyis bzod par gsol// dge des 'gro kun smin grol shog gcig zhus so/

(82)༄༅/ sbyang ba'i sngags la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba pazwa a mṛ ta ra sa ya na ta na dza ya gu smya silki hūm̐ hri thaḥ stong tsho bsdus pa'i sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ stong bai ro tsa na ā+oṃ mūṃ sda tu shwa ri/ basmra pa twa hūm̐/ laṃ khye sha ra ti/ ratha su traṃ/ maṃ mo ha ra ti/ aṃ a ro li ka sāṃ rā ga ra ti/ a mo lnga silki ha/ tāṃ basmra sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya stā/ stong*/ oṃ sarba padwa amṛ ta basmra tsing sa ma ya hūm̐ḥ stong tsho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba padwa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hri thaḥ bdud rtsi dbab sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba padwa a mṛ ta pra we sha ya pra we sha ya/ pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hrī thaḥ stong*/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hū+u+om̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba padwa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī thaḥ ci mang oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba padwa a mṛ ta smya ski wa hu lu hu lu' blā bla hūm̐ hri thaḥ srid pa dbang du gsol ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ a ho su ka dar ma ka ya a mṛ ta sisdi hūm̐ hri thaḥ lan gcig zhus so/ masbalaṃ/ (83)༄༅/ bsam yas su bde gshegs yongs 'dus kyi lung bdag 'jug gi dus kyi dag snang bzhugs so/ ༈ e ma ho/ tham thum gnyid kyi rmi lam du// rten med mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings// bum pa lnga tshogs nang dbus nas// chu rgyun kha dog lnga ldan byung*// phyogs mthun khyab cing rang cag kun// 'thung zhing 'khru ba rmi bar gyur// nyer gcig mtshan dus rmi lam du// sang nyin ji ltar 'byung ba ltar// chos skyong chen po byon pa ni// lan gsum bar du gsal bar byung*// phyi nyin mchod rten sngon po po'i gzhogs// chos skyong byon pa'i zhal ras ni// byu ru lta bur dmar ba mthong*// chos skyong dag gis bskul ba bzhin// thugs sgrub dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste// bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i nyi shar dus// dkyil 'khor dbus kyi rnam rgyal bum// thog mar 'od phung 'bar ba gsum// gong 'og brtsegs mar 'dug pa yi// 'og gi dbus su gza' bdud dang*// g.yas su e ka tsa ti ma// g.yon du gnod sbyin chen po gsal// bar du rdo rje gzhon nu ni// phyag

(84)gnyis phur bu sgril ba la/ sras mchog rigs bzhis bskor ba dang*// rtse mor rje btsun pasga dbang*// rnal 'byor grub chen bzhi yis bskor// yang ni dum tsam snang ba 'gyur// 'og gi dbus su phyag bzhi pa// g.yas g.yon bya rog tsan ḍi ka /dbus su rta mgrin g.yas g.yon du// mkha' 'gro dkar dmar gar stabs bsgyur// steng du gu ru thod phreng rtsal// g.yas g.yon ḍāki dkar dmar gnyis// yang ni dum tsam snang ba 'gyur// gar bsgyur mgon po legs ldan la// chos skyong du ma tshogs par ldan// dbu la rdo rje gzhon nu dang*// gsar rnying yi dam du mar bcas// steng du rdo rje drag po rtsal// yum dang bcas pa rgya bod kyi// rig 'dzin rje 'bangs bcas pa rnams// mngon sum nyams kyi snang bar shar// rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba la// bzang ngan 'dzin rtog yid dmigs kyi// rten 'brel nyams 'di e ma ho// lan gcig zhus so/ masbalaṃ/ (85)༄༅/ dug sngags gser gzung ma zhes pa'am dug bsrungs gser mdog can zhes bya ba'i gdams pa zab mo bzhugs so/ ༈ gu ru ratha dzī wathi rā dza shrī' dra ya na mo/ dpal ldan 'chi med dbang po nī la'i mdangs// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad gzhil bdud rtsi'i gter// dug lnga'i stobs 'joms bcom ldan sman gyi bla// bai ḍu'awa yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'dir dug rigs thams cad kyi gso bsrung*/ sa steng 'dir zab pa gser gzung mar grags pa 'di la/ ji ltar brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ gdams pa dngos so// dang po la yang gnyis te/ bka' ma dang*/ gter ma'i rgyud lugs so// dang po ni/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i che ba 'byin pa dang*/ gdams pa 'di 'byung ba'i don du/ lha dbang phyug chen po'i phyag g.yas pa las/ sbyor ba nag po dug rlangs kyi mkha' 'gro lnga ru sprul nas btang bas/ de rnams kyis dug rigs mi 'dra ba stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis/

nang pa'i bstan pa la 'tshe bar gyur pa na/ kha che'i rgyal po lha cig thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des/ thugs dam sangs rgyas sman gyi lha la nyin mtshan dus drug tu mchod cing gsol ba btab pas/ ston pa nyid khye'u sngo sangs lo bcu gsum tsam lon pa 'od dang bcas pa gcig sprul te/ rgyal po la khyed nyin mtshan 'di tsam du nga 'bod pa'i don ci 'dod/ ces gsung ba la/ rgyal pos/ bdag nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la/ phyi rol mu stegs pa'i sbyor ngan gyi dgra dar bas/ 'di dag zhi zhing sos par bya ba'i phyir du/ 'phags pa la mchod cing gsol btab pa lags/ zhes zhus pas/ khye'u'i zhal nas/ skyes bu dam pa bsam pa de lta bu ni legs so legs so/ khyed kyi bsam pa 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ bdag gi zhal nas sngags gser gyi yig 'bru/ nad thams cad zhi sos zhi 'joms zhes bya ba 'byung gis/ des dug thams cad zhi bar byed pas rin po che'i snod zed cig gsung ba dang rgyal po rab tu dgyes nas/ rin po che gser gyi gzhong pa gzed pa dang*/ khye'u'i zhal nas dug sngags 'di gser gyi yig 'bru tu chol gyis skyugs so// de nas rgyal pos 'phags pa la btang rag gi mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ dug sngags 'di thugs su chub par mdzad de/ dug rigs mi 'dra ba stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sos par mdzad do// de la augriya'i rnal 'byor pa 'chi med rdo rje zhes bya bas/ gser srang brgya dang*/ dngul bre lnga mu tig sogs mang po phul nas zhus te/ des kyang dug nad mang po zhi bar mdzad do// de la bla ma suwa ha ris gser srang drug cu glang po che'i mche ba/ bse ru gcig rnams phul nas zhus shing*/ des kyang mang po dug nad las grol bar byas so// de la kha che khri stan gyi pazhi ta sa mu tra rasmris gser srang bcu/ glang chen mche ba gcig lug bcu phul nas zhus te/ 'ga' phan par byas so// de la ston pa mu na kyis/

tshos ltang bzhi/ gser srang brgyad/ dngul bre lnga/ stag gzigs lnga/ bur tshos ltang bzhi phul nas zhus shing*/ 'gro ba la phan gtags so// de la btsad po so tsa yis/ gser srang bco lnga dang*/ rta gcig phul nas zhus te/ kho rang la dug lan brgyad cu byung ba bzlog go de'i sras po bkris rtse zhang zhung gis btson du bzung ba la/ sngags 'di thud sgong gi nang du bcug nas bskur bas/ dug lan sum cu so gsum byung ba bzlog go khong gis gdams ngag 'di dar za 'og gis dril te gces spras su mdzad do// de'i mchod gnas skyo ston nyi mas mdzad pa la yon gzhan ma bzhed par/ gdams pa 'di dang rta gcig phul te/ 'di gzhan la med pa'i ngo mtshar che bar dgongs/ thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ dbyar thog gcig la dug lan gsum byung ba bzlog go /de la stag chung bas zhing re re la khal bcu gnyis re 'gro ba'i zhing khal brgyad/ khang pa ka bcu legs pa gcig khal dor gcig bong bu gcig sogs/ mkho dgu tshang ba'i gzhis gcig phul nas zhus pas/ khong la dug ro gcig yod pa thon par grags so// rjes su tsha bo gcig gis dug theng bzhi btang ba brdugs shing*/ gzhan yang lan mang du byung ba bzlog go /de la dge bshes rgya chu mig pas gser gyi nya mo gcig zangs drug ma gcig gser srang bzhi phul nas zhus pas dug lan mang du byung ba bzlog go /de la sman pa nya chung gis rta phyugs gnyis pa bzang 1$0000110?1$0000270gcig nas khal brgya tham pa/ re'u phrug bcu phul nas zhus so/ khong la chos sde'i ston pa gcig gis/ ja dang chang dang khur ba la dug sbyar te drangs pa gsum ga bzlog go khong na re mang po rang yang ma bzlas te/ nyin zhag phrug re la brgya rtsa re bzlas pas mi tshugs par 'dug gsung*/ nyang chung bas la stod du phyin pa la/ khams pa dge 'dun bya ba la grogs po gcig gis dug btang ba sos pas/ yon du dngul bre gcig gser srang brgyad/

dar yug gcig 'bul/ slar gser srang lnga dang*/ ja gcig dar yug gcig rnams phul nas gdams pa 'di zhus/ khong gis bla ma dmar rgang ba bya ba la/ bde mchog dgyes rdor sogs dbang mang po dang*/ gzhan yang chos mang du zhus nas/ btang rag du gdams pa 'di phul bas/ bla ma dgyes nas gzhis chung gcig gnang*/ bla mas gdams pa 'di la thugs rtsis che bas/ khong la bstan bsrung zhes bya bas/ gdams ngag zab la mang ba zhig phul zhing*/ khal brgya thon pa'i zhing gcig g.yu legs pa gcig ras phrug gi cha mdzes gcig dang*/ zhabs tog bzang bar bshams nas zhus te/ 'gro ba mang po la phan par byas so// de nas rim par brgyud de/ zung mkhar paṇa chen sdarma swa mi'i bar du brgyud pa ni/ bka' ma'i lugs so// gnyis pa ltar na/ bsam yas kyi lha btsun sngon mo zhes bya bas/ o rgyan pa'i slob dpon chen po pasga 'byung gnas kyis lung bstan pa'i skyes bu de nyid la gter kha mang po'i lde mig phyag tu byon pa la/ pu hrangs kyi btsad po so tsas nang blon gcig la/ lhor a tsāwa grub pa brnyes pa gcig yod 'dug pas/ de la mchod rdzas 'di rnams phul gsung ste/ gser srang bcu/ mu men gyi chos gos gcig bse khrab gcig dngul khrab gcig rta rgod ma yo ma gnyis/ seng ldeng gi sga snga ru rang gug tu yod pa dngul gyis btums pa gcig ke'u tse lcang dmar gcig rnams bskur nas/ bdag la dug thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa'i gdams ngag gcig zhu zhing*/ de las gzhan yang gdams ngag ngo mtshar can 'ga' yang zhu lags/ zhes zhus pas/ lha btsun dgyes nas bsam (88)yas dbu rtse'i rnam snang gi gtsug tor nas/ shog dril gsum spyan drangs pa ni/ dug sngags kyis gsad pa dang*/ skye ba 'khor los bcad pa dang*/ 'bud dung la sngags bris nas bus pas ser ba bsrung ba dang gsum bton nas/ rgyal po la bskur bas so tsha par grags so// dus gcig na zhang zhung gi dmag lhags te/

rgyal po dkrongs shing*/ de'ang sras bkra shis rtse yang mtshon gyis dkrong bar nye ba na/ jo bo na re/ de'i dpe med zer nas/ khyung tshang brag dkyil du bskyur te dug gis dkrongs par gros byas pa nang blon las a tsa ras thos nas/ bsnyad pa na/ dug sngags 'di thud gong gi dkyil du bcug ste bskur bas lhas thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ dug rigs sum cu so gsum byung bas ma tshugs par/ da mtshon gyis gsod pa'i lugs med ces btson las dkrol te btang ngo*/ de phyin gyi brgyud pa ni snga dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa gdams pa dngos la/ bsrung ba dang 'gred dang*/ gso ba dang*/ zhi byed phran bu bstan pa'o// de la thun mong ma yin par gces pa gser gzung rin po che gang zhe na/ oṃ ka li ku ku ri haṃ 'uṃ'u dzu wa te se tan tī sa/ 'a ka 'uṃ a nī sa: pa ri kaṃ 'uṃ ī sa: gaṃ lu sdi'i sa: ra ha ra le 'uṃ sdu k+ṣi swā hā: srabā rī sa: la ri ka ri a mṛ ta ka ri: sa ri na ho: ma hā sde ho: ni la na kan ta: to hor tsad ta rī sa: na sdisī sa: zhes so/ 'di'i dag yig ni/ yig 'bru brgya dgu tshig 'bru bdun cu rtsa drug gi gu bcu dgu/ zhabs kyu bcu/ rna ru lnga 'greng bu gsum/ brtsegs pa nyi shu/ klad skor bdun/ tsheg bar bcu gnyis rnams yod pa la/ klad kor thams cad ni nga kho nar bklag gcod tshams ni tsheg bar gyis shes/ ring thung thams cad kyi gdangs ni slob dpon gyi gsung las shes so// gso bsrung gang dang gang la'ang*/ gong bsnyen gal che bas/ rgyal phur 'dzoms pa nas bzung ste/ bkra shis dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad la/ zhag bdun bsnyen pa bya/ sngags bzla dus thams cad du bsrung bya ni/ 'tsher pa/ lce rtse/ sgo nga*/ sgog pa'i rigs mi za/ yug sa la mi reg go dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid sman rgyal khye'u lo bcu gsum tsam lon pa'i na tshod bzhengs pa'i tshul can/ sku mdog sngo sangs ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/

phyag g.yas u ra gser mdog dang*/ g.yon rma bya'i sgro chun bsnams pas sems can thams cad kyi dug nad sel ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sman rgyal gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rang la bstim la sngags bzla'o// de ltar bsnyen pa them nas/ dang po rang gzhan bsrung ba ni/ lto stong dang dogs pa'i sar zas bza' khar sngags nyer gcig re bzlas pas/ rang la dug gi gnod pa thub bo// bsrung ba ni/ mthing shog gam/ dar sngon po la gser gyis sngags rnams lhag chad med par dbu can 'phreng gcig byas la tshag med du bri/ ma 'byor na shog bu gang rung la mtshal lam rgya snag gis bris la/ byug pa'i rdzas ni/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi gzhog srub ka'i 'bru yung ba 'gron thal bzhi po snag tsha la sbyangs te bsre/ rab gnas bya thabs ni rang stan bde bar kha shar du bltas pa'i mdun du/ mahal bshams la me tog tshom bu bdun bkod pa'i steng du mazwi'i khar rin po che'i snod kyi nang du me tog spungs la/ de'i steng du bsrung ba bzhag ril shing dang thum shun na bza' sogs kyang gsham/ de'i mthar mchod pa rnam lngas bskor/ sman rgyal lam gong du bstan pa'i sprul pa'i khye'u ji ltar bsgom pa'i sku 'bur ma'am ri mor bris pa rab gnas can kyang bkram/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed gsal gdab bsnyen pa bya/ de nas mdun gyi bsrung ba bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin gsal btab pa'i gnas gsum gyi sa bon las 'od 'phros/ 'og min nas sangs rgyas sman gyi lha bde gshegs bdun dang bcas pa spyan drangs mchod pa 'bul/ bstod pa bya/ srung ba la ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs nas/ 'chang ba rnams la dug rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa las bsrung du gsol/ bskyab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas pa bsrung ba la thim par dmigs te/

bdun rnam dag dbul/ bsrung sngags dang rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ me tog la btab nas bsrung ba 'thor zhing*/ shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ de nas gzig mo mchu thur gyis bsham nas dril la/ dar skud dmar pos bcings/ de'i phyi gnam kha de'i phyi ta hūm̐ gis bcings la/ de a ru ra gser mdog che ba rus pa mkhas par phud pa mgo jug ma log pa'i nang du/ gser gzungs dbu zhabs ma log pa tshas bcas sam/ tshas med kyang rung ste/ dril shig dang bcas te gzhug de dar tshon sna lngas dril la/ phyi lkogs gang rung gis btums/ yig mgo gyen la yod par byas te/ bdag gzhan gang la gdags pa'i mgul gyi stong stong por sha drod dang ma bral bar bsrung ba zas za ba dang*/ gtam smra ba'i tshe 'gul ba tsam gyi dam lhod byas la gdags so// lag len 'di la dug bsrung gser mdog can zhes grags te yig 'bru ma byi'i bar du dug rigs thams cad thub bo// gnyis pa 'gred du byed na rta/ rkyang*/ ra dang gsum gyi sha grib skam byas la/ de la sngags mang du bzlas la btab te/ rang gar dogs (chad) bza' bar bya'o// des ni dug rigs thams cad 'gred par 'gyur ro// gsum pa dug gcong chen po zhugs pa 'don pa dang*/ sbyar dug byung na gso ba ni/ rin po che'i ka to ra'am/ snod gtsang mar gangs las byung ba'i chu (chad) nang du/ rdzas yungs kar 'jam la ldum bu re'u ral phyag rdor/ a ru ra rnam rgyal sman lha/ bong dkar sgrol ma dpa' ser gser thub tu bskyed/ 'di rnams thun re dar dkar gyis btums la gzhug dngul chu yang srang phyed las mi nyung ba btab/ dar gyis kha bkab/ de nas rang nyid sman lha sngar ltar bskyed pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin (chad) 'byung ba lnga/ rin po che lnga dang sman gyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas sngags chu la bstim/ rma bya'i sgro chun gyis nad thams cad byabs par bsams ma/

smra ba bcad nas sngags bzla zhing chu la btab/ sngags chu dus gsum char dang na gung la ster/ des dug nad thams cad dang por bsdud/ bar du gsaud/ tha mar dug ro thams cad steng 'og gang rung nas sbyong bar 'gyur ro// gal te gong gi sman rnams ma 'dzom na'ang*/ chu gtsang la sngags bzlas pas thub pa myong bas grub nges so// zhes mnyam nyid rdo rjes gsung ngo*// da ni dug nad shin tu zhen tshabs che ba la/ shin tu gsang ba las ches cher gsang ba/ zhal gdams las kyang ches cher zhal gdams/ snyan brgyud kyi nying khu ni/ gong gi dngul chu'i rdzas kyis dngul chu de nyid dang*/ gzhan yang rung ste/ zla phyed tsam mam nad ma drag gi bar du/ dngul chu la phud kyi sa bon tsam mam/ sran chung tsam re lag g.yon du rang gi mchil mas chos 'byung bsnol ma bris pa'i dbus bzhag de yi ge bam dmar por bsam/ g.yung yin na de ka ster/ rgod yin na sngags 'di lnga bcu bzlas/ srin lag gis mnyes la byin/ sngags ni dngul ngar sod/ mtshal ngar sod/ a te ho/ zhes so// de ma thag tu kun byed tshangs pa'i nor bu la sngags bzlas pa dngul chu'i bungs tsam gyis ril bu ster ba ni rma bya 'jing bsnol gyi sbyor ba zhes bya'o// des zla ba'i rgyud bskul/ sngags chu'i ngar bskyed nas/ nad thams cad bsdud gsod sbyong ba'i snga ltas su/ bong nga'i smon nad lta bu byung yang bskrag mi dgos/ gal te dbang ril bzang po gtong na'ang*/ dngul chu lag par mchil mas bshig pa dang lhan gcig mid/ lar 'di dbang ril la ma ltos so// nad thon pa'i rtags nges pa can ma byung gi bar chang gi rigs thams cad la 'dzem/ dkar gyi rigs la brten/ nya phag dang ma smin pa'i rigs rul sungs can/ snga gong nas mi 'phrod pa ma gtogs/ sha gsar tsho rdzud ran pa sogs thabs kyis btang*/ 'di dus grang ba langs pa'i rtags byung yang*/ phyi nas byug pa sogs byed pa las/ nang du drod bcos cher bya mi rung*/

mig ser ba sogs mkhris pa byer ba'i rtags byung na/ gur gum bzang po'i drungs chu la sngags btab la sbyin no// gzhan ni gtar bsreg gshal skyugs sogs sman dpyad gang yang mi dgos shing*/ 'di ka gcig thub kun gyi rgyal po bla na med pa gong na med pa ste/ tshe zad nges yin na ma gtogs 'dis 'tsho bar thag chod pa sngon (chad) 'o// zhes zur mkhar paṇa chen gsung ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ tsha ba'i nad rigs thams cad la/ khyi smyon gyis rmugs pa'i rma dang*/ kha rlangs kyi phog pa dang*/ sha dug dang*/ sman nad chen po langs pa sogs gang la'ang*/ gangs chu gtsang ma la sngags te byin pas myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// de lta bu'i gdams pa 'di/ yang na chos drin can gyi bla ma la 'bul/ yang na gdams ngag zab mo 'di nyid dang (chad) dang brje/ yang na 'gro don ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa'i mi la byin/ yang na gser zho la bteg pa'i srang gang bas mi nyung ba'i me tog byung na byin/ de las gzhan du sbyin par mi rung zhes/ bla ma drin can gyi bka' rgyas btab par 'dug pas/ gdams ngag gi gsang sgo ma 'chol bar/ snod ldan la brgyud de 'gro ba'i zug rngu sel ba'i sman du 'gyur bar smon no// de ltar dug sngags gser gzungs ma zhes pa'am ming gzhan dug srung gser mdog ma zhes bya ba bka' gter gyi brgyud pa gnyis ldan 'di ni mkhas pa chen po zur mkhar la thog pas mdzad pa'i yig cha la gzhi byas shing*/ kho rang gi lag tu'ang gdams pa 'di'i yig cha rnying pa bdog pas zur brgyan te/ bri bar bgyis shes 'bri gung bla sman skar ma'i ming can gyis yun ring po nas bskul ba las tsā ma ri'i ldom bu ba ratha'i ming can gyis/ gdan sa chen po'i bla brang khang gsar chen mor bris pa'o// gser gzungs rigs gcig la/ oṃ ka li ku ku ri haṃ hūm̐: 'u dzu' tisdanasdī' lngaṃ huṃ: a nī sa sdes kaṃ hūm̐'i sa: pha ri kaṃ:

hūm̐'i sa: na sdi'i sa: ha ra ha ra: me sdu k+ṣi: sa ha sranā rī sa: la hi ka ri: a rmita ka ri: pa ri na ho ma: ho sda ho na: la kan: to hor rtsa ri'i sa: naṃ sdi'i sa: ma hī sa: ka ro tsī sa/ ti ku li'i sa: sngags 'di la lhad bcug pa la bka' chad yong ste bka' ma dang gter ma gnyis gud gud zhus pa lags so// 'bru gcig gi yang lhag chad med pa yin no// zhes pa 'dug gong gi 'bru theb dang ni gong ma mthun bras che bar 'dug kyang*/ 'di yig cha rnying ma'i lugs so/ masbalaṃ//

(92)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi las byang log 'dren zil gnon bzhugs so/ ༄༅/ na maḥshrī gu ru ya mātra ka ye/ bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gyi 'phrin las sgom rim du sdebs pa/ log 'dren zil gnon ces bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ rnal 'byor pa gang zhig lhag pa'i lha 'di yi dam du bya bar 'dod pas dbang dang sgrub thabs rnams legs par thob cing*/ dam tshig la gnas pas mahal dang khrul 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba bshams pa'i mdun du/ mchod gtor gyi yo bya tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ bsgrub po rnams kha lhor blta stan bde ba la 'khod de nyams su blang ba la sngon 'gro dngos bzhi rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum du shes par byas te/ sngon 'gro cha (93)gsum skyabs sems bskyed/ bsrung 'khor mtshams bcad bshags byin dbab/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'o/ zhes pas dang po ni/ cha gsum gyi gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar sbyin la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐ spyi bor bde gshegs kun 'dus pa/ bla ma 'jam dpal rdo rje 'dzin/ skyabs yul gyur pa thams cad kun/ ma lus mkha' la sprin ltar 'khrigs/ bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha/ skyabs gnas dam pa thams cad la/ bdag dang 'gro rnams su 'di nas/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ hūm̐ kun tu bzang po bla na med pa yi/ byang chub mchog tu bdag gi sems bskyed do/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam byang chub sems/ tshul bzhin bdag gi yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ zhes gsum gyis sems bskyed/ bla ma lha tshogs bdag la thim/ dbyer med bde stong chen por gyur/ bsrung 'khor gsal gdab cing mtshams bcad pa ni/ oṃ swā ༄༅ wa shu sdaḥsarba sdarmāḥswā wa shu sdo+uhaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rgya zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas phyag mtshan gyi tshogs nang nas rim bzhin 'phros te/

phyi rol du gnas pa'i bsrung ba'i gur khang la me rlung skyi chad pa bskal pa'i rlung gi kyang gzhol zhig dang bral ba shin tu bsra brtan mi shig pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūm̐ stongs yang 'khor lo'i bla bres la/ 'og kyang 'khor lo'i sa gzhir brdal/ phyogs mtshams 'khor lo 'bar bas gtams/ ral gri 'khor lo 'bar ba'i mtshams las ma 'da' cig hūm̐ steng yang ral gri'i bla bre la/ 'og kyang ral gri'i sa gzhir brdal/ phyogs mtshams ral gri 'bar bas gtams/ ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshams pas ma 'da' cig hūm̐ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi brdal/ phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtams/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshams las ma 'da' cig hūm̐ steng yang be con bla bre la/ 'og chad pa sa gzhir brdal/ phyogs mtshams be con 'bar bas gtams/ be con 'bar ba'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig hūm̐ steng yag gtun shing bla bre la/ 'og kyang gtun shing sa gzhir brdal/ phyogs mtshams tun shing 'bar bas gtams/ gtun shing 'bar ba'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig hūm̐ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ zil gnon lha brgyad rngam pa'i sku/ 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje 'phen/ be con gtun (94)e yaṃ raṃ suṃ ke+u+uṃ hūm̐/ hūm̐ rgyud lnga yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid kyi nam mkha' la/ phrag dog gdug pa'i rlung nag 'khrigs/ zhe sdang rnga ma pa'i me 'od 'bar/ 'dod chags 'khrugs pa'i chad pa gti mug zhing gi sa gzhi brdal/ keṃ sa brtsegs pa'i ri rab stengs/ rdo rje rwa gur sa ra me/ smug nag 'khyil ba'i 'od lngar gsal/ e ā ka sha mahal hūm̐/ yaṃ karma mahal raṃ kwa la mahal ra raca kwa la mahal la/ sum su ti ti ra mahal/ keṃ ri ti mahal rak+ṣa tsakra ུུཾ bi shwa bi shulke smya na tsakra mahalu+uṃ*/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas/ mtha' dbus med par brdal ba'i dbyings/ phyi dang nang med gsal ba'i gzugs/

dur khrod chen po'i klong du 'khyil/ dbus su gru gsum mthing nag la/ phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi 'bar/ thod chen 'phreng ba rab tu brtsegs/ mtha' dbus med par khyams sgo bzhi mdzes/ mtha' ma gnam lcags 'bar bas bskor/ gdan gsal gdab pa ni/ ru tra ti ra baṃ ku ma ra ti ra baṃ sutha ni ti ra baṃ itha ye ti ra baṃ ak+ṣi ye ya ma ye ni ri ti wa ru ṇa ku we ra i shā ni smya sbya ye si thi wi+u+e ti ra baṃ ma he he mahal paṃ pasga mahal a tsagra mgra la hūm̐/ dbus su gtso bo bskyed pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong lha srin sde brgyad bdud dang srin po phyogs skyong ma he brgyad kyi brdzis pa'i khri/ pasga nyi ma zla ba brtsegs pa'i steng du 'byung ba nam mkha' gnas su dag pa/ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma dza ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes drag po'i sngags kyi rang sgra las/ sku rdo rje'i bdag nyid skad cig gi bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon sku mdog mthing nag dug ha la nag po lta bu/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs su bsgrad pa/ g.yas zhal dkar nas klu 'bum gsol ba/ g.yon dmar bas gnyan khri gsol ba/ dbus mthing bas sa bdag stong sde gsol ba/ zhal gdangs ljags 'gril khro gnyer g.yo zhing mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ spyan rtsa dmar po sdang mig bsgrad pa/ rmang ra dang ag tshom smin ma dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ bar mas ral gri tha mas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dang pos be con/ bar pas gtun shing*/ tha mas sdigs mdzub kyi sbrul zhags me dpung 'bar ba bsnams pa/

dbu skra khams nag gyen du brdzes shing thur du grol ba/ bdud dang srin po ru tra/ btsan dang rgyal po'i thod pa skam po lnga lnga'i nang khrag 'thung rigs lnga bzhugs pa la/ rin po che'i (95)shing sdigs mdzub 'phyar/ rlung mes chu yi rba klong 'khrug me dpung 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro/ drag po'i mtshams las gang 'da' ba/ rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya/ basmra rak+ṣal kro sda sk-i hā bi chad pa ra na raṃ phaṭa e raṃ kwa la raṃ/ hūm̐ rdo rje ri rab lhun po'i rtse brgyad na/ 'bar ba'i lha brgyad dbang chen bka' stengs na/ shin tu mi bzad gtum chen ha la'i gzugs/ gshin rje la ṭa ro yi dbyug pa 'phyar/ gang la 'dul tsinga'i 'phreng ba sbreng*/ phra man brgyad khri mang po'i tshogs kyis bskor/ bskal ba'i me ri smug nag 'bar ba la/ nam mkha'i khams kyang me yi 'khor los gtams/ me'i 'khor lo shin tu 'bar ba la/ rdo rje rgya gram 'bar bas mes gtor bas/ steng gi me lce 'bar ba 'og tu 'phro/ 'og gi me lce 'ched pa steng du 'phro/ shar gyi me lce 'ched pa nub tu 'phros/ nub kyi me lce 'bar ba shar du 'phro/ byang gi me lce 'bar ba lho ru 'phro/ phyogs kyi me lce 'bar ba mtshams bzhir 'phro/ 'tshams kyi me lce mched pa phyogs bzhir 'phro/ dur khrod mtshon cha'i me ri smug ring 'bar/ gti mug 'joms pa'i me ni sngon nag 'bar/ zhe sdang 'joms pa'i me ni smug nag 'bar/ nga rgyal 'joms pa'i me ni ser/ 'dod chags 'joms pa'i me ni dmar nag 'bar/ phrag dog 'joms pa'i me ni ljang nag 'bar/ dbang drag gdug rtsub me ni khams nag 'bar/ dur khrod me ri dgon pa'i sa phyogs nas/ mes gtor ba yis mtshams chad pa 'da' mi byos/ dur khrod me yi mtshams las gang 'da' ba/ rdul cha phra mo tsam du brlag par byos/ phaṭa raṃ ha raṃ kwa la raṃ trag raṃ khaṃ raṃ swā hā/ bgegs dang log 'dren lta la mi dbang*/ nyan la mi dbang sgrub la mi dbang*/

sgrub pa'i skal ba dang mi ldan pa su yang rung ste/ gnod pa byed pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig bshags pa bya ba ni/ paṃ pasga mahal la ma suwa mahal la a tsahal la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pasga nyi zla'i gdan la/ dbus su rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma/ g.yas su zhi ba'i lha tshogs/ g.yon du khro bo'i lha tshogs/ 'og tu bka' sdod chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ basmra sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ nyon mongs dug lnga'i dbang gis ni/ srog gcod rku dang log par spyod/ khro bo zil gnon lha yi tshogs/ khyed kyi sku la mthol lo bshags/ rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub dang*/ ngag 'khyal 'khrul pa'i tshig smras pa/ khro rgyal zil gnod lha yi tshogs/ khyod kyi gsung la mthol lo bshags/ brnab sems gnod sems log par bltas/ khro rgyal zil gnon lha yi tshogs/ khyed kyi thugs la bzod par gsol/ ma ga nyon mongs las dbang gis/ nyams chags 'gal 'khrul pa ci mchis pa/ khro rgyal zil gnon lha yi tshogs/ 'khor dang bcas la mthol lo bshags/ tshangs par phul yang bzod pa ma mdzad na/ dam can khyod kyi sgrib (96)par mi 'gyur ram/ ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ da'i 'khor na gnas pa'i lha srin la/ nongs chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod do/ mdun gyi lha tshogs bdag la thim pas/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med pa'i gzi byin dang ldan par gyur/ hūm̐ a la la ho/ 'a ga wan/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya phraṃ/ byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐ 'phags mchog thugs rje can gyi dus la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ dam tshig bskang ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub rtsol ba'i dus la bab/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ mthu chen mthu rtsal bcom ldan 'das/ byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das/ dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ dngos grub mchog rtsol bcom ldan 'das/

bdag cag las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phyi nang gsang sogs mchod pa'i pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ pukhye dkar mo me tog sna tshogs thogs/ sdu pe ser mo spos khang bsnams pa dang*/ snang gsal dmar mo me yi 'phreng ba 'dzin/ gable ljang khu dri yi dung phor can/ nai wi sde khra bo zhal zas ro brgya pa/ nam mkha' khengs pa'i lha mos kun nas mchod/ oṃ basmra pukhye āḥhūm̐/ sdā pe a lo ke gable nai we rgya de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa/ sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig oṃ basmra sha༁ āḥhūm̐/ babla rgya khyon yangs pa'i snod chen du/ sman dang rak+ṣa gtor ma'i nyes skyon kun/ yig 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis sbyangs byas te/ yon tan brgyad ldan bdud rtsi a mri ta/ rak+ṣa'i rgya mtsho zhing gi gnas 'phyo zhing*/ 'a ling gtor ma 'dod yon lha mor bcas/ rgyal ba mnyes byed mchod pa'i sprin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba padwa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hriḥ tha/ ma hā rak+ṣa kwa la sa mu dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liphya te kwa ba lin ta ba la ba te lngu he sa ma ye swā hā/ dngos bzhi gzhal yas lha bskyed cing*/ spyan drangs gsol phyag dam tshig/ phyag rgya mchod 'bul 'phrin las bcol/ bstod cing dbang rgya bsnyen pa'o/ zhes pa rnams las dang po ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐ ma lus rtog med chos kyi dbyings/ tha snyed kun bral byang chub sems/ dmigs med pa yi yul nyid kyang/ chad pa don la bsgom/ oṃ mā hā shu sbya ta smya na basmra swā ༄༅ wa ab ko+uhaṃ/ hūm̐ mkha' ltar dag pa'i ngo bo la/ yongs su dag pa'i rang bzhin can/ chu zla bzhin du snang ba yi/ ye shes 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ sdarmā sda༄༅ tu smya༄༅ na sa ma ya sdi hūm̐/ hūm̐ yod pa ma yin gzugs dang bral/ med pa ma yin cho 'phrul 'byung*/

gnyis med rang bzhin dag pa'i rgyun/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i hūm̐ du byung*/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs gsal btab pa ni/ (97)rtse bran gyi dbu la brgyan pa/ bdud dang dgra bgegs/ klu dang mu stegs kyi mgo dang tsinga'i 'phreng ba/ khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal byas pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ rak+ṣa'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris kyi sku la brgyan pa/ glang chen ko rlon dang zhing chen g.yang gzhi sku stod la gsol ba/ stag gis sags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu rigs lnga'i ngo bo/ sbrul kha dog lngas sku dang yan lag brgyan pa rdo rje'i gshog pa nam mkhar gdeng ba/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas rab tu mdzes shing brjid pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyi ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su/ stong gsum gang ba'i sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi gar bsgyur bas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon pa'o/ yum bskyed pa ni/ de'i g.yon phyogs su yum gsod byed bdud 'dul rgyal mo/ sku mdog mthing nag g.yas tsing khrag 'dzag pa bsnams nas/ yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon thod khrag zhal du stobs/ gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ spyan gsum thod pa dang rus pa rin po chais brgyan pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du 'khyil zhing*/ thur du grol ba la gser g.yu mu tig nor bu'i len phran gyis mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyi stabs kyis sku la 'khril zhing snyoms par 'jug pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba rgyas pa'o/ lha tshogs bskyed pa ni/ yab kyi thugs kar baṃ chen bsnol ba'i steng du/ sras mchog ya ma rā dza sku mdog smug nag g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon tsinga'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang rin po che dang rus pa brgyad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskul g.yon brkyang gi bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar dregs pa phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang nag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdig mdzub kyi tsinga'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/

zhabs gnyis brkyang bskums kyi pasga'i gdan la 'gying ba stag gi sham thabs/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ de'i thugs kar rus sbal rngam pa mi zan sku mdog ser po mgo thur du bstan pa/ mig gyen du gzigs pa/ yan lag drug la rang byung gi mchod rten drug rme ba khrag dang thig les brgyan pa/ srid pa gsum po lto na gnas pa'o/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu bya khyung rgyal po sku mdog dkar zhing 'tsher ba/ dbu la nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis sbrul bzung nas zhal chad pa ba/ zhabs kyi klu dregs byed ma rungs pa'i mgo lus mnan pa/ rā dang mchu sder gnam lcags las grub pa/ sgro gshog spu gri la me 'bar ba'i gshog pa g.yas pas khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ chad pa gsum phyag mas 'debs pa'o/ gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad bskyed pa ni/ 'jig byed 'bar ba'i phrag mgo gnyis na khyung nag gnyis khyung nag gnyis kha phyir bstan nas dug sbrul 'cha' ba/ sog phrag gnyis na (98)stag mo gnyis mgo phyir bstan nas mi ro za ba/ nu mtshan nyid nas dung gi seng ge gnyis kha phyir blta zhing ral pa gsegs pas gdug pa can rnams dpa' bkod bar byed pa/ sta zur gnyis na dug chad pa nas me 'bar zhing phyir blta bas dregs pa can gyi tshogs myos par byed pa'o/ bsrung 'khor gyi khro bcu bskyed pa ni/ de'i phyir rol phyogs mtshams steng 'og 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i gur khang du gyur pa'i bdag nyid phyag zil gnon gyi bo'i steng gi rtsibs nang bya khyung gi mdun du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sku mdog ser po g.yas 'khor lo g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum pasga'i gdan la 'gying ba/ rtsibs gzhan rnams la shar du hūm̐ kā ra/ shar lho dbyug sngon can/ lhor gshin rje gshegs lho nub mi g.yo ba/ nub tu rta mgrin nub byang du 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/

byang shar du khams gsum rnam rgyal/ 'og tu stobs po che/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bra sa/ g.yas tho ba dang*/ g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin zhing*/ khro bo gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong 'dul skal phyogs skyong pho mo bsgyel ba'i gdan la brkyang bskul gyi bzhugs shing*/ khro chung gi sprul pa dpag tu med pa rnam par 'phro ba'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ 'khor spro ba ni/ 'khor spro ba ni/ yab yum mkha' gsang byin brlabs shing*/ brdal bskum snyoms 'jug sbyor mtshams las/ ya ma me ta k+ṣe byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gsal/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ma tsa ya hūm̐/ sku gsum thugs kyi sprul pa gsum bskyed pa ni/ ya ma du sha hūm̐/ ya ma rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zla gam gsum la sku yi sprul pa tshe bdag du kha dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad/ phyag gong ma rnams kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams shing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyi gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ yum rak+ṣa srin mo gsod byed mo/ g.yas g.yon spu gri dang thod khrag thogs pa/ seng ge la chibs pa/ gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag sku mdog dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas bse mdung dang*/ g.yon phur pa/ 'og ma gnyis gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ yum bdud mo ri ma ti nag mo/ spu gri dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ dug sbrul kha nas dug rlangs 'phyo ba la chibs pa/ thugs kyi sprul pa 'chi bdag sku mdog nag po sbrul mgo dgu dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi khram shing dang sbrul zhags/ sbal nag dang nad rkyal/ tha ma gnyis gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ yum dus mtshan ma dmar mo spu gri dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ stags pa chibs pa/ gshed chen bzhi bskyed pa ni/ ya ma ra tsa hūm̐ ya ma rak+ṣa hūm̐ ya ma raka a hūm̐/ ya ma rak+ṣa hūm̐/ yab mum mkha' gsang dbyings las ni/ rtsibs bzhi srog gi gshed bzhi spros/
shar du ya ma ra tsa smug lho ru myos byed 'bar ba ser/

(99)nub tu awa dmar po dang*/ byang du ral pa tshar dgu ljang*/ kun kyang gcer bu zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis ro dbyug 'khor lo bsnams/ thod 'phreng sbrul dang dur khrod brgyan/ phyag nyan rak+ṣa dril bsnol dang*/ ye shes mkha' lding dbyugs len te/ yum rnams mkhyud thod khrag stob/ chu glang drel rte lug sbrul nag gzhibs pa'i gdan la rngams par 'gying*/ phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ mon pa bzhi bskyed ni/ dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo/ lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo rang rang sku mdog phyag mtshan bcas/ shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhir gsal/ bdud bzhi bskyed pa ni/ he la khyab pa shar gyi bdud/ nag po 'dzum med lho yi bdud/ nag po bskrag med nub kyi bdud/ so 'dar khrigs pa byang gi bdud/ bdud mo za byed yum bzhir bcas/ sku mdog rgyan chas rdzogs pa ni/ mtshams bzhir gnas te las byed 'gyur/ de phyir bcu gnyis rtsibs la ni/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis bskyed pa ni/ 'chi bdag dregs pa bcu gnyis tshogs/ 'jigs byed dregs pa'i cha lugs can/ 'jig chad pa pa dbang du bsdud/ ma mo mkha' 'gro bran du 'khol/ bla kun bshan pa las la 'gyed/ ging bco brgyad skyed pa ni/ 'obs chen rnam bcu drug la/ skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad ni/ rang rang sprul pa 'gyed/ kha gdangs khrag 'dzag stobs shugs ldan/ gang la dmigs pa dngos su sgrol/ 'khor gyi dregs pa bskyed pa ni/ phyi yi 'khor yug yangs pa la/ pho gshed sum rgya drug cu dang*/ mo gshed sum rgya drug cu dang*/ sha za drug khri drug stong sogs/ snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs/ sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nyar gsal/ spyan drangs pa ni de ltar gco 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bo oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag

khyad par gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar ma mthing nag ya ma'i thugs kar ya smug nag dregs pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ ljang nag rus sbal gyi thugs e ka ser nag byang khyung gi thugs kar khrom dkar po/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro bcu sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpag tu med pa'i tshogs dang bcas spyan drangs/ hūm̐ chos sku byang sems thugs rje'i ngang nyid las/ 'phags pa'i rgyal po khro bo gshin rje/ dregs pa thams cad shugs kyi bsgral ba'i phyir/ thugs dam dbang gi 'khor bcas sku skyod cig e ka pha chad pa ya hūm̐ dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ phyag rgya zil gnon yab yum 'khor bcas rnams/ sngon gyi thugs dam dbang gi 'dir gshegs la/ dur khrod yi dwags 'bar ba'i khri stengs su/ bdag dang gnyis (100)med brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ sa ma ya smya na de dza tispa lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku chen po las/ bdud 'dul khro bo'i tshogs kyi skur ston cing*/ thugs rje chad pa pas tshe bdud sgrol mdzad pa/ khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ ma skyes chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ 'gro ba'i don du khro mo'i skur bstan nas/ dmar chen 'bar ba'i gtso bo gnyis mdzad ma/ yum mchog brjid pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ ya ma rā dza phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rus sbal rngam pa bya khyung la sogs pa/ yon tan lha sku yi rgyan du rdzogs/ sprul pa gyad gnon tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'khor los bsgyur rnams par rgyal ba dang*/ dbyug sngon gshin rje rta mgrin mi g.yo rgyal/ 'dod rgyal bdud rtsi khams gsum stobs po che/ sprul pa khro bcu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ ye shes rgyal ba'i ngang las sprul mdzad cing*/ log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed/

gso pa'i las kun rdzogs mdzad ging chen po/ sprul pa gshed po 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ oṃ na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ a la la hoḥ dam tshig chad pa hūm̐ shin tu mos pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal nas/ dad pas rab kyi lha mchog khyod mi gtong*/ 'gro la phan phyir khro rgyal khyod bsgrubs na/ gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du brlag pa dang*/ yab yum 'bar chad pa bstan du gsol/ hūm̐ yab yum sku dang mnyam sbyar nas/ sangs rgyas zhing du rab bsgrubs pas/ khro gdug 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ 'phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐/ phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ dbus kyi gtso bo phyag rgya ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug sku mdog sku mdog mthing*/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ g.yas pa gsum na bsnams pa ni/ 'khor lor ral gri rdo rje g.yas/ g.yon pa gsum na bsnams pa ni/ be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub 'bar/ sku la 'khril ba'i yum chen ni/ sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba las/ g.yas pa snying thogs yab la 'khyud/ g.yon pa du dmar gtso la stobs/ yab yum gnyis su med pa la/ phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ tshe bdag nag po'i phyag rgya ni/ dbu dgu bco brgyad phyag dang ldan/ mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ mtha' gnyis gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor 1$00001103lt;FORMAT::REL_HORIZ_ADJ=-53gt;<FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=293gt;1$0000270 1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=33gt;1$0000270 1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-33gt;1$0000270 1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-83gt;1$0000270 1$00001103lt;FORMAT::ABS_VERT_ADJ=-203gt;1$0000270ka) kha la 'dir shog 'chi bdag nag po'i phyag rgya ni/ dbu dgu phyag drug sbrul zhags ni/ sbal nag nad rkyal phyag na bsnams/ tha ma gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor ga) srog bdag dmar po'i phyag rgya ni/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'jigs chad pa bse mdu phur pa dang po gnyis/

tha ma gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor kha) sku la 'khril ba'i yum chen rnams/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro bo'i tshul/ g.yas pa spu gris dgra srog gcod/ g.yon pa thod (101)khrag gtso la stobs/ yab yum gnyis su med pa rnams/ phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes/ ya ma rā dza'i phyag rgya ni/ zhal gc-ig phyag gnyis smug nag zhal/ g.yas pa ma ṭang ro dbyug phyag rgya nam/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar nag zhal/ g.yas pa ma ṭangaro dbyug 'phyar/ g.yon pa'i phyag na 'khor lo bskor/ sku la 'khril ba'i yum chen rnams/ sku mdog so so'i yab dang mthun/ g.yas pa snying thogs yab la 'khyud/ g.yon pa thod khrag gtso la stobs/ yab yum gnyis su med pa rnams/ phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐ bde bar gshegs sam gshin rje'i gshed/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyi/ srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ma lus lus pa med pa ni/ kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ oṃ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te+u+o bi shwa mu khe+u ཿ sarba thā khaṃ urta te hra ra na i bi gag na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a ha ra a ha ra basmra pukhye swā hā/ sdu pe a lo ke nai wi rgya sha༁ swā hā/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag pa yis/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ rigs lnga ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dngos/ rgyud lnga sems can ma lus kun sgrol ba'i/ nyon mongs dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ bla ma zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas/ dgyes par bzhes te sgrub mchog rnal 'byor la/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ shitraṃ gatsha khrag 'thung nag po la/ rnam dag sgrub mchog rnal 'byor la/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gtsug lag dpal dge ba su sda ra dang*/

sangs rgyas ye shes zhang khrom la/ rnam dag sgrub mchog rnal 'byor la/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ lcags gtun nag mo gtubs ston chos grags dang*/ gnubs chen bya bral basmra rā dza la/ rnam dag sgrub mchog grub stsol/ mchog dang thon mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sdarmā ke ru sdarmā ma ti'i mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gnam lcags me 'bar sdarma rā dza sogs/ bka' lung man ngag rgyud pa'i bla ma la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐ 'jam dpal thugs rje che ldan khros pa'i sku/ khro bo'i rgyal po phyag rgya zil gnon la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khro rgyal sku la gnyis med 'phrul ba'i yum/ bdud mo chen mo khrag gi ral can la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ (102)zil gnon yab yum bdud 'dul sprul pa'i sras/ ye shes khro bo chen po bcu rnams la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zin gnon yab yamu gnyis med rol pa'i sras/ phyogs bzhi gshin rje gshed po bzhi rnams la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zin gnon sku gsung thugs las sprul pa yi/ tshe bdag srog bdag 'chi bdag 'khor bcas la/

rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mon pa mon mo bdud pho bdud mo dang*/ phung byed srog gcod las byed lha rnams la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis ging chen bco brgyad sogs/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ma hā padwa mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang*/ dkar dmar mthing kha'i yig 'bru gsum gyis gtams/ mtheb srin nyi zla 'bar ba'i 'od kyis drangs/ ljags su ltar bas sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ 'jam dpal sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ hūm̐ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i mngon rol nas/ lha mchog khyed dang smon lam gcig pa'i mthus/ da lta zhal mthong yid dam lhar gsol na/ snying po byang chub mchog la mi gnas tshe/ tshe rabs 'khor bar gar skyes gar gnas kyang*/ dngos grub stsol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ka ya silki oṃ waka silki āḥ tsing silki hūm̐ tisnga basmra/ bsgrol mchod ni/ hūm̐ khrod rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon lha tshogs pa rnams/ thabs mkhas thugs rje shugs kyi 'gro ba sgrol/ sprul pa phra men tshogs kyi gnas nas khug dus gsum mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bdag la bstobs/ za byed pho mo rnams kyi dgra bgegs gsol/ sa ma ya padwa a mri ta khā hi/ raca khā hi ba su ta khā hi go ro tsa na khā hi hūm̐ 'jam dpal gshin rje yab yum 'khor bcas ma/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dgra bo'i klad khra a0ཾ sha chen po/ dbang po lnga yi me tog tshil chen mo/ bdud rtsi chen po'i bshol dang rol mo'i sgra/

dur khrod 'dod yon mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes/ oṃ basmra sa ma ya kro sda gu ru+u+o ཿ a0ཾ pra tibra swā hā/ sdā pe pra tibra swa hā/ sha༁ pukhye swā hā kwa la hrīḥye ye swā hā/ gable a a pa me ta ya swā hā/ 'i ṣā na sda ye swā hā/ dug lnga'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su/ zhe sdang rus dang 'dod chags khrag gti mug nga rgyal sha dang 'khris/ phrag dog glo snying nang khrol rngam/ khro rgyal tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol/ ma hā ba ling ta khā hi/ mang pa khā hi raca khā hi keṃ ni ri ti khā he/ raca'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ gdug pa'i mgo bcad khrag gis bkang*/ dmar chen rgya mtsho 'khyil ba 'di/ dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag dang bcas/ khro rgyal (103)tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol/ ma hā raca khā hi/ nongs pa bshang shing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hoḥye shes khro rgyal zin gnon yab dang yum/ khro bcu sprul pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ srog gshed yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos phyi nang gi mchod pa dngos su bshams pa dang*/ ma 'ar ba yid kyis sprul nas dbul zhing mchis na/ sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchog tu gyur cig khyod kyi spyan sngar bzod par gsol ba ni/ thugs dang 'gal ba ci bgyis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags so/ sku bzod par gsol te tshangs pa yid bzhin du rtsal du gsol/ dngos grub gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa la/ 'jig rten mthong ba'i chos 'di la/ tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang grags pa longs spyod dang mnga' thang*/ chos dang srid kyi rigs brgyud phun sum tshogs pa 'phel zhing*/ rgyas par mdzod cig khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bla man chad nas/ dngos grub kyi rgyu dang skal ba gang lag pa da lta nyid du rtsal du gsol/ 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor chad pa 'das pa sdang bar byed pa'i dgra dang*/
