gnod par byed pa'i bgegs dang*/ byang dmar gyi kyus la btab pa 'di dag nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ skye shi gnyis la khungs ma dbyung*/ las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa la snyad ma mdogs par/ las kyi rlung dmar gyi rgyab nas phul/ 'jigs pa'i mun nag gi mdun nas bsus/ dpal gyi chad pas chod dam tshig gi dmod mos sdegs/ mgo 'khor bar gyis shig khrag skyug par gyis shig yid 'khyug par gyis shig srog dang phrol cig sa ya ma btang cig ma shor cig bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ grub gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ glu 'bum nyi khri sa bdag stong gi gdan chos skyong dregs pa ma he brdzis pa'i stengs/ thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan stengs na/ chos dbyings ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ zhe sdang dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa'i phyir/ rdo rje khros ma sku la rnam par 'khril/ phyag rgya zil gnon sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐ chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ thabs kyi khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa'i/ ye shes khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku dag pa la/ bdud 'dul khro bo mchog gi skur ston pa/ thugs rje gzi ldan thabs kyi gdug pa 'dul/ klu bdud 'dul mdzad bya khyung dbu la bkod/ dregs pa 'dul mdzad thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs/ snang srid rus sbal thugs kyi rgyan du byas/ khams gsum dbang byed yum mchog za byed ma/ gshid so gshed mo sprul pa gya gnon tshogs/ sgrol byed gtso 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ mdun phyed zla gam

(104)'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ 'chi bdag nag po dbu phyag drug pa/ sbrul zhags sbal nag nad rkyal 'khor lo bskor/ sku sprul 'chi bdag sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ g.yas phyogs zla ba 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na/ tshe bdag nag po dbu dgu bco brgyad phyag rab 'jigs mtshon cha gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor/ gsung sprul tshe bdag sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ g.yon phyogs zla gam 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ srog bdag dmar po phyag bzhin 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ bse mdung phur pa gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor/ thugs sprul srog bdag dmar po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ shar phyogs smug nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ chu glang sngon po gzhibs pa'i gdan steng du/ me long ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ gti mug drag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa'i phyir/ dpal gyi phyag nyan sku la dgyes par 'khril/ pha ma ra dza'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ lho phyogs ser nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su/ drel rta rkang gsum gzhibs pa'i gdan steng na/ mnyam nyid ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ nga rgyal dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa'i phyir/ raca dri bsnol sku la dgyes par 'khril/ myos byed 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ nub phyogs dmar nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na/ lkugs pa lugs chen gzhibs pa'i gdan steng du/ kun chad pa ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ 'dod chags drag po'i rnams 'joms pa'i phyir/ ye shes mkha' lding sku la dgyes par 'khril/ awa dmar po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ byang phyogs ljang nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na/ dug sbrul nag po gzhibs pa'i gdan steng du/ nan tan ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ phrag thog gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa'i phyir/ phyag bsnyan dbug len sku la dgyes par 'khril/ ral pa tshar dgu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ dung lcags gso dang gser gyi mon pa bzhi/ gsod byed bshan pa bdud bzhi ging gi tshogs/ gsod byed dregs pa bshan pa sde 'khor bcas/

bstan bsrung pa dregs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyan drangs ye shes pa dang*/ dam tshig pa'i lha tshogs thams cad gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal ba khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i dkyil lo du spyan drangs/ yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas byang sems bab/ rang gi lus khengs lhag ma yar lud pa las/ he ru ka la rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ 'khor rnams la rang rang phyogs kyi rigs bdag gis rgyas btab/ sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa man chad dang*/ dregs pa kun la 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ rgyas gdab pa ni slar yang spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ skabs (105)'dir zhal gdams ltar bsnyen pa bya/ rjes ni byin brlabs spyan drangs shing*/ bskang bshags dgug bsgral btab lhag bsngo/ bstan bskyangs mnan pa gshegs gsol bsdu/ bsngo ba thun mtshams rnal 'byor ram/ zhes pa las dang po tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ swā' ༄༅ shulko+uho/ oṃ ba ling ta ba lā te smya sa ma ya swā hā/ hūm̐ 'og min chos kyi dbyings mchog nas/ khro rgyal zil gnon lha tshogs rnams/ rnal 'byor 'dod yon bde ba la/ dgyes pa'i tshul gyi gshegs su gsol/ basmra sa ma ya dza/ thugs dam bkang ba ni/ hūm̐ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ dang po lnga'i 'dod yon 'kho dgur ldan/ khro rgyal zil gnon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ hūm̐ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/ mdzes pa'i brgyan dang na bza' brgyan pa 'di/ 'bul gyis bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ bskang ngo tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang*/ yum chen rdo rje khro ru lha'i thugs dam bskang*/

sras mchog ya ma rā dza'i thugs dam bskang*/ dregs pa phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*/ rus sbal rngam pa mi bzan thugs dam bskang*/ mkha' lding bya khyung rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*/ khro bo brgyan gyi lha brgyad thugs kyi dam bskang*/ ye shes khro bo bcu'i thugs dam bskang*/ sprul pa rnam pa gsum gyi thugs kyi dam bskang*/ ya ma rā dza myos byed 'bar ba dang*/ āwa dmar po ral pa tshar dgu dang*/ dung lcags gse dang gser gyi mon par bcas/ 'chi bdag bdud po bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis ging chen bco brgyad dang*/ las gshin bdun brgya nyi shu la sogs pa/ sha za drug khri drug stong thugs dam bskang*/ bshags pa ni hūm̐ rang rig ye shes nyon dbang gi/ lhag chad nor dang mi gsal zhing*/ rdzas ma tshang dang byin ma rlobs/ khro rgyal tshogs la mthol lo gshags/ thugs rje che la mnga' bzod par gsol/ dag pa'i dngos grub stsol du gsol/ tshogs tha ma la dgug cing bsgral ba ni/ dza shar gyi phyogs nas bla 'gug pa/ dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo/ dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs/ phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsing dgu/ zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la brgyug spyan dgus dgra bo blta zhing 'dzin/ phyag dgu khongs nas tsing 'byin/ zhal dgu kha mngar med par gsol/ snying dgus dgra bo zhe la gnon/ ljags dgus dgra la mos shing gsol/ dgra bo'i bla dang rnam shes khug dza lho yi phyogs nas bla la brgyug lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs/ phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsing dgu/ zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la brgyug spyan dgus dgra bo blta zhing 'dzin/ zhal dgu kha mngar med par gsol/ snying dgus dgra bo zhe la gnon/ ljags dgus dgra la mos shing gsol/ dgra bo'i bla dang rnam shes khug dza nub kyi phyogs nas bla la brgyug bse yi mon pa stag gi mgo dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs/ phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsing dgu/

zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la brgyug spyan dgus dgra bo blta zhing 'dzin/ phag dag= zhal dgu kha mngar med par gsol/ snying dgus dgra bo zhe la gnon/ ljags dgus dgra la mos shing gsol/ dgra bo'i bla dang rnam shes khug dza byang gi phyogs nas bla la brgyug gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs/ phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsing dgu/ zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la brgyug spyan dgus dgra bo blta zhing 'dzin/ phyag= zhal dgu kha mngar med par gsol/ snying dgus dgra bo zhe la gnon/ ljags dgus dgra la mos shing gsol/ dgra bo'i bla dang rnam shes khug dza shar phyogs dri za me lha'i gtso/ he le khyab pa gtum chen 'thom/ dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du brlog dza lho phyogs gshin rje srin po'i gtso/ nag po 'dzum med gtum chen 'thom/ dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul brlog dza nub phyogs chu dbang rlung lha'i gtso/ nag po bskrag med chags med 'thom/ dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du brlog dza byung phyogs gnod sbyin 'byung po'i gtso/ so 'dar 'khrigs pa dregs chen po/ dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du brlog dza bdud mo yum chen za byed bzhi/ rim nad dug mda' dgra la brgyob/ ngan bsngags dmod pa khong du skyol/ bu yug skyin thang dgra la brgyob/ 'chi bdag dregs pa bcu gnyis so/ rang rang gnas nas las la bskul/ rim dang dal gyi bu yug rlob/ khrag mda' sngags kyi dug mtha' 'phen/ mtshon cha dbal gyi snying gzer 'bebs/ rngam pa'i drag sngags phyogs bcur 'phen/ nyi zla gza' skar du me sol/ theg ser skar mda' ltos ngan 'bebs/ sha khrag dod dang dbug la rel/ 'jig rten dregs pa dbang du bsdud/ ma mo mkha' 'gro bran du 'khol/ bla kun bshan pa las la 'gyed/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par bgyi/ ོུ bsgrol byed ging chen bco brgyad po/ bshan pa chen po srog gi gshed/

rngam byed 'thom pa snying rje med/ sha khrag drod brgyug cing rngam/ las kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed/ kha rlungs nad kyi dbal du shar/ lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams/ gang la dmigs pa sngon du bsgrol/ tsing dang ni chad pa khrom btubs/ rnam shes bskrag dang lus srog 'phrol/ sha khrag rol bstob cing za/ kha gdangs mche gtsig mche ba gtsigs/ rkang pa brgyug cing lag pa rtse/ skye 'gro kun gyi srog len byed/ kha nas khrag 'dzag myos shing rgyal/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ ma lus srog gcod gzir zhing gnod/ sdang dgra gnod bgegs rdul du rlog rings par khatsags la drag tu bsgrol/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ zhal du btab pa ni/ e mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ phyag rgya zil gnon zhal gdongs zhig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ bcom ldan sku yi g.yon rol nas/ rdo rje khros ma zhal gdongs shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ bcom ldan sku yi dkyil 'khor nas/ rtsa ba'i lha drug zhal gdong shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ bcom ldan sku yi dkyil 'khor nas/ rgyan gyi lha brgyad zhal gdong shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs bcu nas/ ye shes khro bo bcu zhal gdung shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ zla gam 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ sprul pa rnams gsum zhal gdung shig (106)sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi nas/ gshed chen sde bzhi zhal gdong shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas/ mon pa bzhi rnams zhal gdong shig

sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ thod mkhar 'bar ba'i mtshams bzhi nas/ gshed chen sde bzhi zhal gdong shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ rtsibs chen bcu gnyis gdan stengs na/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis zhal gdong shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab pa'i kha raṃ khā hi/ phyi yi 'obs chen bcu drug nas/ ging chen bco brgyad zhal gdong shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ gzhal yas khang gi sgo bzhi nas/ sgo ma rnams bzhi zhal gdong shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ las gshin bdun brgya nyi shu dang*/ sha za drug khri zhal gdong shig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi/ dgra bgegs sha ni za ba'i mchog gti mug sha yi mchod pa bzhes/ dgra bgegs khrag ni btung ba'i mchog 'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa bzhes/ dgra bo'i rus pa bca' ba'i mchog zhe sdang rus pa mchod par bzhes/ dgra bo'i glo snying sman gyi rgyu/ nga rgyal glo snying mchod pa bzhes/ dgra bo'i mkhris pa ja gad rgyu/ phrag dog mkhris pa mchod par bzhes/ 'di ni dug lnga'i mchod pa ste/ zil gnod lha tshogs bzhes su gsol/ ma hā mang pa khā hi/ ma hā raca khā hi/ ma hā tsing khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma shā peṃ ri ti khā hi/ tshogs drangs dang ba ni/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos/ 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*/ bram ze gdol pa khyi phag rje/ rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ blang ba ni/ bde gshegs chos ni rin thang med/ 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ a la la hoḥ lhag ma bsngo pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lhag ma'i 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ ya ma kadza ḍāki ni hūm̐ dza/

rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi/ lhag ma'i 'gron la gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu/ mkha' 'gro ging dang dbang phyug ma bdun srid bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa/ bya nag thang la lhags pa ltar spyan drangs/ hūm̐ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyud/ bcom ldan dpal chen phud la dgyes/ bar du tshogs kyi mi rten rgyu/ bdud dang gshin rje tshogs la dgyes/ tha ma lhag mas mi sbyin rgyu/ dpal chen bran g.yog lhag la dbang*/ lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu/ rje dang 'bangs nyams khyad par che/ rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyu/ chos kyi dbyings la bzang ngan med/ mchod nas las rnams mi bcol rgyu/ chos 'khor bstan pa bshig pa 'byung*/ hūm̐ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dal nas/ chad pa ldan dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon dang*/ yum chen za byed khros ma nag mo la/ sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa rnam gsum dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud bzhis bskor ba ni/ ya ma rā dza myos byed (107)'bar ba dang*/ awa dmar po ral pa tshar dgu dang*/ sprul pa rnam gsum mon pa bzhi la sogs/ gsod byed bshan pa sde bzhi 'khor bcas la/ brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul 'phrin las mdzod/ bcom ldan dpal chen zil gnon yab yum la/ ging bshan dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ ging chen bcol brgyad bshan pa srog gi gshed/ rngam pa 'thom pa drag po snying rje med/ lha srin sde brgyad sprul pa 'bum sder bcas/ chad pa ga za zhing rings par dgra la chos/ brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul 'phrin las mdzod/ ho dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon yab yum sras 'khor dregs pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad ba liphya khā hi/ ya ti gabra bstan ma skyong ba ni/ ho nag mo bzhin mi stug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi/ dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi/ dkar mo bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun chen mo bzhi/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor zhing gi rdul rnyed dang bcas pa/

dpal chen po'i bka' yi phab phab len pa dang*/ sgrub pa po'i gdong grogs la gnas 'dir gshigs shig oṃ a ra li hring hring*/ pheṃ pheṃ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ 'dir byon dam skongs 'phrin las mdzod/ bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje ya ma skyong*/ gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang*/ 'brog chen 'khor dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ bdud mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang*/ bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ 'dir byon dam skong 'phrin las mdzod/ gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang*/ gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje rlung mo dang*/ mkha' rig khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rtsal/ gnod sbyin chen mo khyed bzhi yang*/ bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ 'dir byon dam skong 'phrin las mdzod/ kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong*/ btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig la/ mo btsun u chos rdo rje g.ya' mo bsil/ g.yu yi rdo rje dril bu zu le ma/ sman btsun chen mo khyed bzhi yang*/ bra g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ 'dir byon dam skong 'phrin las mdzod/ rdo rje bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi/ sus ma bcol kyang zhal bzhes bzhin/ rnal 'byor 'khor bcas bskyang ba dang*/ chad pa bgegs bzlog pa dang*/ nad yams rim nad bcad par mdzod/ gal te bka' bzhin ma byas na/ rdo rje gnod sbyin khros nas kyang*/ snying gi dkyil nas khrag drangs nas/ sgrol ging mang pos las byed kyi/

(108)bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ ma ma la la le le ta ta te te sring*/ 'gro mu+o ba ling ta khā hi man na sa pa ni oṃ nan āḥnan/ dgra bgegs gnod byed staṃ' rak+ṣa ku ru nan/ bshags pa ni/ gang yang bdag rtog 'khrul pas kun bslad pa'i/ bskyed rdzaugs zab mo'i ting 'dzin don g.yel zhing*/ bzlas brjod cho ga ma dag rdzas ma tshogs/ rgyal ba'i thugs dang 'gal ba mthol zhing bshags/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ basmra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ de yang zhabs kyu khog pa/ mgo bo zla tshes/ thig le nā da'i bar du 'dus/ me long la ha btab pa bzhin/ dmigs med brjod bral chen por gnas so/ bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag 'jam dpal gshin rje 'grub gyur nas/ sogs dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam btab/ slar chad pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang*/ brten pa lha dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal ba'i/ rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar lus thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab zhub lubs su gyur/ oṃ truṃ zhes gnas su bka' nan bya zhing*/ chad pa na oṃ/ basmra ak+ṣo+u hūm̐/ ratha saṃ' traṃ pasga sda ra hrīḥ a mo lnga silki ādza zhes rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan par mos/ basmra phaṭa a pa su+i ni hūm̐/ zhes dar mthing dmar gyi cod pan dang bcas te dregs pa'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon par bam la shis par brjod do/ spyod lam kun tu lus lha/ ngag sngags yid ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas bza' btung gang bad dgra bgegs kyi don snying sha khrag tu bsams la/ rus sbal rngam pa mi zan la gtad/ 'phrin las ni las kyi gshin rje la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi drag rtsal can rnams dal la bzhag cing bcol/

'bras bu ni gnas skabs su ban dgra ngan pa bsad pa la sogs pa/ las rab 'byams 'grub/ mthar thug chad pa la ye shes sems pa'i thugs stong nyid 'od gsal dri ma med pa rtag chad dang bral ba'i mchog tu grub pa la mnga' dbang phyug par 'gyur ro/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi las byang*/ log 'dren zil chad pa rgya ba 'di ni/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po ches mdzad pa las gzhi byas te/ blo dman rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ ngag 'khrigs su bkod pa 'di yang gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/ chos mdzad ngo mtshar grags pa sogs dang ldan 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba las/ 'bri gung pa ratha'i ming can gyis/ chu pho byi ba'i lo hor zla bdun pa'i zla tshes bco lnga la/ dpal 'bri gung gi sa yi cha/ gzho chad pa bde skyid smon pa thang gi sgar du bris pa 'dis kyang*/ snying po'i bstan pa rin po che la/ logs par blta ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar chod cig sisdaṃ/ lan gcig zhus so/ masbalaṃ/ (109)༈ phyag rgya zil gnon gyi bsnyen bsgrub kyi yig chung gud du bkol ba bzhugs so/ /skabs 'dir zhal gdams ltar bsnyen pa bya zhes pa ni/ bdag nyid 'jal dpal gshis rje gshed kyi mgur gyi bum pa nas/ zhabs kyi long bu yan chad rdo rje'i go khrab dre mig thams cad khro bo mtshon gang pa lcags sol mal nas bton pa lta bu/ g.yas med yi 'khor lo// g.yon rlung gi 'khor lo bsnams nas/ zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i las byed par gyur// gco bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpal gshin rje'i gshed smug nag zhal gcig phyag nyis g.yas be con/ g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can rgyan med pa/ pad zla'i gdan la khro tshul brkyang bskum stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de bsnams pa/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pasga dkar po'i steng (110)du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nas 'bru tsam gyed du bgreng pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag spu bris pa tsam/ de'i klad kor gi nang du rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs pa/ zhabs kyu'i nang du bsrung bya gnas pa/ rang gshin rje gshed kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po la awai rings dkar po g.yas su bskor ba/ mgrin par āḥdamar po la awai ring dmar pos g.yon du bskor ba/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag la/ awai ring mthing khas g.yas su bskor ba/ de rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag nyid la thim pas/ thugs rje'i byin brlabs zhugs te/ kun 'dus gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur/ yang de rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas bde ba la bkod/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad la phog tshar bcad/ 'od zer tshur 'dus de dag gi mthu dang nus pa thams cad bdag nyid ma thim pas bskrag dang gzim mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros bsrung bya thams cad la phog lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab gyon pas gnod byed gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skyabs 'og tu tshud par 'gyur/ slar yang lha dang sngags kyi 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i phyi rol steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du/ me tog gi rwa ba gcig la cig 'brel gyi tshul du gnas pa'i pasga re re'i steng du bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis thams cad sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/

sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dpag tu med pa'i sna las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i dpag tu med pa 'phro ba la yang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba zhal nang du gzigs nas bzhugs pas bsrung ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de yi phyi rol du rje'i gur khang stug rngams dang ldan pa/ yang 'od zer 'phros pa de'i phyi rol du ral gri'i gur khang rno ngar dang ldan pa/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de yi phyi rol du rdo rje tho ba'i gur khang brtul phod dang ldan pa/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de (111)yi phyi rol du gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu dang ldan pa gnyis kha sbyor du gnas pa'i/ stong ma g.yas su 'khor bas/ byad ma dgra bgegs pho rigs thams cad sgrol ba/ 'og ma g.yon du 'khor bas/ chad pa ma dgra bgegs mo rigs thams cad bsgrol ba/ kha sbyor bsnol mar 'khor bas klu gdon rnams sgrol zhing gnod byed rnams mya la gtub pa/ de'i phyi rol du bskal pa'i me'i gur khang rab tu 'khrugs pas gnod byed bgegs thams cad rab tu chad pa / de'i phyi rol du bskal pa'i rlung gi gur khang rab tu 'khrugs pas gnod byed bsregs pa'i tham ba phyogs bcur gtor ba/ de'i phyi rol du bskal pa mun nag mthibs pa'i gling chen po/ de'i phyir rol du stong pa sgra'i gur khang*/ ā li kā li'i sgra di ri ri bsgrog par gyur/ de'i ngang las bdag dang snang ba thams cad 'jam dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed sgyu ma gzugs kyi sku grags steng sngags kyi rang sgra dang bcas te/ gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas bzla'o/ awai awai awai a kro te ka ya mān ta ka ya ma ye ā+oṃ/ kā la tū pa ka pā ye āṃḥ hrisngi a pa ye hūm̐/ a ā ne u ne du du ne du ne a ī u ai au aṃ ra ṛ ma li ngu ru yai bya tsa yai setra yai hri ta yai

'i ta yai mu ka yai u ū ne u ū ne wi kri ta na a a na na ya ma rā dzā ya ma radza ya ma raka a ya ma raka k+ṣa bai ta li kro di shwā ri ma mo e ka tsa ti de mā kā baṃ ril ru lu ru lu shrī basmra kro sda ya ma kadza/ ro ṣa ṇa kro ta radza mon ta a hūm̐ dzaḥ brgya dang zhe dgu'i tshig bar can ai ring rnal ma ste bsnyen pa'o/ bstan pa gshin pa'i ban dgra bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan pa byed pa'i stobs dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ smyo dang*/ ngan sngags kyi dbal dang*/ kho yi lha bsrungs dang bcas pa myag thum ril sarba sha truṃ trig nan/ sbur yang nan/ e hur thuṃ dza khang shag ro khyag yug ti rbad ya e e yaṃ yaṃ raṃ raṃ baṃ paṃ laṃ laṃ byad ma dgra bgegs lha bsrungs dang bcas pa mā ra ya rbad ya/ shaṃ bu 'byung sham dang bcas pa'o/ myag thum ril gyi mgor dgra bgegs gang la bya ba'i ming 'jug pa ni zhal las shes so/ de ltar bsnyen rub las sbyor gyi sngags ci nus bzlas/ hūm̐ rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus bdag la dgongs/ 'dir gshegs mchod sprin ye shes rgya mtsho bzhes/ chad pa pa kun bshags 'phrin las rgya mtsho sgrubs/ dngos grub kun rtsol ro ba rgya mtsho bskongs/ gnyis med 'od gsal mchog tu grub par mdzod/ ces brjod/ dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad kyi rnam shes rang gi snying gar bstim/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag bzas pa po rnams kyi tshe srog bsod nams thams cad sna bug g.yon nas rngubs te srog gi dngas ma la bstim zhing*/ mi 'gyur ba'i tshe bsgrub pa bya'o/ de ltar bsnyen bsgrub kyi bzlas pa'i man ngag gud du bkol ba 'di yang*/ phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang zur 'debs su/ 'bri gung pa ratha pa 'bri gung la thun bde skyid smon pa thang du bris pa'o/ lan gcig zhus pa'o/ masbalaṃ/ (112)༄༅/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro chu dug sdong nag po'i las byang gdug pa tshar gcod ces bya ba bzhugs so/

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha yang mātra ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ bde bar gshegs pa rigs gsum kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ 'jam padal gshin rje gshed khro chu dug sdong nag po'i 'phrin las byas 'dod pas/ lha mchog 'di nyid la yi dam dang chos skyong du byed pa'i sgrub pos/ gnas dus rten dang mchod rdzas tshogs par byas la/ gzhi bdag dang bgegs rigs la gtor ma byin la bka' bgo/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ni/ dus 'di nas gzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ bla ma dang ni dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ lung ngag yid gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi/ zhes dang*/ snang grags chos rnams rang bzhin med pa la/ de ltar ma rtog sems can snying re rje/ de phyir bdag nyid gshin rje'i gshed gyur nas/ de dag sangs rgyas pa la 'god par bya/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ suṃ' nis sangs/ swā ༄༅ wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dgra bgegs gdug pa can (113)mtha' dag bsgral ba las byung ba'i khrag gi yon chab/ dbang po'i me tog sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me 'khris pa'i dri chab/ tsinga'i zhal zas/ rkang chen gyi gling bu la sogs pa mchod pa'i rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ basmra a0ཾ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du pukhye sdu pe ā lo ke gable nai wi snga sha༁ zhes sbyar ba slar bdud rtsi bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung med thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i/ āḥlas thod pa yangs shing rgya chen ba'i nang du/ bcud sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ sarba padwa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hri tha/ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod pas/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs gtor ma sngar ltar bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i/

āḥlas ban sda'i snod lcang lor bcas pa gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du/ rnariḥdang tri las dgra bgegs byad ma'i gzugs phud sha khrag gi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hri tha/ zhes gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ raca bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ āḥlas thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ srid gsum dgra bgegs chad pa pa can ma lus pa bsgral ba las byung ba'i raca'i rgya mtsho chen po lbu phrong rba rlabs 'phyo zhing yongs su gang bas gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ oṃ ma hā raca kwa la mahal hūm̐ hri tha/ zhes chad pa byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rdzu 'phrul gyi bsrung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang bdag bskyed gsal gdabs ni/ hūṃ chos rnams dmigs med spros bral kun khyab gdal/ snying rje'i rtsal du rang byung khro tshogs gsal/ e las rab 'jigs chad pa mtha' dbus med/ 'khor bas 'dam skems ye shes bskal me dang*/ 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho snying rje'i chu rgyun gyi/ tsha grang dbyer med rab tu 'jigs par 'khyug stong gi phyogs ni ral gri'i lding khang la/ 'og tu spu chen po'i 'dis gzhir brdal/ bar du mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshub/ de yi dbus nang ni lcags bsregs la/ phyi ru mtshon cha 'chol pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i phyi thod pa'i gur khang zlum po la/ dur khrod dang po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ ha la'i gur khang gru bzhi dug rlangs 'phyo/ rlung gi spu gri g.yon 'khor gru gsum 'bar/ phyi ni khro chu'i gur khang bsra mkhregs brtan/ de las bskal pa'i me chen rab tu 'bar/ (114)zhes gur khang brgyad kyis bsrung ba ste gzugs kyi shog dril gyi don no/ de nang bzlog byed khro bo gnag cing 'tsher/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mtshon cha sna tshogs gdengs/ grangs med sprul pas dgra bgegs ma rnams/ bzlog cing bsregs pas thal ba rdul du brlog

de'i nang nas khro bo dkar po zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug dang po tshe bum bdud rtsis bkang*/ bar pa gnam lcags 'khor los tshe bdud bzlog tha mas byang sems rgyun chad pa pa bsnams/ rang 'dra'i khro bo du mas sngags sgra sgrog bsrung zhing bskyangs pa'i las ni phun tshogs mdzad/ dus 'di nas gzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ bar chod dgra bgegs bdud dpung mtshams chod cig zhes pa 'di khro bo dkar chad pa ba sde yid kyi shog dril gyi don no/ gur khang gzhal yas chen po'i nang nyid du/ phyi nang yi dam chos skyong dregs chen gtso/ dgra bgegs pho mo gan rkyal kha sbubs steng*/ bdag nyid skad cig brdzus skyes rdo rje'i sku/ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs sprul pa/ snang srid kun gyi bcud 'dus khro bo'i rgyal/ 'jam dpal las gyi gshin rje dmar nag 'char/ ljang dmar nag pa'i zhal gsum drug pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcu'i bgegs la gzigs/ bstan pa'i dgra la khro 'khrug rngam pa'i zhal/ mche ba bcu gnyis dug phur 'bar ba bltams/ ljags 'dril drag po'i rkan brdebs dgra bgegs gsol/ rdzi smin smang ra ag tshom dbu sgra rnams/ dmar sam gyen brjes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ dbu stengs dug lcags khro chu'i mchod rten dbus/ rigs gsum dus gsum sangs rgyas thod skam brgyan/ g.yas gsum dgra stas nyams pa'i mgo lus 'phral/ g.yon gsum tsing srog rtsar bcas pa 'grad/ spu gri ral gri'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon gyis/ byad ma dgra bgegs bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod/ sde brgyad dregs pa'i mgo bcad do shal byas/ dug sbrul 'bar ba dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ srid rtse mnar med khyab pa sku'i khyon/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma zla ba 'char/ ba spu'i bu ga rang 'dra'i gro bos bltams/ lte bar srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig gi/ grong khyer bcas shing skye 'gro khram la 'debs/ sku rked chu srin rngam zhal bar yis/

stong gsum gsol zhing phur bu sbrul chun 'phyang*/ dgra bgegs srog gzir dngas ma 'dren par byed/ sku skyes dug mes gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bsreg khro chung tshogs spros dgra bgegs rdul du brlog mdun zur sku chad pa 'chi bdag nag po dang*/ g.yas zur gsung sprul tshe bdag sku mdog dmar/ g.yon zur thugs sprul srog bdag mthing nag mdog g.yon du yon tan bai wa pa ta dus/ rgyab tu 'phrin las za ba dmar ljang rnams/

(115)kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngam/ glang chen ko rlon zhing chen sbrul gyis brgyan/ sku smad phur bus nyams pa'i nyams pa'i snying la gzer/ rdzu 'phrul gshog pas bar snang khams su rgyug za byed zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/ smang ra ag tshoms khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus/ khros pa'i sdang mig dmar zlum gyen du bsgrad/ ral pa kham nag srid pa'i rtse mor 'bar/ thod pa skam rlon rin chen rus pa brgyan/ g.yas pa dgra stas nyams pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ g.yon pa dgra snying dmar po zas su rol/ g.yon du gnyis med dug gsum khros pa'i sku/ ya ma rā dza 'dod chags chu srin dang*/ zhe sdang seng chen gti phag zhal bsgrad/ khro rngam 'bar ba dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ sku smad phur bus nyams pa'i snying la gzer/ rdzu 'phrul gshog pas bar snang khams su rgyug za byed zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/ smang ra ag tshom khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus/ khros pa'i sdang mig dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs/ ral pa kham nag srid pa'i rtse mor 'bar/ thod pa sko rlon rin chen rus pas brgyan/ phyag drug g.yas gsum ral gris dgra srog gcod/ g.yon gsum sbrul nag zhags pas dgra bo 'ching*/ phyi 'khor las kyi gshin rje'i dmag gi tshogs/ gshed chen sde bzhi bdud sde bzhi dang*/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis sgo ba dregs pa bzhi/ srog gcod ru tra sde bzhir bcas pa/ pho gshed mo gshed bdun brgya nyi shu'i 'khor/ bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs bcas phyogs bcur rgyug kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'phyong stabs rngam/ khro gtum sha la sred cing khrag la rol/ ma bskul bar yang gang la bya shes nas/ spyi sgos bstan pa'i ru tra zhes gnon/ mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas sgrub pa po'i/ re ba bskong zhing bar chad dgra bgegs 'joms/ kun gyi gnas gsum yi ges mtshan pa las/ 'od 'phros ye shes lha tshogs spyan drags gyur/

zhes pa ni lha bskyed pa ste bsrung ba me'i shog dril gyi don no/ de nas spyan drang ba ni/ e yāḥ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na/ nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na/ las kyi gshin rje'i zhing khams su/ tsha grang 'khyug pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ mtshon cha 'chol ba'i gur khang dbus/ dregs byed 'bum gyi khri stengs su/ pasga nyi zla dgra bgegs gdan/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ bde gshegs kun gyi sprul pa ste/ ya mātra ka'i sku'i sras/ las kyi gshin rje ma rungs pa/ spyi gshed dug stong mthu bo che/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung slad du/ drag po'i pho brang dam pa 'dir/ spyan 'dren mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ khro chu dug stong khashegs su gsol/ 'chi bdag nag po gshegs su gsol/ tshe bdag dmar po gshegs su gsol/ srog bdag nag po gshegs su gsol/ bai wa sa ta gshegs su gsol/ za wa ljang dmar gshegs su gsol/ ya ma rā dza gshegs su gsol/ gshed chen bdud po 'chi bdag dang*/ ru tra sgo ba la sogs pa/ bye ba 'bum (116)dang bcas pa'i 'khor/ bstan pa gnyan po bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ phyi nang chos skyong 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ lha srin sde brgyad gshegs su gsol/ byad ma sbod gtong gshegs su gsol/ rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dul gshegs su gsol/ ye the'u bsen mo gshegs su gsol/ gza' klu the'u rang gshegs su gsol/ sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ byad kha phur kha bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol/ dgra bgegs gdug pa bsgrol phyir/ nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyong phyir gshegs su gsol/ rkyen ngan bar chad sel phyir gshegs su gsol/ ya ma rā dza pa ri wā ra basmra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ ma ṭaṃ ra tra bsgral ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ byad ma dgra bgegs nyi zla'i gdan stengs nas/ khro rgyal gshin rje rab 'jigs 'khor ba bcas/ mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

du tri ya ma rā dza/ ya ma rak+ṣa kro sda pa tsa la ka la rūpa a kro rwa dza ya ma ya dza dza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ti k+ṣa lhan/ zhes ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyor med du gyur par dmigs la/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ lha mchog mātra ka 'khor bcas la/ khrog gi a0ཾ dbang po'i me tog dang*// sha chen bsur dang zhun chen snang gsal sbar// 'khris pa'i dri chab tsi nga'i zhal zab dang*/ thod rnga rkang gling ror maro bcas pa 'di// 'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// rtsa sngags la mchod sngags btags la/ a0ཾ nas shakwa'i bar gyis dbul lo/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong du sbyar ba'i sma/ 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa/ nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms shing rigs lnga'i dngos/ ye shes lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi'i bcud 'di ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje rje shākya seng ge dang*/ nyan thos sde dang rig 'dzin pasga 'byung*/ ba su sda ra sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ gter bton zhang khrom zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ don yod rdo rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang/ karma si tu bzhi ba chen po/ nyi ma bcu drug pa dang kun dga'i zhabs/ byang chub dpal mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang*/ gzhan yang ba ya shag rdor sras a dbang*/ rig 'dzin gsang ba'i bar du brgyud pa yi/ rtsa rgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gshin rje 'di nyid kyi rgyud lugs gnyis kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ rtsa sngags 'jug tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'jam dpal khro bcu 'khor bcas la dbul/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā li ye oṃḥhūṃ/ zhes chos skyong bsrungs ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bdud rtsi'i thigs gtor 'bul zhing*/ bskyang bar bya'o/ de nas dug khrog gi mchod pa ni/ hūṃ las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la// dug khrag bdudi 'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// sting phyog lha rnams bsgral ba'i raca dang*// ban sda snod kyi dug khrag mtsho 'di/

'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ raca'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ 'og phyogs klu rnams bsgral ban sda snod kyi 'chi med= raca'i mchod pa = (117)bar snang gza' rnams bsgral = ban sda snrad kyi = 'tshi med sman = raca'i mchod pa = nag po bdud rnams bsgral ban sda = 'chi med sman = rapa'i mchod pa dmar po rtsan rnams bgral = ban sda snod = rapa'i med mchod = pho rgyud mo rgyud brgyul ba'i = ban sda snod = 'chi med= raca'i= sde brgyad 'byung po = ban sda = 'chi med = raca'i mchod = dgro bgegs log lta bsgral ba'i/ ban sda snrad kyi = 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir = raca'i mchod pa 'bul gyis/ rtsa lngags sham bur/ ma hā raca su dza ho/ zhes dbul de nas gtor ma dbul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo kha phyi bas rtsa sngags zhabs su/ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dgro bgogs byed ma rnams kyi don snying lnga ba kha raṃ khā hi/ srog rtsa khrag rtsa snying rtsa la kha raṃ khā hi/ skye mched gzugs phung rnams la kha raṃ khā hi/ byad ma dakhro bgogs mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la kha raṃ khā hi/ byad ma dakhro bgogs skye ba bdun rgyud dang bcas pa la kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes lan gsum rtsa phul bas/ 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i skad sgra dang bcas te gsol bar bsam mo/ de nas bsdod pa ni/ ā+e yaḥ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ pad nyi zla drogs byed gdan stengs su*/ dus gsum sangs rtayas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ rnam 'phrul sku gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshid thu bo che/ sku mdog dmar nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar*/ zhal gsum g.yas ljang phyag sdor drogs pa 'dul/ mayon mar mgrin dbang chen khros pa'i zhal/ dbul mthing 'jam dbyangs drag pos dgra bgegs lo/ rigs lnga sangs rgyas dbu'i rgyan du byas// spyan dgu dmar zluṃ sdang mi mig gyen thur gzigs/ mchen ba bcu gnyis dug phur 'bar bltams/

phyag drug g.yas gsum dgra stas ru tra bsgrol/ g.yon gsum nyams pa'i tsing chad pa spru gri ral 'bar ba'i gshog pa gdongs/ sked pa chu srin rngam zhal stong gsum rngub/ sku smad gnam lcags phur bus dgra bgegs gzir/ ba spru'i gseb nas sprul pa'i khro bo 'gyid/ sku la ye shes me phung rab tu 'phro/ dur khro rus pa'i chas kyis sku la brgyan/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyis/ gnyis med sprul pa 'chi bdag me yi bdag srog bdag bai wa pa ta za ba ljang*/ ya ma rā dza sprul 'khor bcas la bstong*/ chad pa khag bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'bul// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub du gsol/ dgra bgegs gnod byed bsgral ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ zhes bstod la bsnyen pa bya ba chad pa dang rdo rje dkar po'i lte ba ni/ 'od dkar gur nang bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong*/ zhal nang gzigs ste thugs brtses bar 'gyur/ zhes pa ni ting gyis bsrung ba chu bo'i shog dril gyis don no/ nang du tsing zur (118) chad pa gsum dug rlangs 'phrur/ 'dzam dpal gser mdog ral gri po ti 'dzin/ rta mgrin dmar po thod dbyug sdigs mdzub can/ drogs pa mthing nag rdo rje zhags pa rnams/ g.yas bskul g.yon brkyang pad nyi'i chad pa / dur khrod chas brgyan sgo gsum bsrung bar gyur/ zhes pa ni ting 'dzin gyis bsrung ba dus kyi shog dril gyi don no chad pa ūṃ gi klad bskor dbul su bla ma dang dbyer med bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan rdzogs thugs ka yi/ 'od kyis 'chi med bdud rtsi bkug byas te/ thugs srog gsum la thim pas chad pa dbang thob/ zhes pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyis bsrung ba gdengs can gyi shog dril gyi don no/ skad cig nyid rdzus skyes khro bo'i sku/ 'od lnga las sgrub keng rus bde ba'i nyams/ zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gnas gsum yi ges mtshan/

de las 'od 'phros yes shes spyan drangs thim/ 'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'phro 'dus dbang bskur zhing*/ dngas ma drangs pa'i bcud kyis phyi nang khyab/ bsrung byed khro bo'i bdud rtsi nang du 'khyil/ srid gsum sgrib sbyangs bde stong ro la spyod/ tshe dpal bar chad sdig sgrib gnod byed bgegs/ thams cad 'od zer nag po de la thim/ slor yang yig gsum 'phreng ba'i 'phro 'du yis/ 'jig rten dregs pa rigs drug tshe bdud kyi/ sgrib sbyangs ye shes lha'i go 'phang bkod/ mthu stobs nus pa das bo 'bru lnga dang*/ a su ṇi tri sre du trir bcas bsdus/ sngags 'phrengs bon bcas par thim pa yis/ 'khor 'das kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan/ 'phrin las mkhyen brtse tshe bkrag gzi mdangs rgyas*/ skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i khus su gyur/ zhes pa mā sdis bsrung ba'i shog dril bu ga'i grangs can zhal shes kyi dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i ngang nas/ du tri yā ma rā dza ya ma rak+ṣa kro sda tsa la kā la ru pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā pa ma ya dza dza*/ zhes ca ba'i bsnyen sngags dang*/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bsrungs cig bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la bsrungs cig ṇi bruṃ basmra rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes gdags pa ni bsrung ba'i sngags te/ bzla bya'i sngags so/ de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni mdun kyi rten rnams dang gtor ma (119)bsang sbyang byas la/ hūṃ chos rnams dmigs med spros bral kun khyab gdal/ zhes pa nas dgra bgegs pho mo gan rkyal kha sbub steng*/ zhes pa'i bar du bsrung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang gdan bskyed la/ bcom ldan 'dzam dpal gshis rjes gshe po ni/ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs sprul pa/ zhes sogs skyis gtso 'khor rnams bskyed cing*/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ phyi mchod bdud rtsi sngags kyi dbul zhing*/ dug khrag gi mchod pa dang*/ gtong ma dbul bstod pa ni/ hūṃ bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshen rje'i gshed/

dgra bgegs baṃ dang sde zabargyad bsnol ba'i stong*/ khro rgyal gshin rje sku mdog dmar nag ste/ zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas gsum dgra ste bsnams/ g.yon gsum gradabo'i snying dang nang khrol gsol/ g.yas ljang g.yon dmar dbul mthing mi ro 'cha'/ dbu skra kham ser mchod rten gsum gyi nang*/ rigs gsum mgon dang dus gsum sangs rgyas tu 'bar/ rigs gsum mgon dang dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ 'dzum pa'i zhal dang bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa'i/ sku smad khro chu shi me phur pa dbal dang ldan// sku sked chu srin rngam zhal sbrul nag 'phyang*/ chu gri spu gri'i gshog pa bar snang brkang*/sku la dug gi me dpung rab tu 'bar/ 'khor du 'chi bdag tshe bdag bdag dang*/ bai wa sa ta ljang dmar dang*/ ya ma rā la sogs gshin rje'i tshogs/ 'tshi bdag bcu gsum sgo ba drogs pa dang*/ yang 'khor gshin rje dgu 'bul dgu khri sogs/ bsrung dang bzlog cing bsad pa'i las mdzad rnams/ 'jal dpal gshin rje'i bka' la ma 'da' bar// sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ byin brlabs dngos grub char ltar 'bebs pa yi/ yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ rnal 'byor gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes bstod cing tshogs kyi longs spyod sumā nis bsangs swā ༄༅ wa sa sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la phud cha gsum gyi dang gtor mar sgron ma bdud ci bran te/ gtor sngags lan pa'i dbul zhing bskang ba bya/ phud bar pa sgrol la/ oṃ ya ma rwa dza sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yi ge brgya pa brjed cing bshags pa bya/ tha ma bsgral zhing btab pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas e mthing kha gc-ig chad mdun du 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dug dang zangs lcags khro chu las grub pa'i khang sgrom me 'bar ba/ gru gsum pa bang rim dgu dang ldan pa/ kha khror yangs shing gting zab pa/

de'i nang du 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba nga zhes sdang gi me rlung batshub pa/ gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ mtshon cha'i drag char 'bab pa/ nad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ dug gi rlabs pa sngo dmar 'phyog ba/ khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa/ gshin rje'i skyes bu dpag tu me pa rgyud pa/ than dang ldan ngag gyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyi gang ba/ gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya 'jigs su rung ba rnams ni/ seng ge ltar rngam pa stag ltar 'phyogs ba 'brong ltar (120)bsang sbyang byas la hūṃ chos rnams dmings med spros bral kun khyab gdal/ zhes pa nas dgra bgegs pho mo gan skyal kha sbub steng*/ zhes pa'i bar du bsrung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang gdan bskyed la/ bcom ldan 'jal dpal gshin rje'i gshi po ni/ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs sprul pa/ zhes sogs gtso 'khor rnams bskyed cing*/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ phyi mchod bdud rtsi sngags kyis dbul zhing*/ dug phrag gi mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul bstod ni/ hūṃ bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ dgra bgegs baṃ dang sde brgyad bsnol ba'i steng*/ khro rgyal gshin rje sku mdog dmar nag ste/ zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas gsum dgra sta bsnams/ g.yon gsum dgra bo'i snying dang nang khrol gsol/ g.yas ljang g.yon dmar dbus mthing mi ro 'cha'/ dbu skra khal ser mchod rten gsum gyi nang*/ rigs gsum mgon dang dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ 'dzum pa'i zhal dang bsrung pa'i las mdzad pa'i/ sku smad khro chu ba'i phur pa dpal dang ldan/ sku sked chu srin rngam zhal sbrul nag 'phyang*/ chu gri spu gri'i gshog pa bar snang bskyang*/ sku la dug gi me dpung rab tu 'bar/ 'khor du 'chi bdag tshe bdag chad pa bdag dang*/ bai wa sa ta za ba ljang dmar dang*/ ya ma rā dza la sogs gshin rje'i tshogs/ 'chi bdag bcu gsum sgo ba drogs pa dang*/ yang 'khor gshin rje dgu 'bul dgu khri sogs/

bsrung dang bzlog cing bsad pa'i las 'dzad nag 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ de'i 'og tu bskal pa'i rlung spu gri so rgal chi li li 'khrug pa/ de'i 'og tu drag po chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dgra bo thams cad gtan nas brlab par byed pa mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gang du gnas kyang skadacig gis chad pa gyur/ zhes dmigs la bden brdar dang*/ dgug gzhug gsum sogs kyi 'jug tu/ che ge mo/ rnari dzaḥ tri baṃ ril dzaḥ aka' dzaḥ gatsha smyi dzaḥ a we sha ya dzaḥ zhes brjod la bstim de nas gshin rje'i dmag chad pa la ba ni/ e yā phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na/ nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na/ las kyi gshin rje'i zhing khams na/ tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ shin na 'jigs pa'i pho brang ni/ steng chad pa gra'i chad pa khang la/ 'og ni spu gri'i sa gzhi ste/ bar snang spu gri chu gri dang*/ mtshon cha 'chol pa'i gur khang du/ dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs bam gyi steng*/ las kyi gshin rje nag po ni/ sku mdog dmar dag me ltar 'bar/ zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ g.yas ljang pho rgyud tshogs rnams gsol/ g.yon dmar mo rgyud tshogs rnams gsol/ dbus mthing byad ma dgra bgegs gsol/ dbu gsum steng na

(121) chad pa bgying ba khra ltar 'dzum pa/ sbrul ltar 'khrug pa/ 'dresrin ltan ngu ba 'gong po ltar smyo ba srin bya ltar rgod pa wa mo ltar brgyan ba/ srin po ltar khros pa/ sha za ltar rgyug pa/ sod sod rgyob rgyob kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pas gang ba/ de'i nang du bskal pa stong gi mun nag 'khrigs pa/ phyi nas bskal pa stong gi me 'bar zhing rlung nag 'tshub pa/ gshin rje'i zhing khams bshan pa'i pho brang*/ srog gcod kyi grogs khyir/ srin pa las kyi gzhal yas khang chen po/ dgra bo phyin ma thag lha dang phral zhing gshed du 'bebs pa/ las ngan thams cad smin par byed pa'i btson khang drag so/ de'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra/ dkon mchog gi spyi dgra/ rnal 'byor gyi sgos dgra dmigs pa'i dgra bo gang gi rnam par shes pa/ ṇi dud kha yongs su gyur pa las*/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo de dgra nyams chung ba/ sgyid pa phra ba skra gzings pa mdog nag cing ba pa mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can/ bu ga dgu nas khrag dang rnam 'dzag pa/ kha nas sod kyi sgra sgrog pa/ bsrung zhing skyob pa'i lha dang bral zhing*/ gnod byid thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de'i 'og tu zhing chen gyi pa ga bsdal ba/ mtshon cha sna tshogs gzigs te 'dug pa/ drag po'i chi li li khol pa/ de'i 'og tu rak+ṣa'i rba rlabs 'khrul cing*/ zhing chen gyi rba nyil nyil 'phyo ba/ de'i 'og tu bskal pa'i me rlung dmar rnams/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' la ma 'da' bar*/ sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ byin brlabs dngos grub char ltar 'bebs pa yi/ yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ rnal 'byor gus pa'ica sgo nas phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes bstod cing tshogs kyi longs spyod sumā nis bsangs swā ༄༅ wa sa sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phud cha gsum gyi dang po gtor mar sgron la bdud rtsi bran te/

gtor sngags lan chad pa dbul zhing bskang ba bya/ phud bar pa sgron la/ oṃ ya ma rwa dza pa ma ya ma nu bā la ya/ sogs yi ge brgya sa brjod cing bshags pa bya/ tha ma bsgral zhing btab sa ni/ bsang sbyang stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi thugs ka nas e mthing kha gcig chad mdun du 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa la/ dus dang zangs lcags khro chu las grub pa'i khang sgrom me 'bar ba/ gru gsum pa bang rim dgu dang ldan pa/ kha khyer yangs shing gting zab pa/ de'i nang du 'dod chags gi khrag mtsho khol ba/ zhes sdang gi me rlung 'tshub pa/ gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ mtshon cha'i drag char 'bab pa/ nad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ dug gi rlungs pa sngo dmar 'phyogs ba/ khrag gi ser chen 'babs pa/ gshin rje'i skyes bu dpag tu med pa rgyug pa/ than dang ltas nang gyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya 'jigs su rung ba rnams ni/ seng ge ltar rngam pa/ stag ltar 'phyogs ba 'brogs ltar (122)mchod rten gsum/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs/ bsrung skyob tshe dbang chos kyi sku/ g.yas gsum dgra sta bsnams pa ni/ nyams pa can gyi mgo lus 'phral/ g.yon gsum snying dang dog rtsa bsnams chad pa drogs pa bco brgyad zhal gsol/ sku sha gdug pa sbrul gyis brgyan/ gdug pa'i tshogs rnams rlul du brlog mche ba bcu gsum dug phur ltams/ byang ma lha bsrungs don snying gsol/ ljags gsum chad pa skad sgra brdeb/ stong gsum lha 'dre zhal du gsol/ spu gri'i gshog pa g.yas pa yis/ pho rgyud thams cad rtsad nas gcod/ ral gri'i gshog pa gshog pa g.yon pa yis/ mo rgyud tshogs rnams dmyal thag gcod/ sku chad pa drin rngam zhal can/ stong gsum mi mjed du gsol/ sku smad khro chu'i phur bu yis/ byad ma 'bum gyi srog snying gzer/ sku la bskal pa'i me 'bar bas/ dmigs pa'i dgri bo gzhob du bsreg las kyi chad pa

na rje mthu rtsal can/ 'khor dug gshin rje byed bas bskor/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ gang la dmigs pa rdul du brlog 'chi bdag nag po'i dus la bab/ pho rgyud tshogs rnams rdul du brlog tshe dbag dmar po'i mo rgyud tshogs rnams rdul du brlog srog bdag nag po'i= snang srid lha 'dre lha rdul 'u brlog bai wa sa ta'i= za ba ljag dmar= mu stegs tshogs rnams rdul du= khro chu dug stong = thams cad lus rdul du= spyi gshed dug sdong*/ phyi nang chos skyong rdul= dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ byad ma lha bsrungs sde gargyad dngas/ ban bon mu stegs shan pa'i tshogs/ dregs chen bco brgyad 'dre steng*/ byadatha 'bum dang brgyad rnams/ skad nyid la rdul du brlog dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ byang bu 'di la btab pa yi/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ gang la bya ba khyed kyi shes*/ yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo 'di/ do nub nam gyi gung thun la/ dam nyamasalas na gnyid log gis/ bla 'khyems la sher khug la shog srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog snying khrag hub kyis 'thung la shog don snying sbar gyis chus la shog sod rtags don snying khyer la shog dgra bo 'khor bcas chad pa lha dang phrol la bdud dang sprod/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzad do/ ces btso 'khorarnams dang*/ ya ma rwa dza bskul ba ni/ 'a༄༅ོ yā ཿ phyogs phyogs drag kyang pha gi na/ sa ni rim dgu'i mar zhabs nas/ chad pa med rgya mtsho'i nang gshed stong mthu bo che/ gnyis med thugs las sprul pa'i sras/ ya ma smya dza mthu bo che/ mthing nag rab 'jigs khro gtum can/ zhal gsum phyam drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ g.yas pa seng zhal rngam zhing bgying*/ g.yon pa phag zhal thur du bsgrad*/ dbus zhal chu srin rngam zhal can/ ya 'gal gnam la ma 'gal pa/ lce ni bar snang klog ltar 'khyur/ mche ba chad pa pyan mig khrag mtshor khyi li li/ g.yas pa gnam lcags ral gri 'phyar/

dam nyams dgra bo'i shus 'phral/ g.yon pa sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams/ dam nyam dgra bo'i yan lag 'ching*/ dam nyams dgra bo las/ chad pa zhal du btab po mgur du bsgrim/ dam nyamasagra bo brlag tu chug khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ zhes pa nas/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ de nas phyi 'khor rnams bskum ba ni/ ུ yāḥgashed chen sde bzhi'i du la bab/ mon pa sde bzhi'i dus la bab/ bdud po sde bzhi'i= 'chi dbag bcu gsum= dus la bab pa so ma ya/ zhes pa nas/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ pho gshed sum brgya drug cu'i/ mo gshed sum brgya cu'i du la bab/ sgo ba sde bzhi'i= ru tra sde bzhi'i= dus la bab pa sa ma ya/ dam las ma 'da' dam tshig can/ zhes pa nas/ bcol ba'i 'phris grub par mdzod/ gshin rje'i dmar tshogs dus la bab/ dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/// / lan gcig zhus so/ mulaṃ // 1$000011
